projects.summary: Knovum 一款开源、本地优先的无限画布 AI 知识工作空间。将 Heptabase 式的空间白板、Obsidian 的数据掌控权（开放 JSON Canvas + SQLite）与本地离线 AI（Ollama + LanceDB + Whisper）结合，打造轻量、隐私可控的技术调研与学习桌面工作台。 • 本地优先与数据掌控：完全杜绝云端绑定和私有格式锁定。支持行业开放的 JSON Canvas 规范与标准单文件 SQLite，数据 100% 留存在本地，断网全功能可用。 • 极轻原生桌面（Tauri 2 + Rust）：底层由 Rust 驱动，前端采用 Vue 3，启动秒开，常驻内存仅几十 MB，彻底告别传统 Electron 工具动辄数百 MB 内存的笨重感。 • 空间化无限画布：支持 Markdown 笔记卡片、技术草图、PDF/音视频素材同屏混排与双向关联连线，告别死板的层级文件夹。 • 开箱即用的端侧 AI：内置嵌入式 LanceDB 向量检索与本地 Whisper 语音切片转录，原生对接本地 Ollama 模型，提供变异感知溯源引擎（修改源笔记时自动标识引文失效，避免假引用）。 • 开放协议集成：原生支持 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 与 Agent Client Protocol (ACP)。

projects.title: Termi Protocol
projects.summary: Termi is a 3D room where your real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more) work at their own desks. You watch every file read, command and edit live, not a scrolling log. New since our first launch: when an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit, Termi saves its goal, changed files, errors and todos, then hands the work to an agent on another model. A boss agent splits one goal across your team. Deleted agents go to a trash. Now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

projects.title: Glaude
projects.summary: Meet Glaude — stop babysitting Claude Code. Keep track of your coding sessions, see when Claude needs your attention, and jump back in without constantly switching between terminals. Less context switching, fewer interruptions, and more time building. Claude codes. Glaude keeps you in the loop.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Context Attachment Manager：让 Codex 和 Claude 按需取回历史图片
projects.author: chipfighter

github.name: chipfighter/context-attachment-manager
github.description: Long image chats in Codex and Claude, without the lag. The model manages its own images, pulling back only what it needs, and any image you made before is one search away: just describe what you remember.

projects.summary: 我是项目作者，想推荐一个管理多图长对话的小工具。 在 Codex 里反复生图、改图时，历史图片会不断累积，跟着后续消息重复发送。我做了 Context Attachment Manager，让对话继续留在原任务中，同时减少不必要的图片重传。 模型按需取回历史图片；重要参考图可以固定为每轮发送，也能手动勾选。 按描述、用户评价和轮次查找图片，例如搜“脸最好”或“雨夜”。 为图片记录特征和评价，帮助对话压缩后重新找到对应图片。 项目中的一个 15 张图测试，请求体从 24.9 MB 降至 212 KB；这是该测试场景的数据，不代表所有对话的效果。 适用于 Codex 桌面版和 Claude 桌面版 Code 标签页中的本地会话，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux。v0.9.0 也支持兼容对应客户端协议的自定义服务地址。插件在本机处理，不修改原始对话和素材，不额外上传到第三方服务。 项目采用 MIT 协议，TypeScript/Node 实现。README 有图文演示，安装可直接让 Codex 或 Claude 按 INSTALL.md 操作。 项目： 中文介绍： 安装： 欢迎有多图长对话需求的朋友试用并反馈。

projects.title: [开源自荐] Voltip：识别可以完全在本机的跨平台语音输入工具
projects.author: sunerpy

github.name: sunerpy/voltip
github.description: Push-to-talk voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On-device or cloud speech recognition, AI polish with presets, a dictionary, rules and scenes, long recordings with subtitles; the phone works on its own or pairs end-to-end encrypted as the computer's microphone and keyboard.

projects.summary: Voltip 是我做的语音输入工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android。在任意应用里按住 Ctrl+Alt+Space 说话，松开后文字粘贴到光标处；开着 AI 润色时，口头禅和说错又改口的部分会被去掉。识别可以用云端服务商，也可以下载 Qwen3-ASR、SenseVoice 等模型完全在本机完成；AI 润色可选，能接自己的服务商或本机的 Ollama。适合每天在电脑上写大段文字、给 AI 工具口述提示词，或不希望录音离开电脑的人。 亮点 识别可以不离开电脑：应用里能下载五个模型（Qwen3-ASR 0.6B / 1.7B、SenseVoice Small、Paraformer、实时预览用的流式模型）。Qwen3-ASR 经 transcribe.cpp 运行，有显卡时走 Vulkan（Windows、Linux）或 Metal（macOS），没有显卡就用 CPU；SenseVoice 和 Paraformer 经 sherpa-onnx 在 CPU 上运行。也可以自己配置各个服务商的URL和api key使用云服务识别润色。 词典专门对付总被听错的词：每个词条写一个正确写法和最多 10 个常被听成的样子，识别后立即替换，正确写法还会作为提示发给云端识别和 AI 润色。最后还有字面和正则两种替换规则。 场景：开始录音时看前台是哪个应用，自动换用对应的润色预设。内置了编程、办公写作、即时聊天等场景（默认关闭，打开后生效），编程场景里代码、命令、路径和标识符保持原样。 语音编辑：选中一段文字，按住 Ctrl+Alt+E 说「改得正式一点」或「翻译成英文」，选区直接被改写结果替换。 安卓手机可以当电脑的麦克风和键盘：扫码或输入 6 位验证码配对，音频端到端加密后经中继传到电脑，由电脑用自己的设置识别。 没有桌面的 Linux 服务器上可以运行 voltip-server，向本机其他程序提供 OpenAI 兼容的转写接口。 核心用 Rust 写，桌面端是 Tauri 2 + React，AGPL-3.0 开源。 目前的限制：Windows 安装包还没有代码签名，macOS 版未经 Apple 公证；iOS 版还没有；纯 Wayland 会话没有全局快捷键；不做说话人区分和批量转写。

projects.title: Show HN: Embodsi – Embodied Super Intelligence
projects.author: laser
projects.summary: embodsi is a generative AI MMO experience that runs in the browser. It allows people to communicate (text, audio, video, avatar emotes and movement) and collaboratively build 3D spaces and games via LLMs connected to harnesses and sandboxes for object modeling, space layout, game logic, and driving persistent avatars with shared context and memory. It’s different from existing 3D social apps (AFAIK) because it enables people to build multiplayer virtual worlds, games, and characters with generative AI right from their browser (desktop, mobile, or VR), in nearly infinitely-extendable recursively tiled interconnected spaces, while allowing people to interact in a public commons or easily create a private channel to enjoy the same spaces with their chosen friends and community. The brief backstory is I was running my personal “pelican benchmark” [1] on GPT-6 Astra, which when I ran on Gemini 3 Pro last November couldn’t even put heads on 3D models the right side up [2], and was astounded by the initial results. I gained inspiration for an art project and social experiment that was going to have nine interconnected, benevolent virtual worlds that people could explore and hang out in with AI characters, but by the time Opus 5.5 was released I was gaining so much momentum and having so many ideas and so much fun building I just kept building more and more with the constraint of minimizing MVP scope lifted by agentic coding. I let the project become an ever-evolving wishlist of capabilities for a more interesting social environment as I became increasingly fascinated with the prospect of embodying creative machine intelligence in 3D space with people, realizing that rather than just limiting to building the spaces and characters I imagined I might enable people to co-create endless spaces and characters in a shared world. There’s so much to do still but I’m sharing now even if it feels a little too soon (this is the first public announcement of embodsi’s existence) because I think it’s better to build in the open so people might guide the development and help it evolve in a good direction as model capability improves at a jaw-dropping pace. For people that have the budget to build I hope to see you in embodsi creating amazing things! And for everyone regardless of means (I’ve tried to keep as much free and accessible as financially feasible) I hope you meet amazing people, discover awesome spaces, and enjoy your time in embodsi :) I’ll be around here and embodsi to answer any questions! Thanks for your feedback and critique. - Laser P.S. SI != AI — but an emergent property of many people and what we create cascading and recursively interacting [3] [1] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50074156 [2] https://x.com/lasernite/status/1991021951301923107 [3] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaia_hypothesis

projects.title: Show HN: Toli – Let Claude Code on one computer work with Codex on another
projects.author: alama24
projects.summary: A month or so ago, a colleague was running some code my team owned on his machine and hit a niche Windows kernel-related Python issue. We were debugging it together, but kept having to relay information between our coding agents, mine understood the codebase, while his had the context of the environment where it was actually failing. At some point I realized we were basically acting as the message bus between them, copying findings and questions back and forth. That made me wonder, why not just let the agents work together directly? I found A2A and built toli, a local daemon that an existing agent can connect to over MCP, giving it the plumbing to discover and work with A2A peers, including another person’s toli-connected agent on another machine. It also works locally. I use it to let two of my agents working on sister codebases collaborate on bugs and design without having to give either agent both repos. projects.title: Show HN: Caudra – An open-source terminal coding agent in one native binary
projects.author: netsroht
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Thorsten. Caudra ( https://caudra.ai ) is an open source TUI coding agent written in Rust. It started as a fork of Maki and has grown into its own project. I spend most of my working day with coding agents and i have tried a lot of them. I kept adding more and more plugins to get the features I wanted. Most of the time though, i couldn't build the plugins i needed because I couldn't hook into the places I needed (e.g. proper /goal mode). It was also hard to keep them up-to-date, and I wanted one binary I could install in new environments and use right away. It also had to work with small/fast (even local) models as well as flagship ones. I'd like to have feedback on these things: - Steering: You can send a message as "next" (after the turn ends), "guide" (at the next safe point) or "replace" (right now). IMO, "next" is useful for simple ad-hoc chains. - /btw: Ask a side question while the main agent keeps working. It reuses the prompt cache, so follow-ups are cheap. This works even during an active question prompt. - Small/fast models: Caudra nudges the model when a turn stalls, which helps models like Qwen3.8-27B that sometimes stop early. The conversation is always append-only, so the provider cache stays warm. From using it myself, I see about 97% cache hits with anthropic models and 94% with openai. It's still in preview. I'd like to hear what breaks and what you'd want before you'd consider to switch. Repo: https://github.com/caudra/caudra Clips: https://caudra.ai/gallery/

projects.summary: 我们推出并开源了记忆原生基础模型 MemT 1.0，探索让“记住、更新、调用经验”成为模型可以学习的能力，这是我们的 GitHub 开源链接： ，欢迎老师体验～ 模型创新点 我们在 Transformer 的部分模块中加入原生记忆模块，让模型通过内部记忆状态保留和使用历史信息。每轮交互时，模型读取已有记忆；交互结束后，再将输入与回答写入记忆，供后续使用。这个过程中，模型权重保持固定，更新的是各条交互轨迹独立维护的记忆状态。也就是说，在后续相关任务中，模型可以利用此前写入的信息，无需再次把历史原文放进当前上下文。 模型具体表现 本次开源包含 Flash 和 Nano 两款模型，总参数量分别为 288B、36B，激活参数量分别为 17B、3B。在查询时不提供历史原文的条件下，两款模型在 11 项记忆基准上的平均得分分别为 50.6、47.0，位列本次评估的参数化记忆方法第一、第二。同时，我们也在 Coding Agent 中探索了经验的使用：将检索到的操作经验写入内部记忆，帮助模型完成后续任务。

projects.title: Show HN: A scroll-through subway ride to show how GLP-1s work in your body
projects.author: mparker123
projects.summary: I was looking at GLP-1 explanations on the web (full disclosure is that I founded a GLP-1 tracker dashboard) and saw that many had standard text, along with illustrations showing arrows pointing from GLP-1 to a bunch of organs. I didn’t think those sites were particularly memorable or helpful in understanding the actions and side effects. I’m an MD + computer science hybrid with a background in building interactive tools for helping people understand medical concepts, so I decided to build a free scroll-through explainer in the form of a subway ride. The ride is 7 stops, takes about 5-10 minutes, and doesn’t require an account. This was with the assistance of AI, using multiple tools. The process was far from one-shot and with me heavily in the loop for all the different pieces. I still find it tricky to get something medically accurate and useful when the details matter. I had built a free set of pages, GLP-1 Field Guides, to help people understand the different GLP-1 related drug classes, and I was able to lean on all of that research and sources to get the details right and to provide authoritative sources for the information presented at each subway stop. I had tried building this starting in February but then paused it for a few months because the models weren’t quite at the point where I could make what I had in my mind’s eye. In the final piece, the different animated elements are drawn in code and change with the scrolling. Here are some of the tools I ended up using: - GPT Image and Nano Banana, both via a custom Claude Code skill I wrote, with my own sketches as the base, for the Field Guide visuals that were important for this piece. Nano Banana for the subway graffiti and the organs - Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for the conductor’s voice - Suno for the song (ride to the end) - Claude Code with Opus 5.5 to build the site and Codex for code review I am curious if this is a useful format for understanding GLP-1s but happy to answer questions about any of the above.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Treefold：把 AI Coding 的多仓库、Worktree、终端和任务放在一起
projects.author: win5do

github.name: win5do/treefold
github.description: A local-first macOS app for running AI agents in parallel Git worktrees. Keep code, terminals, and tasks together, then merge changes back cleanly.

projects.summary: LLM 时代高强度用 AI Agent 搞项目，LLM 很强，但想要高效舒服的开发还是有很多繁琐的流程。 例如经常同时推进几个任务，还涉及前后端两个 repo，并行任务不相互冲突大家都知道用 git worktree。 手敲 git worktree 命令很繁琐，AI 可以代劳，但每次都要交代一遍却挺烦：从哪个分支创建，前后端项目在哪个目录，做完合回哪里。想去对应目录跑条命令，还得找路径、开终端、切过去。任务一多，就容易忘记哪个目录对应哪件事。 我就在想能不能把常用流程做到一个 ui 界面中管理，于是做了一个 APP 叫 Treefold。我想把每项任务的代码、终端和进度放在一起，打开就知道做到哪了，接下来可以继续做什么。 任务展开以后，要知道怎么收回来 我把工作分成三层：Project、Workspace、Fork。 Project 放一个项目相关的仓库和目录。我一般让原仓库保持在 main 分支，再为每项 feature 创建 Workspace，各自使用独立分支和 worktree。创建时默认从原仓库当前分支展开，也可以选择其他本地或远端分支作为起点。 一个 feature 里有可以并行的子任务，就继续创建 Fork。比如做“商品搜索”，可以让几个 Fork 分别负责接口、页面和测试，各自在独立目录里修改，完成后合回父 Workspace，再一起联调和交付。 这样，worktree 就有了明确的父子关系，交付时知道应该合回哪里。操作由人确认，发生冲突仍然需要处理。Workspace 还可以选择推送 feature 分支，接着走原来的远端评审流程。 简单任务开一个 Workspace 就够了，不用每次都拆 Fork。同一 Workspace 里的多个 Session 共享代码目录；需要隔离修改时，再创建 Fork。 worktree 多了，目录和状态都得看得清 git worktree list 能列出目录和分支，但想知道里面是否有未提交的修改、改动是否已经合回去，还得逐个检查。任务多了，这些小操作也会打断思路。 Treefold 把 worktree list 做成了界面里的管理列表，按仓库展开。每个 worktree 的分支、路径、当前提交和关联任务放在一起，同时显示未提交改动、冲突，以及相对目标分支领先或落后的提交数。已经合入目标分支的状态也会标出来，不用挨个进入目录查 Git。 从列表可以直接打开关联任务；不再使用的 worktree，可以在界面里确认后删除，也能清理失效的 worktree 记录。哪些还在开发、哪些改动已经合入、哪些目录可以收拾，都有地方查看。 完成的任务可以归档，先保留分支、worktree 和工作记录，之后再按需清理。Project 里可以批量清理已归档的 Workspace，Workspace 里也能清理已归档的 Fork。隔天回来看时，活跃任务和已完成的工作分开，也能找到之前的交付记录。 创建 worktree、启动 Session 和批量清理都可以在后台继续，不用一直守着弹窗。切去做其他任务后，也能回来查看状态和失败原因。 Agent 写完，检查代码和提交 我一直挺喜欢 JetBrains 的 Git 集成：修改在哪里，提交了什么，都可以直接看。 Treefold 里也放了 Git Changes 和 History。开发过程中看 diff，交付前检查提交；几个零散提交可以用 Squash 整理成一个，也可以 Reset 到指定提交。当前分支最新一次提交的说明写得不合适，也可以直接在 History 里修改。如果本地记录显示它被远端分支、标签或其他分支引用，会先提醒，再由我决定是否继续。 完成交付时，可以选择 Squash，把这项工作的成果合成一个提交放进父分支。前后端改动不一样，就分别填写提交说明，在同一个弹窗里检查后一起确认。源分支上的开发记录仍然保留，父分支收到的是整理后的提交。 我没有做完整的交互式 rebase 和冲突编辑器。常用操作放在界面里，更复杂的 Git 操作继续交给终端和 Agent，处理完再回来检查结果。 Project 里也能直接查看和搜索本地、远端分支，切换分支，或者删除不再需要的分支。这些短操作，不用每次都通过聊天交给 Agent。 检查代码时，也不想每次都重新告诉 Agent：“这是哪几个仓库，应该和哪个分支比较，别漏掉还没提交的修改。”所以加了 AI Review：在 Workspace 或 Fork 里选一个 Agent，确认提示词，就会打开一个专门检查这项工作的 Session。 Fork 和父 Workspace 比较，Workspace 和 Project 当前分支比较。Treefold 会把各仓库的路径、分支和比较范围交给 Agent，要求同时检查已提交、未提交的修改和新文件。默认提示词让它先报告问题，我确认后，可以在同一个 Session 里继续讨论、修复和验证。也可以给 Project 保存自己的 Review 提示词。 这样，从开发、检查到修复都留在同一项任务里，最后再决定怎么交付。完成交付前，如果还有将被停止的 Session 在运行，界面会先列出来，让我选择暂缓交付，或者确认停止后继续。这里检查的是进程是否还活着，不能替我判断 Agent 是否已经做完。 暂缓的任务，先记在 Todo 里 和 AI 讨论方案时，经常会冒出一些现在不做、以后值得试的点子。以前我会开个文件记 Todo，接下来还得记得这个文件放在哪。 现在可以直接记到 Workspace 的 Todo list。要做的时候，把 Todo 分配给 Fork，展开成一项独立工作；完成并合回父 Workspace 后，关联的 Todo 也会完成。 Treefold 也带了 CLI 和 Skill，Agent 能读取、添加和修改 Todo，遇到问题时也能记录阻塞原因。换一个 Session 接着做，代码、Todo 和交付记录都还留在 Workspace 里，不用依赖某一次聊天记住所有事情。 比如接口开发时发现一个值得单独处理的问题，可以先留下 Todo，继续完成手头的工作。等有空了再把它分出去，也不用为了保留这个点子一直开着原来的 Session。 Agent 把服务跑起来了，我却看不到它在干什么 调试的时候，我经常要让 Agent 启动前后端服务。以前它通常在自己的会话后台启动，再告诉我“服务已经起来了”。我只知道启动了，眼前却没有一个能持续看日志的终端。想知道请求有没有进来、服务有没有报错，还得让它再查一遍。 两个 Agent 并行工作时更麻烦：各自的会话没有共享的进程列表，不知道对方已经启动了什么。一个刚把服务跑起来，另一个又启动一遍，端口就冲突了。 Treefold 用 amux 管理这些需要持续运行的进程。服务可以跟着任务列出来，人能在界面里看日志、输入命令，Agent 也能通过 amux 查询进程、读取日志、停止或重启服务。几个 Session 可以共同观察同一个服务，启动前先查看已有进程，再决定复用还是另开一套。 切走页面不影响进程运行，也不用再回忆服务藏在哪次聊天里。不过并行启动多套服务时，端口仍然需要分别配置，Treefold 目前不会自动隔离端口。 关闭窗口时，可以选择让 App 留在后台，或者直接退出。退出 App 后是否保留 amux 和受管进程，则由单独的设置控制。 一个任务，可能要改几个仓库 有些项目的前后端是两个 Git 仓库。一个功能要两边一起改，就得告诉 AI 两边的位置，同步创建分支和 worktree，再检查是不是进了对应的目录。 所以 Treefold 的一个 Project 可以放多个仓库。创建 Workspace 或 Fork 时，相关仓库一起准备分支和 worktree，后续查看修改、同步和交付也在同一个任务里完成，各仓库的结果分别展示。 接手已有工作也不用从头开始。创建 Workspace 时，每个仓库可以分别新建分支，或者选一个已有的本地或远端分支继续做。分支列表可以搜索，已经被其他 worktree 占用的本地分支会标出来，避免选错工作目录。前端从 main 开始，后端接着已有 feature 开发，也可以放进同一个 Workspace。 还有 monorepo：一个仓库里放了很多项目，我可能只关心其中几个目录。Treefold 可以把这些子目录设为工作入口，也可以加入外部资料目录，方便 Agent 找到相关上下文。目录选择帮助组织工作，Git worktree 仍然以整个仓库为单位。 需要换回熟悉的工具时，Open With 可以直接在 IDE、终端或 Finder 中打开当前目录，也能一键复制路径。选中了哪个任务，就打开它对应的工作目录。 保留终端习惯，少记几个快捷键 我日常主要用 Agent 的 CLI 和 TUI，所以 Treefold 里的 Agent 也是原来的终端界面。目前支持 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Pi，也可以单独开 Shell 跑命令。终端使用 xterm.js。 Agent 使用本机安装的 CLI，沿用自己的登录和模型配置。喜欢哪个就用哪个，同一项任务里也可以开不同的 Agent Session。使用前先确认相应 CLI 在终端里能正常运行；没有配置 Agent，也可以先用 Shell。 我喜欢 Command Palette，但不想记一大堆快捷键。所以默认只给少数高频操作绑定快捷键，其他操作从 Palette 找，也可以按自己的习惯修改绑定。 这里我比较在意上下文：在某个 Fork 里打开 Palette，新建 Session、开始 AI Review 或打开目录，就应该接着使用这个 Fork 的上下文，不用重新选一遍。 免费开源，本地运行 Treefold 免费开源，使用 AGPL-3.0-only 许可证。App 在本机运行，项目状态、任务、Session 元数据和配置保存在自己的电脑上，核心管理功能不依赖云端服务。 Agent 沿用你自己的模型和服务配置，模型调用、网络访问和费用由对应服务及配置决定。目前支持 Apple Silicon Mac，需要 macOS 14 或更新版本。

projects.title: SlickTrip MCP
projects.summary: Ask ChatGPT or Claude for flights, hotels or seats in plain words, and real prices come back as cards right in the chat. Say "watch it" and SlickTrip keeps watching after the chat ends, then alerts you by email, text or push when the price drops or the seat you want opens up. No dates yet? Pick a route and the months you could go, and we tell you when a good fare shows up. 35 travel tools, free account. 20,000 people joined in the first two weeks, and it hit #1 trending connector on Claude.

projects.title: Transit
projects.summary: 🚇 Turn distributed traces, GitHub Actions runs, and coding-agent sessions into animated NYC-subway-style maps: GIF, MP4, or an interactive page you can drop in Slack. Fully local, no telemetry. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

projects.title: Waydo
projects.summary: Plan a road trip day by day: add stops, get distance and drive time for each leg, hotels near every overnight stop and attractions along the way. Free for trips up to 3 days. Premium adds unlimited days, link sharing, PNG export and an MCP server.

projects.title: Feedbacks
projects.summary: Make website feedback easy for clients. They point, annotate and comment; your developer team and its AI agents get the same screenshots, exact text requests and replay context. Keep the conversation with the work. Free, Apache-2.0 and self-hosted. Start with one Docker command.

projects.title: Builder Guides by B Scanned
projects.summary: A one-person studio's working notes from shipping real iOS and Android apps, client sites, payments and automations with Claude Code. An App Store and Google Play launch playbook, 105 prompts that actually shipped work, 228 silent-failure fixes (symptom, cause, fix, prevention) and 7 drop-in Claude Code skills. Each guide on its own or all of it in the Builder Bundle.

projects.title: Deep Code
projects.summary: Deep Code is an open-source AI coding assistant tool deeply optimized for DeepSeek, It supports deep thinking, reasoning effort control, Agent Skills, and MCP integration.It has already gained 2,000 stars on GitHub.It recently launched a Coding Plan, with pricing as low as $9.9/month.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Codex Co²：让多人共享同一个 Codex 会话，一起推进工作
projects.author: SpaceCoder-Kafka
projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个开源项目 「Codex Co²」（ ）: 让多人共享同一个 Codex 会话，一起推进工作。 解决的痛点是，Codex 官方虽然也提供了会话分享功能，但只可以把只读的历史快照发给别人。但如果对方看完后想继续追问、补充信息，或让 Agent 接着排查的话，就满足不了，需要一种能持续交互的协作方式。 Codex Co² 通过生成邀请链接，让一方得以在官方 Codex Desktop 中继续工作，另外几方则可以通过浏览器加入所选会话，查看已有上下文，并向同一个 Agent 发送消息、跟进后续结果。 一个典型场景就是运营与研发的接力排障： 运营先让 Codex 分析用户反馈的日志，得到初步结论，再将这条会话分享给研发。研发加入后，可以直接查看前面的日志分析过程，补充代码背景、追问可疑线索，让 Agent 继续定位问题。运营也能在同一条会话中补充用户信息、跟进排查进展。 主要特点： 共享持续进行的会话：加入后可以继续交互，后续消息与 Agent 回复持续同步。 协作者只需浏览器：打开邀请，经分享者批准后加入，无需安装应用。 由分享者控制范围：只共享选中的会话，可移除成员、结束共享，也可开启逐条消息审批；原生工具审批仍在分享者的 Desktop 中处理。 中文演示视频

projects.title: Mailsort
projects.summary: Sort your Gmail and Yahoo inbox with a free extension. No agent, no server.

github.name: Sorsa-io/sorsa-mcp
github.description: An MCP server for the Sorsa.io API v3 — access to X/Twitter data: profiles, tweets, search, follow/retweet checks, Sorsa scores, lists and communities.

projects.summary: 文档： 开源 MCP 服务： 这是一次来自产品方的工具自荐。Sorsa API 提供公开 X（Twitter）数据的只读 REST 接口，包括用户资料、帖子、搜索、关注者与关注列表、列表、社区及互动验证，可用于数据分析、研究和 AI 应用。 使用一个 Sorsa API Key 即可接入，无需提供 X 账号密码或 Cookie，也不需要 X 开发者账号。提供在线 API Playground、OpenAPI 描述文件，以及可在 Cursor、Claude Desktop 等客户端使用的 MCP 服务。 新用户可试用 100 次请求，无需信用卡；更多用量需付费。服务不支持发帖、私信或读取私密账号内容。Sorsa API 是独立服务，与 X Corp. 无隶属关系。

projects.title: AgentReady
projects.summary: AgentReady is a vendor-neutral, open specification for making websites and products usable by AI agents. It covers discoverability, machine-readable content, authentication, APIs, MCP, WebMCP, and agent payments, with practices grounded in research on real agent behavior.

projects.title: [开源推荐] 连镜：在无限画布上编排 AI 图片、视频和音频的生成流程
projects.author: zaylora

github.name: zaylora/video-canvas
github.description: 连镜：开源 AI 视频创作工作台：用无限画布连接图片、视频和音频生成流程，支持多模型、AI Agent 和私有部署。

projects.summary: 连镜把 AI 视觉创作从一次性的对话框搬到无限画布：文本、图片、视频、音频作为节点互相连线，上游产物直接成为下游的参考素材，首帧、镜头和成片可以在同一条流程里反复调整。支持接入多家模型供应商，可 Docker 私有部署 亮点 画布式工作流：每次生成的产物都留在图上，改上游即重跑下游，不再是排队等一次结果 3D 导演台：用人台、道具和多机位搭构图，导出机位首帧和视频回填画布 画布 Agent：用对话创建、编辑、排列节点，改动可撤销，可导入技能包 插件化模型接入：每家供应商协议是一个 JS 插件，跑在隔离进程里；内置 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、豆包、阿里百炼、可灵、即梦、Vidu、海螺、Sora，也支持上传自定义插件 完整的自建能力：渠道与模型校验、积分结算、支付、使用记录与审计，密钥加密保存、只写不读 素材存储可切换：本地磁盘，或把阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、AWS S3、Cloudflare R2 设为默认存储 Go + React，Docker 一条命令部署，MIT 协议

projects.title: Bits
projects.summary: Bits is a personal agent that runs on your own machine and never sleeps. A small background daemon does the work: routines wake it on a schedule, and tasks keep going when the app is closed. Every step is saved, so a crash just resumes. Memory lives in plain Markdown files you can read and edit. Risky actions pass the Sentinel, a reviewer that only trusts your own words. It answers with live cards and mini-apps, talks by voice, opens with ⌥Space, and works with any model, including local ones.

projects.title: Show HN: QAmcp – Automated test runner for MCP servers in your terminal
projects.author: Abhiramreddykal

projects.title: Talk Kit
projects.summary: Voice AI widget for any website. Answers visitor questions out loud, books appointments, takes payments, and live-transfers qualified leads to your sales team. Installed with one line of code, configured entirely through the Talk Kit MCP by AI coding agents like Claude Code.

projects.title: ClientCoded
projects.summary: Most agent testing either traces failures after customers hit them, or makes you hand-write every test and let an LLM guess if it passed. ClientCoded generates adversarial tests and knows the correct answer, scoring against computed ground truth with SQL, not opinion. It catches failures before production, monitors every live conversation with Slack alerts, and turns real production failures into new regression tests automatically. Connect in minutes with one webhook. First audit free.

projects.title: Doop AI Studio
projects.summary: Doop AI Studio brings AI image and video generation into one developer-friendly platform. Generate cinematic videos with Veo 2 and high-quality images with Nano Banana 2.1 through a web studio, API, and MCP integrations.

projects.title: Ramorie
projects.summary: Ramorie gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP-compatible agents persistent project memory. Save decisions and bug fixes, retrieve them in later sessions, and inspect saved context with semantic search and a knowledge graph. Memory stays on your Mac; external AI usage is separate. Desktop is free until April 2027, with no account or card required. A paid license is planned afterward. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon and Intel.

projects.title: datatomcp
projects.summary: Upload a CSV or pick a Google Sheet, and Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can filter, group and total the rows. The numbers come from a database, not from the model's guess, and every answer says which version of the data it used. An import report flags messy data first. Same data over a REST API for n8n or Make. OAuth sign-in, read-only, hosted in the EU. Free for 3 datasets of 100,000 rows.

projects.title: RepoGraph AI
projects.summary: RepoGraph AI turns any repository into an AI coding-agent graph — a free VS Code extension. Open a folder: it auto-indexes every file and import into an interactive dependency graph (2D + 3D sphere), tagging each edge EXTRACTED, INFERRED or AMBIGUOUS so you know what to trust. Communities, flow diagrams and Q&A with citations work offline with zero API keys; connect Groq, Ollama, Gemini, Claude or OpenAI for AI summaries, and export REPOGRAPH-CONTEXT.md to ground agents in your real graph.

projects.title: AtlasMCP: MCP Server for WordPress
projects.summary: AtlasMCP lets Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Cursor work directly on your WordPress site, so you can stop copy-pasting between chat and wp-admin. Just ask: “draft a post with a featured image”, “which products are low on stock?”, “fix the alt text on my last 20 images”. Connect in one click, choose exactly what the AI can touch, and see everything it did. Works with the plugins you already use, including WooCommerce.

projects.title: AgentRaaS
projects.summary: New since the first launch: self-hosted Team features are free with no license key (approvals, SSO, spend-cap holds). Approve risky actions from Slack, Teams, Telegram, Discord, email or the dashboard. Daily money caps and allowed hours per agent, undo for refunds and messages, a one-command install on Linux, macOS and Windows, `agentraas scan` to check an MCP server before you connect it, and keys that can stay in your own Vault or cloud KMS.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】NovAI：一个 OpenAI 兼容入口调用 DeepSeek/Qwen/GLM/Kimi 等 111 个中国模型，官方直连不加价，有免费层
projects.author: vvvvking
projects.summary: 是什么 NovAI 是一个 OpenAI 兼容的中国模型 API 入口：一个 baseurl + 一个 key，调用 DeepSeek、Qwen（通义）、GLM（智谱）、Kimi（月之暗面）、MiniMax、Doubao（豆包）、Hunyuan（混元）等 111 个模型（含文本、图像、视频），端点： baseurl = 任何 OpenAI SDK / 工具都能直接用：Cline、Continue、Aider、Cherry Studio、OpenClaw、LangChain 等，改 baseurl 和模型名即可。另有远程 MCP 端点 cheapestmodels / modelprice / listcategories 三个工具）。 为什么可能值得一看 官方直连、不加价：走各家的官方 API，倍率固定 1.0（按官方列表价透传，不按人民币换算加价二次加价）。价格单可在 /transparency.json 和 /china-ai-leaderboard.json 机器读取核对。 免费层是真的免费：5 个通义/智谱的 Flash 模型（glm-4.7-flash、glm-4.1v-thinking-flash、glm-4.6v-flash、cogview-3-flash、cogvideox-flash），10 次/天、5 次/分，不需要信用卡、不需要手机号；视频 5 次/天。 一个端点同时出文/图/视频：豆包 Seedream（图）和 Seedance（视频）也在同一套 key 下。 一条 curl 试 bash curl \ H "Authorization: Bearer $NOVAIAPIKEY" \ H "Content-Type: application/json" \ d '{"model":"glm-4.7-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"你好"}]}' 免费 key 在 领取（不用卡）。

projects.title: TranscribeX
projects.summary: TranscribeX records and transcribes Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Slack and Discord calls directly on your Mac. No bot joins and nothing is uploaded. Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet, Nemotron and Qwen3 run on-device, with speaker labels, live captions in 30+ languages and AI summaries from a built-in local LLM. It also transcribes any audio or video file, dictates into any app, and has a CLI and MCP server. Free with unlimited transcription; Pro is $39 once, no subscription.

projects.title: Dejavue
projects.summary: A Discord bot for help channels. When someone asks a question that was already solved, it replies with the past answer, plus an AI-drafted reply on paid plans, before a mod has to. Solved threads are tagged, archived and searchable in Discord, and can publish to a public FAQ site Google can index (opt-in, usernames aliased). Pro and Max expose the archive as an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. Semantic search on every tier, free plan included. Open source and self-hostable.

projects.title: Show HN: A better hosted MCP server for QBO and Xero
projects.author: wdaher

projects.title: A²D — Agentic Asset Designer
projects.summary: A²D is a design-first platform for MCP mocking, API mocking, and agent mocking. Design, mock, validate, and test MCP server specs and A2A agent cards before the real backend exists — then publish to Anypoint Exchange. No code required.

projects.title: ChatterEase - AI Customer Support Agent
projects.summary: ChatterEase is an affordable AI customer support agent for startups and small businesses. Add one widget to your site to answer customer questions 24/7, capture leads, cite sources, and hand conversations to a human when needed. Train it on your website, docs, and custom Q&As, customize it to your brand, and launch in minutes on WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, or any site. Supports 50+ languages, analytics, auto-retraining, webhooks, and API access.

projects.title: Developer OS
projects.summary: Claude Code forgets everything between sessions, and its defaults are not a careful engineer's habits. developer-os is a free, MIT-licensed plugin that fixes both. Your agent searches an Obsidian vault before work and captures decisions into its inbox while it works; you approve what stays. Rules load in every session, skills cover specs, reviews, audits and PRs, and hooks ask before installs or force pushes. Plain Markdown, no server, no telemetry.

projects.title: BrightSite
projects.summary: BrightSite is a website builder and host that your AI agent can run. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client with one URL and get nearly 300 tools. Ask for a page, a form, a product, or a fix and it lands as a draft under your own permissions. Lumi is built in with no credits. Every plan includes a store, website chat, email campaigns, forms, analytics, and SEO tracking. Unlimited team members. From $29/mo per site, 7 days free, no card.

projects.title: FreeQrly
projects.summary: FreeQrly is a free, privacy-first QR code generator. Static QR codes are generated 100% in the browser — no sign-up, no tracking, no expiry. 16 content types (URL, text, WiFi, vCard, email, SMS, event, Bitcoin, coupons, app links, reviews, MP3, forms, menus & more), batch mode, barcode generator, QR scanner. Unlimited dynamic codes with scan stats, editable after printing — limited-time offer. 10 languages. Free API + MCP server for AI agents. Independent project, not affiliated with FreeQR.

projects.title: Aerini
projects.summary: Aerini is an open source, local-first visual workflow engine. Wire nodes on a canvas and run them by hand, on a schedule, or from a webhook, on your machine or on a headless server. No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Extend it with sandboxed WASM plugins, or let AI agents like Claude Code build workflows through the separate aerini-mcp server. Pre-1.0 and still in development, so expect rough edges.

projects.title: Searchtok
projects.summary: SearchTok makes TikTok and Instagram searchable for your AI agent. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code with one URL and ask what's working in your niche. It finds the outlier posts (ranked by how far they beat their account's usual views), quotes their hooks word for word, and shows the creators behind them. Built for founders, marketers, creators and small agencies.

projects.title: The Brains
projects.summary: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

projects.title: Convert.Online API & MCP Server
projects.summary: Convert.Online started as a plain file converter and still is one, across 400+ formats. What's new: an MCP server, so Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini can convert files directly in a conversation, and a REST API with chained jobs, webhooks and a sandbox mode. Also added since the last launch — OCR that makes scanned PDFs searchable in 17 languages, and imports straight from Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive.

projects.title: ARGUSX
projects.summary: Track AI infrastructure spending, debt, leases and cash flow with dated sources. Explore the research on the web or query it in Codex and Claude Code with an open-source skill. English and Chinese. No ARGUS API key needed.

projects.title: Agent C
projects.summary: Upload your app's real screenshots and Agent C designs the full App Store set in about a second: headlines, layouts, 3D device tilt and colors from your app. Edit anything, export at exact App Store Connect sizes, or send it straight into your app's draft version. Also works from Claude Code, Cursor and Codex over MCP. Free to design, $9.99 per finished set, no subscription.

projects.title: hdtp-gateway
projects.summary: An open-source, self-hosted node that gives your AI agent an address other people's agents can reach. Two people, two nodes, nothing in between: MCP over mTLS, messages sealed end to end, and a per-contact switchboard that decides what each contact may do. projects.author: norvalbv
projects.summary: What’s up HN?! I'm Benji, and I’ve been building Frink since ~April this year. Frink is a desktop-first, open-source (MIT) app for running coding agents in parallel and multi-step workflows that start on their own. It runs on your machine (macOS and Linux) with your own provider login. It currently supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and OpenCode, but the latter 3 are in preview. No Frink account to use the app. The biggest USP of Frink is workflows: think n8n for agents. You describe a routine in a sentence, for example: "every weekday at 9am, run the tests; if any fail, have an agent fix them, then wait for my approval before it opens a PR." Then, Frink builds it as a workflow (or simply, Flow): a list of steps you can read and change before it runs. A Flow can start on a schedule, from any webhook, or from an event from a third-party such as Linear, Shortcut, ClickUp, Sentry, PostHog, etc. Steps can be agent turns, shell commands, conditions, approval steps that stop and wait for you, or steps you write yourself in code (or ask the agent to write one). Everything that needs you (an approval, an agent's question, a finished task to review) lands in one Work Queue. Other stuff: * Up to four agents side by side, each on its own git worktree if you want. Or, many agents out of direct view. * Every change shows as a diff; there's a code editor, a terminal, etc. * Local-first: chats, Flows and tasks live in SQLite on your machine. * Easier provider parity: currently working on and improving the tooling setup between providers. Once inside Frink, irrespective of what provider you use, the hooks, MCPs, and other tooling work out of the box between providers. Why I built it: I started building it when there weren’t many other competitors; now the industry is swamped with ADEs and harnesses. However, in my opinion, each still lacks good automation for more fine-tuned scenarios. I doubled down on the flows to help me with my actual day-to-day job as a SWE, and over time it’s helped me automate most of the PRs being shipped across my personal projects, team, etc., to the point that it’s a continuous loop and helps a whole ton. Notes: Windows isn't supported yet. Flows only run on Claude Code and Codex for now. It's a solo project, so expect sharp edges.

projects.title: Show HN: Peras – Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your weekly limit
projects.author: vertias3u
projects.summary: Hello HN! Today I am presenting you with Peras, the tool which governs your Claude Code and Codex usage, and enforces limits. I built it because I got tired of constantly having to spam /usage to check my usage, and decide if a task is worth risking the agent running out mid-task. Peras enforces a limit with 2 main tiers. At 75% weekly usage you will get a notification, and at 90% Peras will automatically pause the agent. These limits are the default and they are customizable to your own liking. You may ask "how does it know my usage in Claude Code or Codex?" Well, it's pretty simple. Peras gets the Claude Code usage % from the status line, and Codex's one comes from its local app-server. The "pause" Peras executes is a hook that refuses the agent's tool calls and ends its turn. A new feature I implemented is one that makes agents aware of their own usage. When you send your prompt, Peras attaches the usage %. It sends it at the start of the session, then again at 50, 75, 90 and 100%, or if a reset is coming in 30 minutes, so the agent can hurry up and actually capitalize on the remaining usage, if any. Just to clarify, this feature is informational and the pause is what enforces the limit. Before I switched to native SwiftUI, I used SwiftBar. The problem was that for the mascots patrolling their usage bars, I had to re-encode every menu image 8 times a second! There was also stuff SwiftBar wasn't capable of, like the menu being able to appear over fullscreen apps, pinning it as a floating panel, etc. What is the difference between the free and paid version? Well, it is MIT, first of all. The CLI, the hooks, the SwiftBar menu, and the app's source are all on GitHub, but building the app needs macOS 13+, Node 18+, "xcode-select --install" and then finally "npm run build:app". The €4.99 buys you a signed copy which is notarized by Apple, with updates included. The guard works with no menu at all. To install, just run: npx peras-cli setup npx peras-cli codex setup And now we get to the limits part. For now it's subscription plans only, and when running "claude -p", the pause uses the last interactive reading, so it can come late. Also I feel I have to mention that the guard rail is not a security boundary. It runs inside the agent. The menu is macOS only. The CLI and hooks pass tests on Linux in CI, but I don't use them there day-to-day. Last thing before I end this post, I would really appreciate feedback from you, whether install worked for Codex users, whether you have encountered any bugs, or whatever you feel like sharing.

projects.title: Show HN: Gauge CLI – Open-Source Hillclimbing for Agent Experience
projects.author: 0x63_Problems

github.name: gauge-sh/gauge-cli
github.description: :dog: The open-source Gauge CLI. Hillclimb your Skills, CLI, SDK, MCP, API, or Docs to make something agents want.

projects.summary: Hi HN! We're releasing an open-source CLI for hillclimbing Agent Experience. That means optimizing your agent-facing surfaces (Skills, CLIs, SDKs, and docs) so that your users' coding agents can easily use your product. Pointing your own agent at the repo is enough to get started. https://github.com/gauge-sh/gauge-cli We've found that power users generally want to hand a CLI/MCP to their agents and get started from the terminal. They rarely want to log in and use the web UI themselves. We think developer tools must be agent-friendly to remain relevant. Here are some common findings that Gauge identifies: - agents get confused with CLI/SDK behavior and start source diving - interactive commands block agents - agents use deprecated/old CLI commands - agents don't use Skills when you'd expect - agents confidently assert limitations that don't exist - inconsistent terminology confuses agents - agents can't figure out how commands fit together into a workflow Locally, the Gauge CLI uses Docker containers to run agent harnesses (you can bring your own subscriptions). It finds where agents get confused or stuck and tests changes using your pre-release artifacts (Skills/CLI etc). We normalize events from Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode into standardized transcripts, and store them locally, alongside structured information in SQLite so that your agent can easily analyze the data. This enables automatic hillclimbing toward a great Agent Experience. We also offer hosted compute that enables more features, built on our custom Gateway (for credential brokering and transparent, per-session response rewriting). Hosted compute enables many more concurrent sessions, easier collaboration with teammates, a GitHub App for PR reviews, sessions with logged-in MCPs/APIs, and most importantly it lets you close your laptop while the sessions actually run. You don't need a Gauge account to run the full loop end-to-end though. We expect that local execution with the CLI is enough to find and fix several agent experience issues in a typical project. You'll be able to validate fixes for these issues locally, before publishing new versions (we inject pre-release Skills and code artifacts into the sessions). We would love your feedback!

projects.title: Show HN: Tori by TalkJS. AI support that's actually good
projects.author: skrebbel
projects.summary: Hey everyone! Joshua and Egbert from TalkJS here. Today we're launching Tori, an AI support agent built for difficult product questions. Other tools we tried struggled with the technical questions we get at TalkJS, so we built our own. One of our test questions was: "How can I add two-way sync between TalkJS and my Minecraft mod?" Our docs never mention Minecraft, and TalkJS does not have a Java SDK. Tori figured out how a Java Edition mod could use Kotlin, found our Kotlin Data API even though it isn't mentioned on the homepage, and explained step-by-step how to connect the two. It avoided the obvious solution of REST + webhooks, and explained why that would be insecure in a clientside mod. That's what it means for support to actually be good. Understand what customers are trying to build, research the features and limitations, and work out how they fit together. Tori works great even when no single page contains the answer. Tori browses your live website and documentation, no retraining step. We've been using it for TalkJS support over the past few months, and it handles 87% of our customer enquiries autonomously. Customers can ask for a human at any point, and you can always see what Tori is telling them and what it thinks. So your team can jump in and work alongside Tori, with the conversation and research already there. Our goal is for your customers to get good help faster, with human support always in reach. Tori is built on TalkJS, whose infrastructure handles 130M+ monthly messages. The TalkJS base means you can fully customize the interface's components, layout and behavior to fit your product. You also get direct access to senior Tori developers for free, including help with customization. We're launching early so customers can help shape the product. Have a go at https://asktori.ai . We're curious what you think!

projects.title: Show HN: Pando, what to do with vibe coded apps at work

projects.summary: Since AI has grown in popularity, technical and non-technical employees have been using it to build small tools and apps to boost productivity and model prototypes. Some companies like Ramp and Stripe, are building their own internal platform for this. That’s great for them, but not every company can, or has the bandwidth to do that. Pando is a similar idea, but fully open-source. It provides a home for these apps and tools that people build, so they get put in a centralized place with a clear owner. Apps are automatically put behind company SSO, scanned for vulnerabilities, isolated, and easily shareable. You can also put egress controls on them, and control how many apps people can deploy. projects.title: 标题：carquet：纯 C11 实现的 Apache Parquet 读写库，比 Arrow C++ 更小更快
projects.author: Vitruves
projects.summary: carquet 是一个纯 C11 编写的 Apache Parquet 读写库，不依赖 Arrow。整个库约 500 KB，只用到 zstd、zlib、lz4、brotli 四个依赖（CMake 找不到时会自动下载编译），一分钟内即可构建完成。它完整支持 Parquet 的物理类型、编码方式、嵌套结构、统计信息、布隆过滤器和页索引，写出的文件可以被 PyArrow、DuckDB、Spark 直接读取；通过 Arrow C Data Interface，也能与 Arrow 生态零依赖互通。 在 Apple M3 上对 1000 万行数据的基准测试中，carquet 写入压缩文件的速度是 Arrow C++ 的 1.8–5.7 倍，读取同一个文件快 1.3–2.1 倍；未压缩数据走 mmap 零拷贝路径，读取 1000 万行只需 0.36 毫秒。读写路径都针对 x86（SSE、AVX2、AVX-512）和 ARM（NEON、SVE）做了 SIMD 优化，并在运行时自动选择。 除了 C API，它还自带一个命令行工具（查看 schema、统计信息、按条件过滤行、生成 C 读取代码），提供 Python 包 pip install carquet（底层仍是这份 C 代码，通过 Arrow 与 PyArrow 零拷贝交换数据），以及一份给 Claude Code / Codex 等编程助手使用的 Agent Skill，帮助把库接入已有项目。MIT 协议。 图片：

projects.summary: 前阵子让 muse 整理云资产，发现早年藏箱子底的项目 `https://www.ifolo.cn` 和辛苦拿下的 ICP 备案号一直在吃灰,还有 claude 的 tokens,索性拯救了一下尸山代码,搓了一个 macOS 侧边栏笔记：iFolo Note.按我自己使用习惯来的,大家可酌情使用,可提提意见!免费,免费,免费! ### 为什么要造这个轮子？ 每天面对 IDE 和 多 Agent 终端，我在 Mac 上随手记东西一直很割裂： * **重型软件太重**：只是想临时贴段 JSON 、记行命令或闪念，用 Notion 、Obsidian 甚至系统备忘录都得 `Cmd + Tab` 切窗口，打断思路。 * **桌面便签太乱**：贴多了像牛皮癣，过后根本找不到。 我想要的只是一个**平时完全隐形、需要时从屏幕边缘一秒滑出、写完立刻缩回去,AI 时代还支持可控 mcp**的轻量容器。 ### 核心特点 1. **无感边缘呼出**：常驻屏幕侧边，鼠标贴边或快捷键秒开。全屏写代码、开会时随叫随到，不抢焦点，用完即走。 2. **原生丝滑体验**：拒绝套壳卡顿，深度优化了滑出帧率与输入延迟，后台常驻几乎零感。 3. **Markdown 混排直出**：代码片段、Todo 、临时链接所见即所得，无需在源码和预览模式间反复横跳。 4. **不只是临时草稿**：支持双链与标签整理，纯本地 Markdown 存储,目前还没做云端同步、s 5. 3 同步啥的，Mac 侧边栏记下的碎片灵感，随时能在 iOS 端继续整理，数据完全自主。 --- ![1792413680626.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad60ff81f2e3.webp) ![1792413938920.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad61104628ca.webp) ![1792413857126.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad611192ceb9.webp) ![1792413927750.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad611198bb42.webp) ![1792413912991.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad61119879aa.webp) 目前 Macos 端已稳定,后期计划 windows 端，欢迎大家体验,免费、免费!： 👉 **官网**： https://www.ifolo.cn

github.name: finereli/yarareads
github.description: A free reading app for kids who just learned their phonics sounds: every word in a story can be sounded out, tap a word for its sounds. Bring your own agent (MCP). Cloudflare Workers.

projects.summary: My kid is 6 y/o and she is learning to read. She's moved through the basic phonics with Teach Your Monster to Read but was struggling with how repetitive it was. I wanted to give her some stories to read, but she still needed help sounding words out - and I wanted her to have the experience of sitting and reading by herself. So I built this book reader app to allow her to click on the words, sound out the phonemes, and read by herself. My 12 year old son wrote the first story, there's a cliffhanger at the end and he's working on the next section. We're going to release more chapters and more stories in the near future. And there's one other thing - The reader has an MCP connection, so you can connect your Claude or ChatGPT or Grok, give them a PDF of a book you like (or even a set of scans done quickly with a phone camera) and have them import your favorite books into the app (private to your account, for your own kid, if you own the book of course). The reader is free to use on its website and open source if you want to tinker and create your own version. The included stories are under Creative Commons.

projects.title: Show HN: PatchWave - Add static analysis and automerge to Dependabot
projects.author: blimmer
projects.summary: Hey Hacker News, we're Ben, Josh, and Donnie, co-founders of PatchWave. PatchWave is a GitHub App that combines static analysis and eval'ed agents to analyze and (optionally) auto-merge PRs it deems as safe. If a Dependabot PR breaks your CI build, a fix agent works to get CI passing again. Dependabot PRs suck. Nobody likes dealing with them. Most of the time they go ignored or a senior engineer spends their valuable time dealing with them. Before PatchWave, I ran a freelance business charging clients hourly to do exactly this kind of "keep the lights on" work. Even at our small startup, we'd spend Monday mornings dealing with Dependabot PRs. Having a human-in-the-loop working with an agent on these PRs was time consuming and, often, agents would get lazy and not actually validate how an upstream change affected the codebase. And, as the quantity and severity of CVEs increases, merging security updates quickly becomes increasingly important. PatchWave is a set of specialized agents that uses static analysis tools on context we gather deterministically. 1. We pull the changelog, the code diff between versions, security advisories, and CI results. 2. The agent checks out your code in an isolated sandbox, where it uses structural code search, type checkers and your project's own toolchain to understand how your codebase uses each dependency being updated. Every Dependabot PR gets a report. You can see a few examples (against OSS repos) here: https://reports.patchwave.ai/alam00000/bentopdf/pull/913 and https://reports.patchwave.ai/shipshapecode/shepherd/pull/355... 3. If CI fails, we automatically dispatch a fix agent to try to get CI green again. For most PRs, this means updating your code to use a newer API, fixing linting/formatting issues, etc. 4. We have an optional feature that allows auto-merging certain PRs when PatchWave deems them as safe and the PR aligns with your auto-merge policy. Our recommended auto-merge policy is to auto-merge patch/minor/major dev dependencies and patch/minor production dependencies. You can customize this policy or turn auto-merge off entirely. PatchWave will skip auto-merge in a bunch of cases where a human should review. For instance, if provenance changes (e.g., a package that's usually published by GitHub Actions via Trusted Publishing is suddenly published by an API Key), we require human review before merging. Dependabot also instituted an on-by-default 3-day cooldown to reduce the risk of supply chain attacks. If PatchWave makes any changes via a fix agent, we'll always require your review before merge. Currently, PatchWave only works with Dependabot and GitHub. We plan to offer Renovate support in the future. We've eval'ed the agents the most against TypeScript and Ruby, but are always adding to our eval suite to improve accuracy. The fix agent works best with PRs that require modest code changes. For large updates, especially updates that span multiple majors, our fix agent will give up and provide you a remediation plan to help you mitigate. On the privacy/security side of the house, our SOC 2 Type II audit is in progress (see trust.contextbridge.ai). We only run on repos you select, our agents run in a short-lived microVM per run, we use Amazon Bedrock with zero-data-retention, and never train on your code. We're offering 25 free PRs per GitHub org, per month with no credit card required. Additional PRs are billed at about $1/PR, with discounts for higher volume. We also would love to accelerate OSS projects, so reach out to ask about additional free credits. If you hate dealing with Dependabot PRs, we'd love for you to give it a shot and tell us what you think. Josh, Donnie, and I will be around answering any questions and responding to any feedback you have.

projects.title: Show HN: Stop Claude Code from compacting mid-task
projects.author: LippInc
projects.summary: I run long sessions with Claude. For a long time I've had Claude in the middle of some difficult coding task, and then I see the auto-compact message pop up. Every time I wonder if Claude actually picks everything up correctly and nothing is lost. Claude told me 78/82 auto-compactions landed while Claude was working. For a while I couldn't do much. At first I made a skill that would make Claude explicitly save progress throughout long runs. But that didn't fix the core problem and cost more tokens as well. Now that mods came out, I fixed the actual problem. catnap tells Claude at 50% context what the context is and that it should finish what it's working on, write a handoff, and then initialize compaction itself. When Claude finishes its task, catnap compacts, and Claude can then pick up work again. The handoff replaces Claude Code's default summary, so we don't do similar work twice. If Claude for some reason doesn't compact before 60%, it gets a stricter note. And Claude Code's default auto-compact kicks in at 70% as a backstop. The 3 numbers are all settings. After I took on catnap, 0 of 129 naps came mid-task: 98 of them in benchmarks and 31 in my own sessions. The cost is the same as the default auto-compact kicking in at the same point, in tokens and dollars, on 200K and 1M context windows. Compared to the default auto-compaction that kicks in when context is nearly full, catnap used 56% fewer tokens. But lowering the default auto-compact will get you most of the way there as well. I measured memory today as well. Claude worked through tasks one message at a time while 20 instructions and facts were said in the chat, inside long chatty messages, and nowhere else. Asked right after compaction to list them from memory, no file reads: all 20 were listed with catnap and with the default compaction, in every run (15 with catnap, 5 with the default). So in my tests the memory was exactly the same, but catnap got there with a handoff 60% shorter (4.0K tokens against 10K). I was surprised that catnap is actually faster than the default option. This wasn't even one of the reasons I wanted to make this, it just happened. Since Claude writes the handoff in one go instead of the separate summary call the default makes, and the note is shorter, tasks finish sooner: measured end to end, 406 seconds instead of 464. Try it with nothing installed: npx github:LippInc/catnap It prints how often auto-compact cut in mid-task in your own logs (reads numbers only, sends nothing). Install (needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later, where mods are on by default): claude plugin marketplace add LippInc/catnap claude plugin install catnap@lippinc Currently Claude Code only, tested on Windows and Linux. The memory test used made-up coding tasks on a 200K window. Some related tools: compact-adviser, handoff-compact, session-pilot and sub-agent-compact. What catnap adds: Claude finishes its piece first, and the numbers on where the cut lands.

projects.title: Jev 做 arXiv 大规模文献检索综述， 5 分钟筛 36,000 篇论文
projects.author: Zilize
projects.summary: ## 设计动机 人工智能领域的论文进入爆发式增长，数量越来越多，文献检索也面临着很大的挑战。我个人在使用 General/Coding Agent 进行文献检索（寻找相关工作或者领域梳理）的时能体验到的局限性： 1. 通用 agent 通过黑盒 web search api 进行开放网络检索，通常只能拿到 top-k ，难以穷举并且难以回答“这里领域有多少篇论文”的问题； 2. 通用 agent 通过 search api 进行的检索噪音大，返回的内容是整个互联网的相关性条目，需要花费额外的开销进行数据清洗和整理； 上述局限性导致 agent 在查找文献的时候浅尝辄止，或者开销大/速度慢。所以在上半年的时候我给自己 vibe coding 了一套 arXiv 元数据抓取->向量化->关键词或语义召回->LLM 精筛的管线。但成本仍然比较高，并且精筛时候速度很慢，用起来不怎么顺手。 九月中旬的时候 Jev 横空出世，我意识到非常适合用来做召回后的文献精筛和分类，于是就开始重构自己的文献基础设施，把它迁移到 Jev 上来。可以先通过一张 GIF 示意图感受精筛的速度： ![]( https://parallax-open.oss-cn-hongkong.aliyuncs.com/v2ex/26/26c91fee54ce38fef5e65ca4d9751019ea7995810858a46e09587d864c4d1c3f.gif) 我把这个系统命名为 Parallax ，其实它不止是一个文献检索工具，还包括了一系列的论文阅读、综述产出工作流。项目已投入生产环境，欢迎注册试用： https://parallax.ink 下面将继续介绍系统搭建时的一些设计和感悟。 ## 检索结构 曾过一段时间的推荐算法但没太接触过 Agentic Search 领域，还带着点相关的思维定势，所以最初的设想是通过一个漏斗式的结构完成召回、粗筛、精筛。后来发现论文检索的特点跟信息流推荐还很不一样： - 需要扩增：论文存在引用关系，通过一篇早期文章的引用关系进行扩增检索是很常见的手段 - 需要补充：不管是人还是 Agent 进行检索的过程都会有疏漏的可能，所以在初次检索完成后还要进行复核，看看是否有不合适的条目被纳入，或者是否有早些关注到的标记点被遗漏 这样的话漏斗式的检索显然就不够用了，结合多路召回所需的合并去重、假阳性需要批量剔除，我发现集合运算是解决这个问题的良好数据结构，因此就将整套检索的底层架构用集合代数的接口重写了一遍。 因此检索结构设计为：Agentic 操作的基本单元是论文集合（满足确定性、互异性、无序性的基本属性），支持并集、差集等基本的集合运算符；同时引入了一些实用的功能性对象或算子： - 虚拟根：用一个虚拟对象表示检索起点，比如全库论文集合、arXiv 每日公告的论文集合；使用虚拟根是为了避免对大规模条目进行持久化，占用过多存储空间 - 规则过滤：通过 arXiv 分类标签、时间窗口、资源种类、embedding 相似度、关键词检索等条件进行论文条目过滤 - AI 精筛：利用 Jev/LLM 进行条件判定，条件是由 agent 根据用户意图生成的 - AI 分类：利用 Jev 的多标签概率判定接口进行分类，不过一篇论文可以同时归属两个分类，所以这块的分类没有设计互斥性 我把整个检索系统用节点图的形式进行可视化，前端使用 ReactFlow 构建。节点图的形式足够灵活，能够应对各种不同的生产需求。 ![]( https://parallax-open.oss-cn-hongkong.aliyuncs.com/v2ex/37/3748ac89d43e73a2964cd4174e916aa7819571e67f596994608e3385270438d9.gif) 于是一个典型的节点工作流如上图所示：使用关键词或者语义检索进行多路召回，然后用并集算子进行合并去重得到一个规模较大的候选集，扔到 AI 精筛节点调用 Jev 进行精筛（目前判定阈值硬编码为 0.5 ），再通过 AI 分类节点进行主题分类。 在 DeepSeek-Flash 模型实测中大部分时候 Agent 会依照典型的工作流进行检索，但面临更大规模更复杂的检索需求，Agent 可能会在复核过程中发现工作疏漏，构建用于弥补的新集合，反复调试出“最终版”集合，再进入下一步分类阶段，从而构建出跟电路图一样复杂的工作流： ![]( https://parallax-open.oss-cn-hongkong.aliyuncs.com/v2ex/aa/aaab6013da54f2ea688fdfa217dc230a40f1c84712acac28cfdea94260a5ae66.png) 相比于 General/Coding Agent 的文本文件记账直接处理、结构化标记语言（ XML/JSON ）记账脚本处理，建立在数据库和索引基础上的集合记账能够实现更大规模、更高效的处理；并且将这种大规模处理任务委托给确定性的程序，能够对抗模型的幻觉或者上下文压缩过程中的记忆细节丢失。集合数据结构还可以进一步扩展统计分析接口，以满足更加精细的数据洞察需求。 ## 性能和成本 其实上述的思路非常自然，ComfyUI 等低代码节点图工作流已经深入人心，在很多人的脑海中应该都浮现过类似的文献检索思路。但是让这样的系统能够投入生产使用，最大的问题不是数据抽象，而是面临较大规模数据时的性能优化，以及如何平衡速度、成本、效果这几个维度。 Parallax 目前通过 OAI 接口抓取了 arXiv 下 cs.*分类自 2020 年来的元数据更新，大概有 82 万篇，元数据及其索引约占 7.8GB ；为了实现语义召回，系统接入 Perplerxity 的完成语义嵌入，向量比元数据重得多。每篇论文的摘要经 pplx-embed-v1-0.6b 嵌入成 1024 维向量。按 float32 算单条 4KB ，82 万篇理论上约 3.3GB ；如果压成 halfvec 半精度表示，单条 2KB 共计约 1.65GB 。但这只是裸数据大小。真正落到 PostgreSQL+pgvector 里，为了同时满足精确和快速两个目标，向量实际存了多份，加上索引的总占用达到了约 17GB 。 关于系统的一些优化手段： - 精确语义检索的召回分批：直接跑一条大规模召回 SQL 时长不可控，并且发生中断缺乏检查点又要重新跑，因此对召回语句按时间窗口进行分批检索 top-K ，最后合并再取总 top-K ，精确性得以确保；分批会带来一定的额外时间开销，但是系统可靠性和资源可控性都获得了提升。 - 近似最近邻（ ANN ）：系统实测发现在 top-K 召回任务下，随着 K 的增加，召回率相比于精确算法会下降，这是由于 HNSW 索引本身的特点导致的；因此我们采用的策略是在较小的 K 时采用 ANN 进行加速，能从精确版本所需的十多秒降至几秒，并且召回准确率能保持在 90%以上。 - Jev 的批处理和并发：我们的精筛和分类都使用 Jev 的 noul 元语实现，分类也使用 noul 是面向论文主题的多标签场景；在实现上，对同一个节点任务在后台切分批次，并发推进，精筛和分类的批大小并不是固定的，而是根据 Jev 的上下文窗口和当前批内元数据 token 长度自适应调整。 相比于最初使用的 DeepSeek-Flash 进行精筛，九月下旬切换到 Jev 后在生产服务器上实测，新管线对 36,564 篇论文进行精筛判定只花了 5 分钟左右，是 LLM 版本速度的 10+倍，而成本只有不到五分之一。 为什么 LLM 的成本会高延迟会低？因为我们设计的管线会收集判定审计信息（概率或者原因），LLM 并非直接输出 true 或者 false ，而是输出一个带判定结果和原因的 JSON 。如果打开模型的 CoT 思考，模型的思考长度不可控故而延迟不可控；如果关闭模型的 CoT 思考，又会导致批处理时时常出现 JSON 格式错误，要么整批作废重试、要么聚集错误结果开新批次。不管怎么样，在专门为 type-safe 设计的 Jev 面前，LLM 都并非解决这个问题的首选。 ## 实测效果 在一个“LLM 智能体记忆机制”主题的论文检索案例中，Agent 会先根据用户提供的线索对库中的论文进行低成本探针（ probe ）调研搞清楚论文的大致分布情况，然后创建 6 路关键词+5 路语义召回，合并后得到三万多篇候选文献； Agent 会拟定提供给 Jev 进行判定的业务标准，什么样的论文可以被纳入（ include ），什么样的论文需要被剔除（ exclude ），然后提交后台进行并发批处理判定。 ![]( https://parallax-open.oss-cn-hongkong.aliyuncs.com/v2ex/04/04761a883a18745c7d4014f7c8b2d74ac82ecc4881b41589fe1bb299940e9415.png) 而在另一个“多模态理解与统一多模态方向八月份工作梳理”主题的检索任务中，Agent 通过三路关键词和语义召回得到 466 篇候选文献后进入精筛管线得到 428 篇匹配主题的论文，接着 Agent 读取集合条目标题拟定分类目录后，调用 Jev 分类节点进行分类，得到评测基准与数据集、具身智能、安全隐私、理解生成统一等 10 类。 用户指出评测基准这类还有一百多篇，可以进一步细分，Agent 就继续探查条目，对评测子集进行进一步细分，得到 11 个类别的评测基准与数据子类别。分类过程中 Jev 会提供论文条目关于每一类分类判定标准的纳入概率，这些概率信息都会被持久化到数据库中以供用户和 Agent 审查。 ![]( https://parallax-open.oss-cn-hongkong.aliyuncs.com/v2ex/e9/e9544f684368db55cd9753f081d8e8d955b2d76568151cc7994733783564ab9a.png) ## 集成工作流 为了让检索的结果能够更便捷地转化为用户对于论文的理解和对领域的洞察，我在数据与检索基础设施之上，构建了整套云原生的 Agentic Workflow 。产品追求智能体原生，所以为所有功能都设计了供 Agent 调用的工具入口；而人类目前仍然需要在学术研究场景进行深度介入，所以我们仍重视用户的交互习惯与系统的可观测性，为大部分功能都构建了可视化的 UI 面板（比如更适合文献阅读场景的衬线+两端对齐阅读排版）。 ![]( https://parallax-open.oss-cn-hongkong.aliyuncs.com/v2ex/2a/2aad817fedc3de6f1823c40f251cff0d52f7be174d691fc214db58fdbf3a0ea5.png) 用户可以利用 Parallax 提供的技能，直接产出领域研究综述、每日/每周/每月进展跟踪报告： ![]( https://parallax-open.oss-cn-hongkong.aliyuncs.com/v2ex/bf/bfcd6d02a6ebbcbcb719c6b2b3f1f1007c703aae8511dbfc953123d19a1cf1bd.png) ## Why Parallax? Why Parallax? 为什么要设计 Parallax ？在 RSI 真正到来、AI 领域论文的价值完全消散之前，对于 Frontier Lab 以外的学者、学生或开发者来说，arXiv 上的论文仍然是第一手的领域信息来源；但现在论文的产出量越来越大、文献所涵盖的总体洞察越来越多，但是人们却越来越难以获得与论文增长相匹配的、对领域洞察和理解的增长。 我希望能找全文献，看看整个领域或者某个我所关注的细分方向，在空间或者时间维度上发生了什么，要做到这一点就只能对全量论文做快速的召回扫描，而无法仅仅通过 Google Search 或者 arXiv Search 的 top-K 结果来实现这一点。“找全文献”这件事情的需求，从 GitHub 上琳琅满目的 awesome paper list 就可见一斑；而设计 Parallax 就是为了能快速自助产出 awesome paper list ，并且通过更易用的数据接口和更聚焦的上下文管理来在此基础上更全面地理解领域发生或者正在发生的事情。 我一年半之前还在游戏行业工作的时候曾看过用户研究部门的分享，介绍他们是如何助力游戏战投部门的工作的。游戏玩得多的人都知道，游戏的品类是很难定义的，因为玩法之间的分类往往是模糊的，而一款游戏可以有很多种玩法，品类定义起来也更加麻烦。但是定义品类、预测品类的走向又是用户研究和战略投资绕不开的课题，因为每隔一段时间就会有一种新品类在市面上流行起来，对于大厂来说对未来可能的新品类进行提前布局是必要的商业手段。那如何解决这个问题呢？ Steam 以及一些游戏直播平台上有大量的游戏评价数据，并且 Steam 游戏的标签系统是用户共建的。通过建设评价数据和标签的实时观测系统，能够看到一种标签或者评论区中的概括是如何从零碎的短语，演变成为大部分玩家的共同描述手段，从而成为一种新的“品类”。比如“魂-like”或者“类银河战士恶魔城游戏”就是从用户标签或者评价中起源，并逐步演变为约定俗成的正式品类名称；而最初用户想表达的意思仅仅只是“该款游戏的玩法像银河战士和恶魔城”或者“游戏的操作难度和叙事像黑魂”。 而 arXiv 文献数量的暴涨，也让 AI 学术研究进入了高频、高动态的时期；而 Jev 的到来让我发现能够通过一种更加低成本的方式来灵活地观察领域的变化和动向。 Parallax 现在已经上线生产环境，欢迎来访使用： https://parallax.ink

projects.summary: 麦当劳中国这个月开了 MCP 接口，查菜单、算价、建地址、下外卖单都能做，还顺带办了个开发者比赛，按 GitHub star 排名。我做了一个参赛，叫「麦从天降」，群里请客抽奖用的。 发起人在 Claude Code 里说一句「群里抽一个人请吃巨无霸，满 10 人开」，它去 MCP 查完价格，给一条链接，丢进群。群友点开填个昵称就算报名，不用登录。到点开奖，中的人填地址，发起人这边自动下单，外卖送过去。 参与的人一分钱不花，页面上也没有付款入口，钱是发起人出。一开始想做成每人出一块那种，查了下那叫一元购，不合法，就改成纯请客了。 开奖做了 commit-reveal：发起时先把种子的哈希贴出来，锁名单时服务端加个 nonce ，开完奖全部公开，页面上有个按钮可以在浏览器里自己算一遍。下单那步有金额上限和防重复下单。 真实付款下单那一步还没完整跑过，字段照文档写的，有坑再修。 演示活动一直开着，填个名字能看到自己在名单里，不会真开奖。 演示： https://lucky-drop.defiabell.workers.dev/d/38m4bwpfzh 仓库： https://github.com/Defiabell/mcd-lucky-drop

github.description: Daily radar for new AI terms: names of new models, products and repos, caught on X, Hugging Face, GitHub and sitemaps before keyword tools list them.

projects.summary: 每天从 X、Hugging Face、GitHub 和导航站的 sitemap 里，找出刚开始冒头的 AI 新模型、新产品、新仓库名字，再用 Google Ads 搜索量和 Google Trends 估算这些名字背后通用搜索词的需求，给出「优先 / 观察 / 跳过」的建议。适合做 AI 工具站 SEO、写 Newsletter、做导航站的人：新词出现当天就知道，不用等两周后关键词工具里才有数据。 亮点 抓的是最早的公开信号：实验室在 X 上首发、模型进 Hugging Face 热门、一个仓库一天涨几百星。这些往往比 Google Trends 和关键词工具早几天到几周。 不只给名字，还给名字背后的通用搜索词（比如 SynthID Detector 背后的「ai image detector」），附估算日搜、上涨时间和首页竞争，直接落到「优先 / 观察 / 跳过」。 每条线索 14 天后自动用 Google Trends 复盘，能看到它自己的命中率。 纯 Python 标准库，MIT 开源；命令行、3 个 Agent Skill、MCP 服务器三种用法都有。付费数据走你自己的 AIsa key。

projects.summary: CoWork OS 是我们开发的一款开源 AI 桌面应用（MIT 协议，支持 macOS 和 Windows）。它可以处理文件、文档表格和演示文稿，操作浏览器，整理邮件和日历，运行定时任务和聊天机器人。 和命令行智能体相比，它的重点是“看得见、管得住”：每一次工具调用都实时显示在任务时间线上；发送消息、联网、使用凭据、读写工作区以外的文件之前，都会弹出批准卡片，显示将要执行的完整命令，由你确认后才运行。 模型可以自己选：本地 Ollama、LM Studio，或 OpenRouter、Kimi、GLM、ChatGPT 账号等。首次任务可以通过 OpenRouter 的免费模型直接运行，不需要 API key。记忆以 Markdown 文件保存在本地 git 文件夹里，每次修改都是一次提交，可以直接打开查看和编辑。 最新的 0.5.61 版本还支持从 Hermes Agent 和 OpenClaw 一键迁移人设、记忆、技能和定时任务，导入前会先列出所有内容，不会修改原来的目录。 安装只需要一条命令，不会弹出系统安全拦截： macOS（Apple 芯片）：curl -fsSL | bash Windows（PowerShell）：irm | iex 其他系统 / Intel Mac：npm install -g cowork-os 应用界面目前是英文的，中文说明见 README.zh-CN。

projects.title: Show HN: Vibetown – public sandboxes to vibecode with strangers
projects.author: nickmarch31
projects.summary: Vibetown is a site where you can create a public sandbox (shoutout fly.io sprites / machines) that anyone can contribute to with their AI agents. You can also get matched with a random person in a sandbox to vibe code with them, and if you like what you built then you can open it up and keep it running! Think of it something like twitch meets lovable. There is a chat in each room, along with a localhost preview. People take turns connecting their Claude Code subscriptions and making any changes to the app. Sandboxes automatically go to sleep after a while, but can be woken up. It's completely free because right now I'm only supporting frontend apps. Use it to create art or cool websites without anything fancy. In the future, I will add database, AI (api), and other integrations. The short-term goal is just to see how people collaborate with strangers on public apps. The long-term goal is to make it possible for indie devs to build fully working apps with others that actually generate revenue. Let me know what you think! I have 4 public sandboxes running right now that anyone can hop in and contribute to.

projects.title: Show HN: Celorga – A portable re-implementation of Org for you and your agents
projects.author: aviaviavi
projects.summary: I've been a heavy user of Emacs Org mode for a decade and a half. As AI has reduced how often I'm using a text-editor, I was finding myself tied to spacemacs just for Org, and I was searching for a way to keep those workflows and notes, but be fully decoupled from Emacs. (I blogged about that here: https://avi.press/posts/2024-01-15-standalone-org.html , the original idea for this project). Today I'm excited to launch Celorga: a portable re-implementation of Org, with no dependency on Emacs or elisp, and adds many primitives so you can use it with all of your agents. Celorga offers a portable CLI that covers most core Org capabilities like agenda management, structured editing, searching, and more. It also well offers a tons of capabilities for working with all of your agents (any agent, any harness), like an MCP server, and the ability to kick off your agents easily from any TODO in your notes. It offers most capabilities of multi-agent harnesses today, but aimed at a more general workload than just coding. I believe at this point, Celorga is most polished Org experience outside of Emacs. It comes with native Mac and iOS apps (Linux & android coming soon). Fully OSS, Apache 2. - GitHub: https://github.com/aviaviavi/celorga - Homepage: https://celorga.io - Install the CLI from npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/celorga Feedback is welcome!

projects.author: johnjwang
projects.summary: I often switch between Claude Code and Codex throughout the week, and between my laptop and an older machine I leave running at home. I built agent-archive to make it easier to pick up where I left off, especially when i hit usage limits. It lets you (or a coding agent) find past coding sessions and hand their conversation context to another agent. You can try local handoffs without setup, or connect your own S3/R2 bucket for automatic archiving and access from other machines. It also tracks usage across agents and gives you a full archive of your session transcripts across agents, which I've found useful to iterating and improving my AGENTS.md and lint rules.

Optional replies are off by default and sent only after you confirm the exact draft. Presets for Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, QQ, 163, Aliyun, Tencent Exmail and Feishu. Free for one inbox.

projects.title: Claude Code 账号被封怎么办？实战指南：封号原因、Persona 认证与网络排查
projects.author: EdwardParker
projects.summary: Claude Code 账号被封怎么办？实战指南：封号原因、Persona 认证与网络排查 更新日期：2026 年 10 月 适用于 Claude、Claude Code 账号暂停、Persona 身份核验、终端连接失败等常见问题。文中区分官方规则与社区经验，不把未经证实的“养号技巧”当成防封方法。 最近在 Claude Code 社区，能看到几类让人头疼的求助：有人正用 Claude Code 写项目，突然收到 Account suspended；有人登录时被要求完成 Persona 认证；还有人网页端明明正常，终端却频繁提示 Connection error，写到一半的任务反复中断。 这三种情况表面上都像是 Claude 出了问题，但原因可能完全不同。账号被停用，应该走官方复核；身份验证，应该按真实资料完成；网络连接失败，才需要逐层排查线路和客户端。 如果一上来就不断换节点、改时区、清缓存，很可能折腾半天也没找到真正的问题。 一、Claude 为什么会封号？先了解真正的风险来源 Anthropic 并没有公开一份所谓“封号风控评分表”，但其帮助中心明确列出了账号可能被停用的原因，包括： 违反使用政策或服务条款：例如反复触及被禁止的使用场景，或其他违反账号规则的行为。 从不支持的地区创建或使用账号：能打开 Claude 的网页，并不等于符合它的服务地区要求。 平台判断存在其他需要限制的行为：具体个案可能需要通过 Safeguards 申诉流程复核。 2026 年 10 月 8 日，Anthropic 发布新版 Usage Policy 说明，并进一步明确了 Supported Regions Policy 的适用范围：不仅涉及用户的实际所在地，也涉及企业的注册地、总部及相关控制关系。新版 Usage Policy 计划于 2026 年 11 月 12 日生效；地区资格不能简单理解为“出口 IP 在美国就可以”。 这里有个经常被误解的地方：地区限制不等于按中文语言或中国国籍一刀切。 是否有资格使用，必须对照官方当前政策与实际情况判断；换一个节点并不能改变真实所在地和账号主体的合规条件。 Anthropic 公布的 2026 年上半年透明度数据也说明，账号审查确实不是个别案例：官方记录了约 1,140 万个被封禁账号、39.8 万次申诉，以及约 4.2 万次被推翻的封禁决定。不过这些是平台总量，不能拿来推算“正常开发者的封号概率”。 二、先分清：账号封禁、Persona 验证和网络断流 | 你遇到的现象 | 更可能属于什么问题 | 优先处理方式 | |---|---|---| | Account suspended、Your account has been disabled | 账号限制 | 查看邮件和受限页面，按官方流程申诉 | | 登录时跳出 Persona，要求拍摄证件或人脸 | 身份核验 | 检查验证入口，按真实资料完成认证 | | Connection error、请求超时、终端掉线 | 网络或服务故障 | 查官方状态页、代理配置、证书及线路 | | Rate limit、额度耗尽、用量限制 | 产品使用限制 | 检查用量和计划规则，不要误判为封号 | 遇到异常，先保存完整错误信息、出现时间和对应操作。对于真正的账号限制，反复切换网络通常并不能解除封禁；对于普通连接超时，也不应该直接认定自己被风控。 三、为什么网络质量会影响 Claude Code 的使用体验？ Claude Code 与普通网页浏览有一个很大的区别：它往往涉及连续的交互、工具调用、较长的响应和多轮代码修改。一次网页加载失败，刷新一下可能就过去了；但写代码时突然断线，可能需要重新检查刚才的文件修改、终端输出和任务进度。 所以我判断网络服务是否适合开发工作，通常不会只看测速截图。真正需要观察的是： 晚高峰有没有明显抖动：平时能连，不代表高峰时段也稳定。 长时间连接会不会突然中断：几秒钟的测速与持续任务是两回事。 常用地区是否有可切换节点：某条线路发生故障时，至少方便排查和恢复普通网络工作。 客户端和分流规则是否成熟：浏览器能访问，不代表 PowerShell、Terminal 或其他开发工具也已正确配置。 这也是我会留意 AI 极客圈口碑极佳的 WgetCloud 的原因。选择这类高端线路的核心优势在于： IEPL 内网专线防断流：与走公网易受干扰的普通机场不同，WgetCloud 官网地址 采用物理专线跨境。这保证了在长文本对话、大规模代码生成或挂机时绝不断流，你的公网 IP 始终稳如磐石，从物理层杜绝了“IP 瞬移”导致的封号风险。 价格壁垒过滤污染源：相比廉价中转，WgetCloud 的准入门槛较高，严格限制带宽与在线设备数。这种高客单价天然隔离了羊毛党和恶意脚本，使得单节点 IP 纯净度极高，不会触发风控警报。 严密的底层防泄漏：支持原生接入 Clash / Surge，便于配置精细的路由分流规则，彻底防止 DNS 漏网暴露出国内真实的运营商 IP。 尤其当日常工作经常涉及 GitHub 仓库同步、海外技术文档和远程服务时，值得关注的是实际连接连续性，而不是宣传页上的峰值速度。 Windows + Clash Verge Rev：排查终端代理的一个实例 在符合 Anthropic 服务地区政策、且有权使用相应网络的前提下，如果网页端可用、Claude Code 终端持续报连接错误，可以按以下步骤排查： 第一步：检查 Claude 自身是否故障。 先打开 Claude Status，排除官方服务异常。 第二步：核对客户端的 HTTP/Mixed 端口。 Clash Verge Rev 的端口以软件实际设置为准；系统代理开启，也不代表每个终端程序都会自动继承。 第三步：检查 Claude Code 的代理环境变量。 例如，假设本机 HTTP 代理实际监听 127.0.0.1:7890，在 PowerShell 当前会话中可以检查或设置： powershell $env:HTTPPROXY = " $env:HTTPSPROXY = " 查看当前会话的设置 $env:HTTPPROXY $env:HTTPSPROXY 端口 7890 只是示例，不要照抄到与你的客户端设置不一致的环境中。上述设置只对当前 PowerShell 会话及其启动的子进程生效。Claude Code 官方支持 HTTP/HTTPS 代理环境变量，但不直接支持 SOCKS 代理；若使用了企业证书或网关，还需检查证书信任和网络放行要求。 第四步：判断是网络问题还是账号问题。 如果提示身份验证失败、账号停用或地区不支持，就应停止把它当成简单的代理端口问题。若只在特定网络、特定时段发生超时，则记录错误时间、测试其他获准的网络环境并检查客户端日志。 四、网上流传的“Claude 防封技巧”，哪些不能迷信？ 经常能看到这样的说法：注册后先“养号”几天、每天按美国人的作息提问、把 Windows 时区改成纽约、坚持同一个国家的 IP、换指纹浏览器就能提高账号权重。 这些都不能当成已被证实的规则。 Anthropic 没有公开证据表明，照着一套“人类行为模板”操作就能获得安全账号，也没有宣布“固定 IP 即可免封”。 更值得做的是这些基础工作： 1. 确认地区和账号资格：遵守官方 Supported Regions Policy，而不是只观察出口 IP 显示在哪个国家。 2. 保管好自己的账号：不要购买来路不明的成品号、共享登录凭据或把验证资料交给“代认证”服务。 3. 规范使用 Claude Code：通过官方支持的登录和服务方式使用；有团队协作、自动化或 API 需求时，按对应产品与授权规则部署。 4. 减少无意义的环境折腾：如果某个客户端本来就正常，不必为了所谓“风控玄学”频繁更改时区、设备标识或浏览器环境。 5. 保留自己的工作成果：项目放在 Git 仓库，重要配置、提示词和文档做好备份，避免账号异常导致工作被迫中断。 五、被要求 Persona 实名认证，应该怎么操作？ Persona 是 Anthropic 官方确认的身份验证合作伙伴。根据 Claude 帮助中心 2026 年 8 月 11 日发布的说明，部分个人或企业用户在访问特定能力、接受平台完整性检查或满足安全合规要求时，可能遇到身份核验。 出现 Persona 验证，并不自动意味着账号已经被封。 验证通过也不保证账号一定符合其他使用规则。 需要准备什么？ 个人用户通常需要： 本人有效的实体证件：政府签发、带照片、未过期且清晰完好。官方列举的常见类型包括护照、驾驶证或政府身份证件，最终以实际验证流程为准。 可以拍照的手机：验证过程中可能需要实时自拍或人脸核对。 正常的摄像头权限和清晰光线：避免证件反光、模糊、边缘被遮挡。 官方明确不接受截图、扫描件、证件照片的翻拍、电子证件或非政府签发的学生证等材料。至于能否接受某份具体证件，取决于核验页面及资格条件；不存在“拿中国护照就一定能过”“必须用外国证件”这样的通用结论。 如果 Persona 验证失败 先检查证件是否过期、照片是否清楚、摄像头权限是否正常，再按照页面提供的重试机会操作。次数用尽仍无法完成，应联系 Claude 官方帮助中心。 不建议采用网上所谓的“通关秘技”，例如拔掉 SIM 卡、关闭 GPS、强行禁用 WebRTC，或者使用指纹浏览器伪造环境。这些做法没有官方成功率依据，还可能造成新的兼容性和身份风险。更不要把证件、人脸视频或验证码交给声称可以“包过 Persona”的陌生人。 按照 Anthropic 的公开说明，证件与自拍照由 Persona 收集和保存，Anthropic 可以在有需要时通过 Persona 平台查看验证记录，但不自行复制存储这些影像；验证数据不用于训练模型。具体隐私细节以官方身份验证说明为准。 六、Claude 账号已经被封，如何提交申诉？ 如果登录页面明确显示账号已停用，官方给出的处理途径是 Safeguards 申诉： 1. 打开 claude.ai，登录被限制的原账号。 2. 在受限页面找到申诉表单，按要求填写。 3. 写清楚出现问题的时间、具体错误、实际使用场景和你认为需要复核的事实。 4. 提交后留意注册邮箱的回复；不要以重复注册、虚构身份等方式代替申诉。 英文说明可以简洁一些，不需要套用夸张的“保证解封话术”： text Subject: Request for Review of Claude Account Suspension Hello Anthropic Safeguards Team, My Claude account was suspended on [date]. I primarily use Claude / Claude Code for [your actual use case]. I would appreciate a review of this decision. Here are the relevant details: [error message, time, and factual context]. Please let me know if further information is needed. Thank you. 申诉不是百分百解封，但官方确实会推翻部分错误决定。 先前公布的申诉统计也说明，正常提供事实并请求复核是有意义的。 如需导出数据或删除账号，官方表示受限用户通常仍可在受限登录页面找到相应选项，但可导出内容可能受到限制。因此，代码和重要工作文档最好始终保存在自己可控的位置。 七、几个常见问题 Q：用了 VPN 或代理就一定会封 Claude 吗？ 不能这样下结论。社区个案无法证明“VPN 必封”。但使用代理同样不能改变实际地区资格，也无法保证平台接受当前访问环境。 Q：Claude Code 一直提示 Connection error，是不是账号被封了？ 不一定。先查 官方状态页，再核对终端代理、证书、网络日志；以账号受限页面和官方邮件判断是否真的封禁。 Q：Persona 要求提交护照，能否找别人代认证？ 不要。应当使用本人的真实、有效证件，且仅通过官方验证流程提交。找人代过会带来身份泄露和账号合规风险。 Q：选 IEPL、BGP 或更贵的线路，是否就能避免风控？ 不能。线路架构影响的是网络传输，账号权限和认证结果取决于平台规则。真正值得测试的是高峰稳定性、丢包、长连接和客户端兼容性。 写在最后 Claude Code 能显著提高开发效率，但也不必把“防封”想成需要伪装设备、模拟作息的神秘工程。 账号问题找官方申诉，身份问题走真实认证，网络问题查线路与客户端。 把问题分对类，比照着一串未经验证的技巧折腾更有效。长期依赖 AI 写代码的人，还应该把精力放在可靠的网络、可恢复的开发环境和自己掌握的代码资产上。

projects.title: BeatAPI
projects.author: kkkk
projects.summary: ## 给你的 Agent 增加各种专业能力 我把越来越多工作交给 Codex，但每加一种能力，又要重新找服务、读文档、注册、充值和配置。BeatAPI 就是从这个问题出发做的：给 Agent 一个统一的专业能力入口，也可以直接接入你开发的应用。 ### 现在可以做什么 - **调用模型**：接入文本、图片和视频模型，按量付费，在价格页比较同模型、同规格的公开价格。 - **获取社媒数据**：读取 TikTok、YouTube、X、Reddit、Instagram 等平台的公开数据，用于选题、竞品研究和内容分析。 - **使用网页工具**：搜索、读取网页、获取站点地图和开展研究。 - **先查看再调用**：Agent 可以搜索能力目录，检查参数和价格，再按对应接口执行。 ### 怎么开始 在 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 或 Muse 等 Agent 中发送： `set up https://beatapi.io/SKILL.md` 按引导连接 BeatAPI Key，就可以让 Agent 调用相应能力。应用也可以直接通过 API 接入。 官网：https://beatapi.io/ 价格：https://beatapi.io/pricing 产品演示：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-8vmHR74QC4 欢迎试用，也想听听大家最希望 Agent 补上的能力是什么。

My recent work in AI has been around finding practical uses in the content and knowledge management areas for integrating the technology, and Standard Topic has developed into what I see as a product that uses structured outputs and automated insights to deliver consistent and trustworthy, cited content while maintaining transparency about being primarily powered by artificial intelligence. There's still some kinks to work out in terms of automated workflows, design aspects and more. Let me know what you think!

projects.title: Show HN: Acyclic; Rapid agent swarms
projects.author: ramstar3000
projects.summary: Hi HN, we're the co-founders of Acyclic (YC F26). Acyclic runs any agentic workflow as a swarm. You give it a task and your project; it splits the work across many coding agents, each in its own sandbox, runs them in parallel, and merges what they produce into one patch or pull request. Our thesis: agentic workflows should be realtime, no matter how complex the task. The bottleneck should be human ideation and design, whilst building happens at the speed of thought. To bring this to you we make our agents recursively fork and speculative execute. This means that if an agent has 2 independent tasks to do, it will just split into 2 agents to solve both tasks quickly and merge back up the tree. Additionally, for sequential operations we have “speculative” agents which guess the next steps of the workflow as a pre-fetch step. To make this efficient we are solving the infrastructure bottlenecks. We are solving the memory, communication, routing and durable execution issues. This infra is open source at acyclic.dev/github, so check it out! To run your own swarm (check out acyclic.dev for a full guide) ``` npm install -g @acyclic-labs/cli acyclic swarm run --task <prompt> --dir <files_to_upload> ``` A good (non-coding) first task to try out: Do deep research into a person. “Do deep research into Jeff Goldblum“ You can view the results at acyclic.dev/dashboard or stream the results back to the cli using: ``` acyclic swarm pull <swarm-id> --apply ``` Check out some more research examples at acyclic.dev/evals, right now our biggest useful swarm is 236 agents for a code migration.

projects.summary: 大家好，我们做了一个面向科研工作者的 AI Agent：Yila。 用一句话介绍，就是 Codex, but for scientific research. 你可以说这是一个“套壳产品”。不过，对科研工作者来说，把这些工具装到一起、真正用起来，本身就有不少门槛。 至于为什么不直接用 Codex，举个简单的例子：如果你想让它检索万方的论文库，接着分析实验数据、画出科研图表，这中间的数据源、运行环境和研究方法，都需要有人准备。 我们把这些准备工作做进了 Yila：接入万方等学术数据库，内置科研 Skills、Python 和 R 运行环境，以及常用的统计分析和绘图工具。不用下载安装，也不用自己配环境，在网页上描述研究问题就能开始。 例子一：从文献检索到带引用的综述草稿 围绕一个研究问题检索、筛选文献，比较不同研究的方法和结论，整理证据矩阵，再写成带引用的综述草稿。下图是一个检索了 60 篇候选文献的案例，展示了综述中对不同研究结论的比较。查看完整案例 例子二：上传实验数据，完成分析和绘图 这个转录组案例从数据检查、差异基因筛选，到火山图和 PCA 散点图，最后一起交付图表、结果表和可复用的 Python 脚本。下图是样本的 PCA 散点图。查看完整案例 我们已经悄悄内测了一段时间，发现科研用户的付费率还挺高。这个反馈让我们觉得，帮大家省下配置工具、整理资料的时间，确实是一件值得做的事。 欢迎科研工作者试试，也欢迎告诉我们：你的研究里，还有哪些费时的步骤值得交给 Agent？ 体验：yila.ai · 更多案例

projects.title: 【开源自荐】wxa-runner：在浏览器里用微信官方基础库运行小程序，支持 Playwright 无头测试
projects.author: DBAAZzz

github.name: open-wxa/wxa-runner
github.description: 在浏览器中用微信官方基础库运行小程序，支持 Chrome DevTools 调试与 Playwright E2E 测试

projects.summary: 我是项目作者。wxa-runner 是一个开源（MIT）命令行工具，可以在普通浏览器里运行微信小程序，用于本地调试和 E2E 自动化测试。 它不把小程序转成 H5，而是直接加载微信官方的基础库和编译器，自己只实现微信客户端的「原生层」：消息桥、页面栈、原生 API，以及导航栏、tabBar、弹窗这些原生界面。渲染、组件、setData、生命周期都由官方代码完成，行为和开发者工具一致。 在小程序目录（或 uni-app / Taro 编译出的 mp-weixin 目录）里一行启动： bash npx wxa-runner dev . --open 能做什么 AI Agent 可以直接操作：Claude Code、Codex 这类 Agent 最擅长的就是操作浏览器。小程序跑在浏览器里，它们用现成的浏览器能力就能点页面、看 DOM、读控制台和网络请求、写 Playwright 测试，不用为小程序额外配置开发者工具的自动化端口 用 Chrome DevTools 调试：打断点、看网络请求和 DOM，调用栈停在业务代码上，不会掉进基础库 Playwright 无头测试：直接在浏览器里跑 E2E，不用远程控制开发者工具，CI 里没装开发者工具也能跑 跳过登录：在 wxa.setup.ts 里预置 storage、mock 原生 API、拦截 wx.request，不用改业务代码 直接打开任意页面：地址加上 ?path=pages/detail/detail&id=1 即可 热更新：改页面的 wxml、js、wxss 不刷新页面，页面栈和全局状态都保留 测试写起来是这样： ts test('提交后跳转到结果页', async ({ miniProgram }) => { await miniProgram.mock('login', { code: 'testcode' }); await miniProgram.open('pages/form/form'); await miniProgram.current.locator('#submit').click(); await expect(miniProgram).toHavePath('pages/result/result'); await expect(miniProgram).toHavePageData({ status: 'ok' }); }); 当前边界 不替代开发者工具：预览、上传、真机调试仍然要用开发者工具 不支持蓝牙等设备能力，也不支持插件、分包异步化和 Worker 已在 uni-app（Vue 3）真实项目上验证，基础库验证过 2.32.3 到 3.8.8 之间的多个版本 欢迎试用。遇到跑不起来的小程序，请到 Issue 里反馈。

We’re not trying to make money, just paying the postgres bill. And it was nice to connect with my wife while building something together, she’s not technical, but she can build! I then hooked it up to an agent for stats, and also automated my Divoom (see https://imgur.com/a/iKat7rD ) We’re entering a phase where software costs nothing to build and nothing to run, and I am ready for the “Parents that code phase of my life”.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】gilvt：能看清哪个 Claude Code 会话在等你的 macOS 终端

projects.summary: 我是 gilvt 的作者。 同时开三四个 Claude Code、Codex 会话时，最费神的不是写代码，而是搞清楚哪个停下来等我审批、哪个测试挂了、哪个已经做完在等我看结果。普通终端只能挨个标签页去翻。 gilvt 是一个原生 macOS 终端（Rust + gpui + alacrittyterminal），在它里面运行 claude 或 codex 时： 左栏按「需要你 / 出错 / 运行中 / 已完成」列出所有会话，等待审批时发系统通知，点击跳到对应的 pane 检查器按轮次显示 Agent 执行的命令、改动的文件和这一轮的 diff Quick Look 显示词级 diff，渲染 Markdown 和 Mermaid，内置编辑器带实时预览，review 不用切回 IDE 可以搜索、恢复几天前的会话；SSH 到 Linux 或 Apple 芯片 Mac 上跑的 Agent 也会出现在左栏 不修改 ~/.claude、~/.codex 和 shell 配置，没有遥测，免费开源（Apache-2.0）。

projects.summary: pi-cowboy is an agent orchestrator for Pi( https://pi.dev ) and Herdr( https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr ). Break large jobs into focused subtasks, hand them off to background agents running in parallel, and consolidate the results when they finish. Each agent runs in an isolated copy-on-write Git work-tree, minimising disk overhead. pi-cowboy can orchestrate foreign harnesses too, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more. Feature highlights: - Foreign harnesses: pi-cowboy agents can run in Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pig and Pi-Bolt, as well as Pi. This gives you great flexibility in choosing how to spend your tokens. Running out of Codex usage? Switch your pi-cowboy harness to OpenCode, select one of its free models, and let it handle the rest. Pig and Pi-Bolt are pi variants that are more efficient, with a lower memory footprint and faster performance than pi. Because pi-cowboy is designed to run multiple agents in parallel, having a lower per-agent footprint is crucial. It prevents your machine from running out of resources and lets you have higher concurrency without choking your system. - Concurrency limits: You can configure concurrency limits at every level. Running a local model with limited resources? If a simple task already takes hours to complete, the last thing you want is to overload your machine by running too many of them at once. Set concurrency limits for that model specifically to keep resource usage under control. You can install it on Pi as a package: pi install npm:pi-cowboy #(requires `herdr` 0.8+)

projects.author: wx4766

github.name: wx4766/html-to-video
github.description: 用代码逐帧做视频：HTML / Canvas 动画 → MP4 / GIF / 透明层 · Deterministic HTML-to-MP4 renderer: seek to t, screenshot, encode. No framework, no build step, no GPU.

projects.summary: 一个把 HTML / Canvas 动画逐帧渲染成 MP4 的命令行工具。 不是录屏，也不是 AI 文生视频。做法是：把画面在 HTML 里写成 frame(t) 纯函数，用无头浏览器逐帧 seek 到指定时刻截图，再用 ffmpeg 编成 H.264。因为是逐帧推的，所以帧率是真的（60fps 不用插帧），每一帧都精确对齐，同样的输入永远得到同样的输出。 它解决的问题 现在想用代码做视频，主流选择是 Remotion（React）或 Motion Canvas（场景式）。两者都好，但要先把内容组织成它们的世界观。而很多真实场景是：手上已经有一屏 HTML（常常是 AI 刚生成的），只想把它变成 mp4。为一屏画面建一个 React 工程，代价过大。 这个工具刻意不做框架 —— 输入是一个能跑的 HTML 文件，输出是 mp4： bash bash assets/render.sh my-video.html --duration=6 --fps=60 几个不太常见的点 确定性：冻结 wall-clock rAF，由外部逐帧推进，同一份代码重跑逐帧一致。可版本管理、可做视觉回归 自带验收：qa.js 检查六维（确定性 / 最长连续静止 / 跳变 / 文字框景 / 字体回退 / 控制台报错）。为了让验收本身可信，仓库里放了一个塞满六类真实缺陷的对照样本，测试要求它必须被判失败 横竖屏自适应：--width=1080 --height=1920 就是竖屏，模板跟视口重排而不是拉伸。1920×1080 下与旧版逐像素一致（PSNR 逐帧回归，average:inf） 断点续渲：--resume，长片子跑到 80% 崩了不用从零开始。帧先写 .part 再改名，参数变了直接拒绝，编码前逐个核帧号 —— 实测续渲出来的 mp4 与一次渲完的 MD5 完全相同 MIT，纯本地运行，不调任何 API，不按次计费。

projects.summary: 你好，我是 Vexilo Code 的开发者，自荐一个我做的 Mac App（闭源、付费，详见下方价格说明）。 App Store： 测量过程（英文长文）： Claude Code 每一轮都会把已安装的每个 skill、agent 的名字和描述放进上下文，不管这一轮用不用得到。我在自己 Mac 上新开会话、还没打字就跑了一次 /context all：已经加载 39.6k token，其中 skill 9.9k（300 多条，大部分每条不到 20 token）、48 个 agent 3.3k。单看哪条都不重，加起来却每轮都要带着，手动很难挑出该删哪些。 Vexilo Code 做的事： 我的配置：只读扫描本机 ~/.claude，估算每个 skill 和 agent 每轮占多少 token，从重到轻排序 清理提示词：一键复制一段指令交给 Claude Code，让它带你逐条过最重的那些，你确认的才归档；Vexilo 自己从不改 ~/.claude 工具目录：295 个工具（31 个 agent、128 个命令、123 个 skill、13 条规则），中英双语说明，每条带可直接粘贴的提示词，⌘⇧K 在任何 App 里都能搜 端侧 AI：用 Apple Intelligence 在本机运行，不需要 API key；描述任务后只从关键词筛出的候选里挑一个工具，匹配度不够就直接说没有合适的 说明： token 数是估算（字符数 ÷ 4），用来比较轻重，和 /context 不一致时以 /context 为准；目前只统计 skill 和 agent，不统计 CLAUDE.md 和 rules 价格：免费下载，目录、搜索和指南永久免费；完整功能 7 天试用，之后 $19.99 一次性买断，无订阅。需要 macOS 14.6+ 中国区 App Store 暂未上架。另有中文网页版 （工具目录和中文工具书，¥39 买断），配置开销诊断只在 Mac App 里 独立开发，与 Anthropic 无关联 如果觉得适合周刊，谢谢收录。
