projects.title: 关于自己的 agent-harness 的实践与迭代过程中一些好玩的点
projects.author: woodchen
projects.summary: > 无广告,手打,比较乱. 我是看代码, 翻到哪写哪. 为了避免任何意义上的广告或泄露行为(基本自用, 不想找麻烦), 我会打码比较多, 见谅. > 现在当 claude 限速了, 改点小玩意, 会试试自己的. 大任务还是不太放心. 其实基本就是现在 agent 的 harness 框架,大部分都是抄 codex 和 claude code 的理论和方法. 桌面端用 wails 写的. 有时候我会问 claude 它自己有哪些工具,可以放到我的 agent (笑) ## 先放几个图 ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6c0983.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6c5247.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6dae1b.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a68ead8.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a69a776.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6d75e0.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65fc23aa9.png) ## 主要理论 ### 给 agent 的 tool 这个是基础, 比如`ask_user_choice`, `memory`, `call_mcp`, `workspace`, `read image`, `save file`, `send file`等等, 没有 tool 就啥都干不了. ### 调用 tool 的方法 一般是 round trip, 让 agent 可以循环, 下一步做什么让 agent 自己决定. ### tool 的反馈 tool 要给 result, 无论任何情况, 比如停止, 暂停, 错误, 成功等等, 不然 agent 无法知道情况, 无法继续. ### agent 进程要能后台运行 不能必须在页面才能运行, 以前是通过前端去反馈 result, 给后端持续调用. 发现不行, 如果切换到没挂载组件的任何前端其他页面, 都会导致任务暂停, 不如做本机程序后端去持续进行, 需要用户干预 or 完成时, 发系统级通知. ### 避免失控,人为干预, 推理记忆 1. agent 要有上限, 每次运行都有交付, 我理想的是以后不设硬上限, 交给 decisions 模型去判断. 2. 人为干预: 重要操作需要人来把控(例如可用 ask_user_choice), 人的指令高于 agent 的规划. 所以人可以主动干预计划, 停止工作等. 3. 推理记忆: 这个不能丢, 不然 agent 老是忘事.思维链和工具调用要对应, 不然会混乱. ### 四重记忆 这个我没做 harness 框架和桌面端时就做了, 纯网页对话也需要记忆. 之前好像发过贴, 忘了, 基本就是普通的 rag 4 重记忆. **只要不要影响缓存前缀就好了, 不然缓存总是丢成本很高** ### 上下文工程 正好提到缓存, agent 里要注意静态缓存和动态内容, 需要剥离. - prompt 需要分层组装. - 上下文压缩要渐进式 - 工具也是渐进披露, 不然一次性塞上下文, 占的太多, 大部分在某些工作中用不上, 还影响注意力. ### 网页端的话, 需要远程沙箱 网页端也需要提供 office 三件套文件的生成功能, 一般都是 skills+ai 写 python 脚本来实现. 这个脚本, 我是用 **远程机器(非项目主机器) + 固定容器(提供接口, 可唤起临时容器) + 临时容器(一次性执行沙箱, 做完销毁)** 来跑的. 很有必要, 放本机跑=等死. ### 本机运行环境 在桌面端安装后一段时间, 安装一个自己用的 python 独立环境. 不用机器上的主 python. ### 生态互通 claude, codex 的已有工具, 提示词, 通通都要能用, 可以无缝接入. 也就是还懒得做, 不然可以把 claude 的 memory 文档都自动给导入, 更无缝, 严丝合缝. ### 安全工程 主要就是防止任何情况的外部信息影响 agent 安全. 毕竟 agent 是在本地电脑跑的. 方方面面, 每个环节都需要加. ## 结语 下面这个图是让 claude 给我写的. 擦, 他说我后端 api 有一些 one-api 的影子, 不能写 api 部分全自研, 改成了"重新设计实现". 很尊重版权和事实了. 实际基本把 one-api 原有代码改了 70%以上了, 居然还能认出来. ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca6b0723a82.png) --- 做这个主要是兴趣, 做了一个能用的工具, 当它帮我写代码和调 mcp 发文章, 在老婆电脑上装一下用于排查电脑故障等等时, 很有成就感.

projects.title: 把 Tripo Studio 连接到 Codex 的插件
projects.author: bugyaluwang
projects.summary: ![Tripo Studio for Codex Banner]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.png) 为什么是 **Link your Tripo Studio**，而不是 **Tripo API**？ 最近在用 Codex 写自己的 3D / 游戏项目时，我发现现有的官方工具只支持 Tripo API： 1. **明明开了网页端会员，调 API 还得再交一份钱**：很多创作者和独立开发者手里本来就有 **Tripo Studio 网页端会员**（每个月有大量套餐积分），但官方 API Key 的计费池是完全独立的——想在 Agent 里自动化生成模型，还得额外掏钱充值 API Credits 。 2. **我们需要的是整个「 Studio 工作流」，而不是裸调一个无状态接口**：做 3D 资产不是发个 Prompt 拿回一个 URL 就完事了。以往我们要在「浏览器输入 Prompt ➔ 手动下载 GLB ➔ 拖进 Blender 查面数和流形 ➔ 姿势不对切回网页重刷 ➔ 绑骨骼调动作 ➔ 导出 FBX 塞进工程目录」之间反复横跳。 所以我做了一个开源的 Codex 插件 —— **[Tripo Studio for Codex]( https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin)**（ MIT License ），刚刚发布了最新的 **v0.3.4** 版本。 它不走额外的 API Key 计费中转，而是**直接把你的 Tripo Studio 网页端账号、完整创作管线、可视化工作台以及本地 Blender 后处理引擎，原封不动地连进了 Codex**。 --- ### 💡 连入 Tripo Studio 意味着什么？ #### 1. BYO Studio Account：直接复用网页端会员与积分，零 API 溢价 插件直接复用本机的 Tripo Studio 网页登录会话，无需申请和购买 API Key 。你在网页端订购的会员积分，现在可以直接在 Codex 对话框里调用 Studio 全套最新算力： - **High Detail (H2.5 / H3.0 / H3.1)**：高精度几何建模 + 2K/4K/8K PBR 材质与局部重绘 - **Smart Mesh P2**：严格控制在 500–25,000 面的规整四边面网格，支持单次生成多个面数预算变体 - **多视角对齐建模**：支持正/左/背/右四视图一致建模 - **Rig V3 绑骨 & AI Motion**：自动适配 Mixamo / UE Mannequin / Unity Humanoid 标准骨架，支持文本生成连贯动作并重定向 #### 2. 不止是对话：68 个 MCP 工具 + 内嵌 Studio 可视化工作台（ MCP Apps ） 纯靠聊天调 3D 参数像开盲盒，纯靠点网页 UI 又没法让 Agent 帮你批量干活并直接写入代码仓库。基于 **Codex MCP Apps**，我们把 Studio 界面直接搬进了 Codex： - **三合一内嵌工作台**：随时在聊天中唤起包含「资产中心、任务队列、创建面板」的工作台，顶栏**实时显示当前账号的 Studio 剩余积分**。 - **60 秒防手滑确认卡片**：Agent 准备发起生成或编辑时，默认先弹出可交互的参数确认卡片（展示输入视图快照、网格/贴图配置与本地秒算的预估积分）。**卡片真正渲染可见后才开始 60s 倒计时，点击编辑立刻暂停**，彻底杜绝 AI 误操作偷跑你的会员积分。 ![60 秒防手滑参数确认卡片]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin/main/docs/images/configuration-dark.png) ### 🚀 1 分钟安装上手 **直接复制下面这段话发给你的 Codex ，让 AI 自己帮你装好**： ```text 请帮我安装 Tripo Studio for Codex 插件。 项目地址： https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin 请先检查本机是否有 Node.js ≥ 22 、npm / npx 和支持插件的 Codex CLI ，缺少时帮我安装或配置。 然后执行以下命令： codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin.git --ref main codex plugin add tripo-studio-plugin@tripo-studio-plugins 安装成功后提醒我开启新聊天，再发送“检查 Tripo Studio 登录状态，需要的话帮我登录”，然后发送“打开 Tripo 工作台”。 ``` --- ### 🔗 开源地址 - **GitHub （ MIT 开源，求个 Star ⭐）**： https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin - **NPM**： https://www.npmjs.com/package/tripo-studio-plugin 欢迎手里有 Tripo 会员、平时做独立游戏、Web3D 、3D 打印或者重度使用 Codex 的朋友试试看，有任何问题或建议欢迎直接在帖子里交流或提 Issue ！

projects.summary: Hey all, just wanted to share how my spare time has been spent for quite some time now. Ok, this one started oddly. My aim initially was just to serve multiple models on one GPU and fire it up in my unraid machine. By the time that first bit was done, I realised I could just add one more thing... and another... and well, from beginning of this year when, imho, AI became useful, the whole thing it kind of blew up. So here's what it does: - spins a ray cluster - deploys models using various loaders (vllm, llamacpp, diffusers, sherpa_onnx, etc.) - serves an openai responses ready api on top of them Now some the details, already listed in my production readiness ( https://docs.model-ship.ai/production-readiness/#production-... ) plan: - scores 17/17 on the Open Responses conformance suite and it's got its own responses redis backed store - currently supports cpu, metal and cuda - it has prometheus metrics and grafana dashboard - can run under docker, k8s or simply native install - automatically sizes model context - has MCP support Feedback would be much appreciated. https://github.com/modelship-ai/modelship

projects.summary: > 一个从 wordprss 迁移, 一个从 halo 迁移, 由于场景不同, 写了两套, 但基本逻辑类似. ## 迁移理由 1. wordpress 的速度可以优化, 但是扩展不是很方便, 不像私有仓库, push, deploy 自动化 2. halo 的 java 内存占用高, 并且又去搞商城, 还有这种奇怪的变动让我文章页面错误好几周(有部分文章以前从 typecho 迁移到 halo, 文章 url 没变) `升级 2.22.x 后, slug 为四位数, 比如 1207 时, 访问文章, 变成 文章归档 页面` 3. 自定义扩展方便, 多语言, ai 自动翻译, ai 优化 seo, mcp. ## 非纯静态理由 1. 需要 MCP 给 agent 去发 2. 需要接入 ai 模型做文章翻译, SEO 描述, 自动做 ai 任务队列 3. 需要动态改内容, 并且内置 indexnow 4. 阅读数动态统计什么的 5. 方便 ## 非纯动态理由 1. 速度 2. ai 方便抓取和阅读 3. 没有必要 ## 方法 1. 后端 go 2. 管理端动态网页, 可以绑定其他域名或放 url 路径 当内容变更, go 来负责`next build`, 构建静态网页, 然后可以通过下面两种方式去分发. 1. 另起容器, 共享前端网页卷, 如果有需要后端 api, 可反代几个动态接口到 后端 build 容器 2. 直接放一个容器, go-web-utils/nextstatic 来负责处理 next 静态文件路由 效果还不错. ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca77582ccb1.png) 我的博客: 可以看看

projects.title: Show HN: Context Diet – trims tool output before it floods Claude Code's context
projects.author: hy4hy
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built this after watching long Claude Code sessions fill up with tool output: a single verbose test run or build log can be 30–50k characters, almost all of it PASSED lines, warnings and lockfile churn. The context fills, compaction comes sooner, and the agent forgets earlier instructions. Context Diet is a mod (Claude Code's new JS hook API) that rewrites tool results before they are stored in the conversation: - test runners and build tools (jest, vitest, pytest, go test, cargo, tsc, eslint, npm/pip install, docker build) get parsed digests: every failure with its message and location, plus the summary; passing tests are counted, not listed - JSON becomes a skeleton, diffs drop lockfile churn, grep results and file lists are grouped, tables keep exact first and last rows - running the same command again shows only what changed - the full output is always saved to a file, and the digest says where, so the agent can read it when it needs more The question I cared about most was whether it makes the agent worse. On 7 Q&A tasks with known answers, both groups were 7/7, with 8 tool calls instead of 13. On a bug-fixing task (600 tests, two hidden bugs, Haiku/Sonnet/Opus, 18 runs) every agent fixed both bugs with or without it, using 6 tool calls instead of 8. Honest caveats: the token saving on very large outputs is modest, because Claude Code already moves those to a file; the gain there is fewer steps. Also, when a command fails, Claude Code keeps only ~10k characters and drops the end of the output, where the failures usually are. There is an opt-in mode that saves the whole output first, off by default because it changes the command text. It's MIT, makes no network calls, and I'd love examples of output it digests badly.

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个刚开源的本地复式记账桌面工具 BeanDesk（经营账本）。 GitHub 安装包下载： （支持 macOS Apple Silicon & Intel / Windows / Linux） 为什么做这个工具？ 很多独立开发者、一人公司（OPC）和小微企业在日常经营中都有记账和报税的需求： 用商业财务 SaaS，往往不放心把公司真实的银行流水和账目传到别人的云端服务器； 用 Beancount / Fava 做纯文本复式记账，又面临 Python 环境折腾、缺乏符合国内习惯的标准报表（尤其现金流量表）、以及手写分录门槛高的问题； 直接让大模型算账，则经常出现借贷不平或加减法幻觉。 BeanDesk 的定位是一个“本地化的 AI 财税副手”：基于 Tauri 2 构建，不设云端账号、无需自建数据库，账目与发票凭证完全留在本地电脑；同时通过内置的本机 MCP 服务让 AI 协助日常录账与合规核查，底层用确定性的会计引擎杜绝大模型幻觉。 核心特性 1. 真正开箱即用，免配环境：安装包内置了冻结的核算引擎运行时，无需在电脑上安装配置 Python 或敲命令行，打开软件选定文件夹即可一键初始化标准账套（内置中国企业会计准则 CAS 与国际准则模板）。 2. 标准财务三张表：除试算平衡表外，即时生成规范的资产负债表、利润表、现金流量表，经营成果、资金流向与报税口径一目了然。 3. AI 随手记 + 强规则防幻觉：同一可执行文件自带本机 stdio MCP 服务，可接入 Claude Desktop、Cursor 等 AI 客户端。AI 负责理解自然语言票据并提议分录，本地引擎通过 bean-check 与内置会计规则强制核验借贷平衡，算错一分钱都会被拦截。 4. 原始凭证留存与穿透核对：日记账分录可直接关联并弹窗预览本地的 PDF 发票与银行回单原件，账证合一。 5. 本地快照与加密备份：内置 Git 自动版本快照，并集成 Restic 支持将账本与凭证加密增量备份到本地其他硬盘或 S3 兼容存储（R2 / MinIO / AWS S3）。 6. 报税与付款日程提醒：支持导入或订阅 .ics 日历，关键申报节点提前桌面提醒。 界面预览 试算平衡与经营大盘： 标准现金流量表： 交易明细与原始凭证穿透： 项目采用 AGPL-3.0 协议完全免费开源，希望能帮到同样在折腾一人公司或小微企业经营的朋友。感谢阮老师审阅！

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Droidline，用几行代码让安卓手机自己动起来，不用 ADB 和 root
projects.author: KnifeLemon

github.name: KnifeLemon/Droidline
github.description: Android automation from code. Test your apps on real phones, script the tasks you repeat, run a shelf of phones, or let an AI agent use one, from Python, Node.js, the CLI, HTTP or Appium clients. No ADB, no USB cable, no root.

projects.summary: 手机装一个应用，扫码和电脑配对一次，之后电脑上的 Python、Node.js、C# 代码或命令行就能通过 Wi-Fi 操作手机：按文字找到按钮点下去、输入文字、截图、读取通知。不用开 USB 调试，不用 root，免费开源。 能做什么 在真机上测试自己的应用，包括跨应用的流程，比如登录时去短信里拿验证码（Android 14 及以下，15 起系统会隐藏通知里的验证码） 读取通知并处理，比如银行到账通知一来，就自动把订单标记为已收款 同一个脚本同时跑在多部手机上。手机可以和电脑在同一个 Wi-Fi，也可以用移动数据通过隧道或自建中继连回来，全程端到端加密 交给 AI：自带 MCP 服务器，Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 这类 AI 可以看手机屏幕并操作 命令行也能用，比如 droidline touch text "设置" 怎么做的 电脑端是 Go 写的服务器，手机端是 Kotlin 写的无障碍服务。找元素这一步直接在手机上完成，不像 adb + uiautomator 那样每次都把整个界面导出成 XML 文件再读回电脑。在 Galaxy S23 Ultra 上按文字找一个元素，10 次中位数是 16 ms，Appium UiAutomator2 是 100 ms，adb + uiautomator 是 2,368 ms。 所有命令写在一份规格文件里，Python、Node.js、C# SDK、命令行和 MCP 工具都从它生成，所以 touch 在哪里都叫 touch。 踩过的一个坑：一开始内置了开关 Wi-Fi、飞行模式的命令，做法是打开系统设置去点按钮。结果每家厂商、每个 Android 版本、每种语言的按钮文字都不一样，光是三星的韩文系统就把飞行模式叫“搭乘飞机模式”，小屏手机上要点的那一项还在屏幕外面。最后把这些命令删了，改成文档里的示例，按自己手机上的文字改一下就能用。关 Wi-Fi 这种会断开连接的步骤，可以放进 batch 交给手机离线执行，重新连上后再把结果交回来。 下载 应用和电脑端： （Android 9 及以上；电脑支持 Windows、macOS、Linux） SDK：pip install droidline、npm install droidline、dotnet add package Droidline 文档：

projects.title: Show HN: BraiNOTES, handwritten notes on your lecture PDFs in a browser tab
projects.author: swimmingbrain

github.name: swimmingbrain/brainotes
github.description: Handwritten notes and a whiteboard in your browser. Write with a pen, keep the pdf next to your notes. No account, nothing leaves the browser.

projects.summary: In August, I posted here about TeXbrain, a LaTeX editor that runs completely in the browser, with no need for an account or server. (I didn't excpect it to get that much feedback, bug reports and help from here!) This is the same idea for the other half of my studies, the handwritten notes. I take them on a convertible laptop, and I've had a hard time with apps for that, taking notes from a device to another, exporting as PDF, needing an account for many of them, etc. So I've been working on the version of it that I always wanted. Open a tab, the slides of the lecture or multiple PDFs open next to the page or even become the page, write on them with my pen, and nothing ever leaves my browser. braiNOTES is a static website and has no backend. Strokes are perfect-freehand outlines which support pen pressure, the PDF files are rendered by pdf.js in a worker, and for storage it uses IndexedDB a moment after every change. No account, no analytics, and completely offline and local-first. You can export notebooks as .brainotes files, which in the background is a zip with one json per page + the PDFs and pictures you import. It keeps the original pages and puts the vectorized ink on top, this way the text stays selectable in the slides. You can try it here: https://notes.swimmingbrain.dev GitHub Repo: https://github.com/swimmingbrain/brainotes (MIT) In Study mode, the PDF opens on the side of the tab, you can read it simultaneously to the notes, snip a formula or diagrams directly into the notes with the snip tool, and then write around it. In Board mode, you have just a Whiteboard for tutoring or simply for more place for exercises, and can also highlight or draw things with the laser pointer tool while presenting. The line of the ink appears the moment the pen moves, and a one euro filter calms shaky hands while you write + a light a refit when you lift the pen. I also have a video editor and an animation tool which are still a work in progress, on the same GitHub profile. I'm also working on a MCP server for each tool, so you can use your MCP client to do further things with your notes, automatically edit videos on the video editor, etc. That feature will of course be off unless you turn it on and will only be able to talk to localhost. I've used this tool for every lecture in the last few months and a few friends use it too. Bug reports, fixes, recommendations, feedback are all welcome!

projects.author: mbicecode-ctrl

github.name: auten-ai/auten-mcp
github.description: Computer-use MCP server: give Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client hands on a real screen: your computer (Mac/Windows/Linux) and your Android phone (beta). Clicks, types and reads the screen, even in apps with no API.

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一下我们做的 Auten，一个 computer-use MCP 服务器。 AI 编程助手很会写代码，但遇到没有 API 的软件就没办法了：桌面客户端、老的后台系统、只能在手机 App 里完成的操作。Auten 给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或任何 MCP 客户端一双"手"：在真实屏幕上点击、输入、读取内容。支持你的电脑（macOS / Windows / Linux X11），以及通过 USB 连接的 Android 手机（beta）。 几个设计点： 优先读取系统的无障碍树（accessibility tree）：智能体拿到的是带编号的真实按钮和输入框（listelements 然后 clickat(3)），而不是猜坐标。没有无障碍信息的 App 再用 OCR 和截图。 任务做成一次后可以保存为技能（skill）。下次重放不调用模型、不消耗 token，几秒完成；界面变了会自己修复。 密码保存在本机（macOS / Windows 钥匙串，Linux 本地私有保险库）。filllogin 在本机直接填入，模型看不到明文。 安装（第一步装本地运行程序，Linux 上会用一次 sudo 安装依赖）： bash curl -fsSL | bash claude mcp add -s user auten -- npx -y @autenai/mcp AI 用你自己的（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或自己的 API key），Auten 只负责"手"。免费版每月 30 分钟运行时间，不用绑卡；付费版目前是早期价格。界面和文档暂时只有英文。说明一下：本地运行程序不开源，GitHub 仓库里是 MIT 协议的 npm 启动器、各客户端配置和文档。

projects.title: Show HN: OpenWants – A Simulated City Where AI Agents Handle Residents Needs
projects.author: ddaniel10
projects.summary: Iv'e been working on this for a while. Most of the effort went into what i call "sophisticated simplicity", keep the idea in the smallest version that still works. This one is a bit personal. it can feel like some sci-fi thing, but i've been obsessed with it for a very long time. its not a "business" that you used to see here speak about moat or tam, its more like an experiment, a way of me to take one question seriously and see where it leads and if there are others like me out there. AI models are on a path to keep getting better and better, personal ai agents are spreading fast, and we're starting to see "ghost" agents that handle the things for people they don't want to do themselves. the question i keep coming back to is this: if every one of us has a powerful brain in our pocket, do we still need all the infrastructure we built to connect people's needs? im talking about those services like uber,airbnb,indeed,doordash,tinder,zillow,amazon and many more. or would agents just need one shared place to find each other, and that's it? So i built a simulated city to explore that. it has AI residents that live there with stats like hunger, energy, and money. each resident has its own ai agent, and it has one shared list where agents write down what everyone wants and then work on our behalf to make it happen. that could mean delivering food, giving rides, or finding jobs, relationships, apartments, customers and almost anything else. honestly, the city works much better than I expected, and you can watch some surprisingly advanced interactions unfold between people and agents through the list on the right side. all the conversations and actions are real, everything happens with each person managed by llm with minimal context, just to live like us and context of stats. A simple example: A restaurant tells its agent, find me customers so the agent writes to the list, "Salina restaurant in SF, selling burgers from 8:00 to 10:00, i want customers" A delivery guy tells his agent when he wakes up, "I want to work in delivery now. find me jobs. status: free" A person at home tells their agent "i want to eat burger. order for me from salina" the person's agent acts as the middleman and searches the list for salina, it finds their item and sees the way to connect with them and contact. the person's agent and the restaurant agent close the deal, and then the restaurant agent looks for available delivery guys in the list and speaks with his agent to come pick it up. Another thing i checked is with my friends: we took 3 agents, one for each one, and gave them different sophisticated scenarios, and the agents handled the scenarios in a way i couldn't have imagined. you can try it by yourself, the product is fully functioning, and you can just copy-paste the skill and test it also with your friends. That's it, you can see it in the simulated city it happens like magic over and over again. the list of the city is in the simulator itself and also using my real product behind it openwants.com the repo is in https://github.com/openwants/maplehill -- technically, it's surprisingly simple. every agent publishes an md file describing a "want". other agents find it, message each other, and update the file live or remove it from the list. the file holds everything needed, all in free text: what's wanted, the live location, geofence for where its needed. all those algorithms built over years to connect us are no longer needed. ai, instead of software with rules, can figure out the best route and path on the spot. all we need is to align all agents to one shared data source, so billions of agents will update it and maintain it in the most sophisticated smart way no algorithm will ever be able to do. that’s it. i hope it inspires you as much as it inspires me

So we spent a year building the features in APIblaze: A serverless MCP and API gateway. Here’s what makes it different: - Authorization. Most gateways stop at authentication: they check who is calling. What they can and cannot do is left to your code or a plugin connecting to some sort of complex Authorization system. APIblaze provides users & groups management and enforces Authorization policies at the gateway, as a default suggested from your API spec. You add groups and write Authorization rules in plain English ("only whoever created a record, or an admin, can read or change that record"), tested and enforced by the gateway. - Hosted end to end. APIblaze hosts the MCP server, the gateway, OAuth discovery and the login pages on the internet. One thing we really wanted to make easy was local development so the hosted API gateway forwards the requests to your backend, even if this backend runs on your localhost. So you can connect Claude/ChatGPT/… to the hosted MCP, bring your own oAuth and log into it (which is important because MCPs are all about taking actions and you have to know “who” is taking those actions), chat with your API to test it, and change your code live while the calls stream in your terminal. - UI widgets: self-service API keys, users and groups and chat window. A drop-in React widget lets your users create, rotate and revoke their own keys on the developer section of your site. Another lets your customers' admins manage their own users and groups. A last one lets end users chat with your API on your App. - Multi-tenant. Each customer gets its own keys, users, portal and MCP address to serve their own service to their end-users. - The usual gateway tools: rate limits and quotas, transformations, custom domains and more. - No lock-in: one command exports your setup (config, users, groups, and API keys as hashes so your callers keep theirs) to a runnable Kong bundle once you outgrow APIblaze. To try it, paste this prompt into Claude Code or Codex, in an empty folder (you get a sample app) or in your backend's folder: > Show me what APIblaze does using npx apiblaze skills Or by hand, no sign-up needed: npx apiblaze create --target https://ninopizzas.com/openapi.yaml It's in beta. I'd love your feedback, what you like and what you don't.

projects.title: Show HN: Pocketty – iPhone SSH terminal that pings you when an agent is blocked
projects.author: lukeed
projects.summary: Hello~! pocketty is an SSH terminal for iPhone and iPad, made for herdr. herdr keeps your agent panes alive on your computer and knows the state of each one: working, needs you, or done. I made this in anger/desperation for the latter half of my recent paternity leave. Nap traps are sweet, but there's only so much doom-scrolling and movie-watching I can handle... In any event, I've been using it for the last couple months and no longer have to be my desk anymore to be productive. Now the nap-traps are still productive (when i want them to be) ! How it works: - The app talks to your computer directly over plain SSH. Tailscale is the easy way to reach it from anywhere but any SSH host you can reach works. - A small Rust daemon on the host watches herdr. When a pane needs you, it seals the alert to your phone's key with HPKE (X25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305). A stateless relay (pocketty's) on Cloudflare Workers passes the sealed bytes to APNs (Apple Push Notification servers), and a notification extension opens them on the phone. The relay can't read them and keeps nothing. - Your SSH key is made in the Secure Enclave and can't be exported. - The terminal uses libghostty-vt for state and draws with wgpu on Metal, so full-screen TUIs look like they do on your desk, albeit narrower. - Diffs for each agent turn, a file browser, and previews of `localhost` dev servers your agent starts, all through the same SSH connection. No port forwarding to set up. herdr and the daemon are optional. Without them, it's a normal SSH client. There's no account to set up and no analytics or tracking in the app. The app runs a 14-day free trial, with full feature access. Then, if you're as happy as I am with it, then it can be yours forever with a one-time purchase: $99 for the first two weeks (launch promo) then $129 after that. Happy to answer anything about the sealed push setup or running libghostty on iOS.

projects.title: OhMyGame 开源 10 天拿到 936 个 star 的一个小复盘
projects.author: dihuanginfo
projects.summary: 我们团队最近开源了一个 AI 游戏创作工具 [OhMyGame]( https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame)，主打“开源的一人 AI 游戏工作室”：用户描述自己的想法，Agent 完成游戏设计、生成资产，再进行开发和测试。 我们把 Canvas 和游戏工作流整合在一起，希望让素材生成、编辑和游戏开发的过程更直观。 ![OhMyGame 首页]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-home-overview.jpg) 我们是一个不自带流量的小团队。开源前 10 天，项目拿到了 936 个 star 。想把这段时间的数字、流量来源和用户反馈分享一下，也想请教大家：发布最初一波热度过去后，怎么继续让项目被需要它的人看到？ ## 先说数字 这 10 天里： - 936 个 star ，113 个 fork 。 - 发布了 11 个版本，从 beta.3 到 beta.4.9 。 - 合并了 131 个 PR 。 - 用户提了 36 个 issue ，已经关闭了 26 个。 - 没有投流，主要靠 X 上的内容传播。 下面是这段时间的 star 增长曲线： ![OhMyGame 开源前 10 天的 Star 增长曲线]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-star-history.webp) [查看增长曲线动画]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-star-history.mp4) ## 关注从哪里来？ 我看了 GitHub 的仓库访问数据，这 10 天总共有 3,648 位访客。前五个访问来源分别是： - X：1,194 位访客。 - GitHub 站内：359 位访客。 - 官网 ohmygame.ai：326 位访客。 - Google：208 位访客。 - V2EX：138 位访客。 X 一个渠道带来的访客，比后面四个来源加起来还多，占这五个来源合计的约 54%。 这里统计的是仓库访客来源，不是各渠道带来的 star 数，也不是全部访客的来源占比。 比较明显的两次增长，分别发生在两条 X 帖子传播之后。 **第一次是开源首发帖。** 开源当晚 11 点多，团队成员 Dogxi 发了项目介绍，目前有约 3 万次浏览。 刚发出时没什么动静，第二天早上 7 点左右才开始明显增长，到傍晚新增了大约 300 个 star 。 ![Dogxi 在 X 上发布的首发帖]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-x-launch-post.webp) **第二次是 Hyper3D 合作帖。** 10 月 10 日晚上，我发了介绍 Hyper3D 合作的帖子，目前有约 2.2 万次浏览。帖子点赞持续增加，第二天仓库又增长了约 180 个 star 。 ![Hyper3D 合作帖]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-x-hyper3d-post.webp) 不过，到了 16 号以后，增长就慢下来了，三天涨了 48 个。 这次比较直接的感受是：至少对我们这个项目来说，外部内容传播带来的关注很明显，GitHub 站内也有流量，但没有自动带来持续增长。 ## 这 10 天，我们怎么回应用户反馈？ 我们尽量第一时间回复用户，并尽快修复问题、补上需要的功能。举三个具体例子： **1. 简体中文界面** 有人提出需要简体中文界面，3 天后就在 beta.4.7 中上线了。 对应 issue： https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues/134 **2. 撤回 Agent 的一轮操作** 有人希望 Agent 改坏了之后能退回去。 4 天后发布的 beta.4.9 支持了这个功能：Agent 每轮操作后会列出修改过的文件，用户可以一键撤回。 对应 issue： https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues/202 **3. Windows 上的 bug** 有人报告示例项目在 Windows 上没法 remix ，37 分钟后修复就合并了，当天随 beta.4.2 发了出去。 对应 issue： https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues/122 目前我们很大一部分开发工作，就是围绕这些真实反馈展开的。 ## 用户已经做出了什么？ 贴几个用户作品。下面的图片可以点击，打开对应的实机录屏。 **Hunter Space：低多边形风格的 3D 野外探索** [![Hunter Space]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-hunter-space.webp)]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-hunter-space.mp4) **Windmere Highlands：在高地草甸和石阵间奔跑** [![Windmere Highlands]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-windmere-highlands.webp)]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-windmere-highlands.mp4) **第一人称恐怖走廊，Backrooms 风格** [![Backrooms 风格恐怖走廊]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-backrooms.webp)]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-backrooms.mp4) **2D 弓箭手放置游戏，带技能树和掉落** [![2D 弓箭手放置游戏]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-archer.webp)]( https://www.dihuang.me/assets/blog/ohmygame-user-archer.mp4) ## 为什么做这个？ 我自己是 3D 视觉和图形学出身，一直想做和游戏有关的事。 做了前面几个应用之后，我越来越觉得，还是要做自己有感觉的东西。否则遇到困难时，很难一直坚持下去。 选择开源，也是希望大家能用更便宜、更简单的方式创造游戏，和用户一起把工具慢慢做好。 感谢给项目点 star 、提交 issue 和 PR 的朋友，也感谢 Hyper3D 提供赞助，让用户能体验到 3D 生成能力。 ## 接下来 近期我们在研究直接接入 Codex 和 Claude Code 的 CLI ，也会完善互动叙事和插件相关的支持。 更长期还想支持多人游戏、Unity 、Unreal ，以及更多创作工作流。这些还在计划中，需要一步步做。 - GitHub： https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame - 官网： https://ohmygame.ai - 完整博客： https://www.dihuang.me/blog/ohmygame-10-days

projects.title: Show HN: Railcode – Secure cloud for internal software
projects.author: yakkomajuri
projects.summary: Hey HN, Yakko here from Railcode. Railcode is like an internal Vercel for your company. We built it after speaking to dozens of engineering leaders at various companies where employees were given access to Claude Code or Codex and started to build little tools (apps, agents) locally, but then struggled to share it with coworkers securely. Typical scenarios are: 1. Employees can't share what they've built because of internal policies 2. Agents find the path of least resistance and deploy things on e.g. Vercel, leading to a sprawl of software that's a nightmare to manage (disjointed auth or no auth, API keys handled insecurely, no centralized management, etc.) 3. Companies set up templates to ensure some standardization but still require engineers in the loop to review and deploy code Neither of these options felt great, so we built Railcode to be the place to deploy and manage internal software inside a company, ensuring projects are deployed securely, follow the same patterns, and can be easily managed from one place. The goal is to unblock users to deploy and share what they've built while removing the burden on Engineering/DevOps to review and manage it all. How we do this: - Company auth in front of everything that's deployed - Permissioned connectors to access data instead of shared API keys - Infrastructure building blocks that make it easy to store data or use an LLM but allows admins to oversee everything (via a simple SDK) - Centralized audit logs - Unified design system (optional) - Role-based access control with granular permissions that can be inherited by the projects themselves The platform is built to be really low friction for agents and to not require folks changing their workflows. We support static frontends and serverless JS functions for the backend, meaning Tanstack, Hono, Vite, React, etc will all work. Even Next.js with OpenNext though that has some quirks :D Projects run locally and everything Railcode-specific comes from an optional SDK. We ship a skill and a CLI and that's all you need to build and deploy projects or have agents manage configuration. Keen to hear feedback! https://railcode.dev/

projects.title: Show HN: Abyss – ACP Agent Isolation with Middleware Support
projects.author: everforward
projects.summary: [Abyss]( https://abyss.scurry.io/ ) is my take on a local-first agent containerization framework for ACP agents. It aims to neatly solve 2 issues: 1. Agents having full access to your desktop, and thus indiscriminate access to your files/secrets/etc. 2. Agent/harness features having to be re-implemented for each agent, even if the feature isn't tied to the specific agent in any way. The former is largely self-explanatory, I think. I want to log into my bank, I don't want my agent to even have the ability. There's a fair bit of software in this space already. I'll loop back to the advantages of Abyss' containerization vs others in a second, but the 30,000 foot overview is that Abyss runs your agent in a Docker container and proxies the ACP connection so it works with Zed/Openclaw/whatever. The second is the more interesting and novel (as far as I'm aware). The current zeitgeist is heavily agent-specific, even for features that only read/manipulate the context (which isn't agent-specific). If you want RAG, you're writing an agent-specific plugin. If you want subagents, you're writing an agent-specific plugin even though a subsession is really just context. As a user, that can leave you tied to a particular agent just so your plugins continue to work. Abyss solves that by taking a page from Nginx's book. Abyss supports WASM-based plugins that have full access to read and manipulate ACP messages flowing back and forth. Plugins can hide secrets in prompts from users before the agent ever sees them, implicitly hydrate prompts with RAG, inject MCP servers and more. There's a diagram showing what the flow of messages look like [in the docs]( https://abyss.scurry.io/docs/guides/04-plugins/02-developing... ), and there's a sample plugin [in the repo]( https://github.com/SethCurry/abyss/tree/main/plugins/secrets... ) that will auto-cancel a session if the agent outputs an OpenRouter API key in tool calls and responses (sample screenshot [on this page]( https://abyss.scurry.io/docs/guides/what-is-abyss/#i-am-not-... )). Plugins currently only run on the host, mostly because I haven't written something to install/distribute them inside the containers that's better than an 8GB Docker image or forcing users to make a custom Docker image. Current Features: - Fully agent-agnostic: pre-build images exist for Pi, Hermes, Claude and Codex but it works with any agent that supports ACP - Supports both bind-mounting host directories and having Abyss copy files in on startup (so the agent can see them but can't change your copy) - Includes pathing support to mount them at the same path as on the host so your `@file.md` references still work - Supports startup scripts, so you can add Node/Go/Rust/etc to your agent container without having to write a Dockerfile - Manages the full Docker lifecycle; point Zed at Abyss and Abyss handles creating/stopping containers, mounting directories, etc - Agent containers can be ephemeral or persistent - Persistent containers leave the agent running; running Abyss will re-connect to a running container (or create one if it doesn't exist) - Ephemeral containers are created and then torn down every time you invoke Abyss, giving you a consistent environment for batch-type jobs - WASM plugins allow creating functionality reusable across agents - Connections between your editor and the agent are encrypted and use mutual TLS for authentication - Certificates are ephemeral, and each container gets its own certs (they are single-use for ephemeral containers) Future Wishlist: - Backends other than Docker (most of this isn't Docker-specific, just a first target) - Remote backends (requires figuring out how to make something bind-mount-ish work on remote hosts) Feedback, feature requests and bug supports are welcome!

projects.title: Show HN: Binance futures order book history from 3 nodes, with a public gap log
projects.author: pentelicus
projects.summary: Hi HN. CandleFeed is a small API for crypto derivatives data (funding, open interest, liquidations). We wanted to test execution ideas against what the Binance book looked like, and commercial tick data cost more than we could justify for one venue, so in June we started recording it. Three nodes record USD-M depth@100ms diff stream, the trade stream, and a 1,000-level REST snapshot every 5 minutes. Two are in Tokyo on different providers and one is in Singapore. A nightly job merges them: an update from a second node only goes in where Binance's update-id chain (pu equals the previous u) stays continuous, and where nodes overlap, their copies have to match, or the day is held back. Anything all three missed goes into a public gap log. The largest trade gap so far: on 2026-08-19 at about 15:28 UTC, all three nodes lost the same 32,153 trades across ten symbols, about 4 to 5.5 seconds' worth depending on the symbol. A surprise: on 2026-09-25, 848 of the 861 BTCUSDT snapshots our three nodes took landed partway through a diff event. (That count comes from the nodes' raw copies; the published snapshot file carries one node's snapshots.) Replay has to apply that "straddling" event in full, so we tag every snapshot clean, straddle or in_gap. Try it without an account: `curl https://candlefeed.ai/api/v1/l2/sample ` lists the two open days, BTCUSDT and DOTUSDT book data for 2026-10-01. In Python, after `pip install "candlefeed[l2]>=0.3.2"`, run `from candlefeed import CandleFeed` and then `CandleFeed(public=True).download_l2_sample("DOTUSDT", "2026-10-01", "data/")`. That downloads the DOT day (about 100 MB) and checks every file's SHA-256. Sample files, with or without an account, are for internal use under our Terms ( https://candlefeed.ai/terms , §5.3), so please don't re-host them. With a free account, the 1st of each month is free for every symbol (10 GiB a month). Pro is $149/mo for the full archive. Our MCP server, candlefeed-mcp (`pip install candlefeed-mcp`, https://pypi.org/project/candlefeed-mcp/ ), lets Claude Code or Cursor pull a day and rebuild the book from a prompt; it needs a free API key. There's also a notebook that does it in plain Python on the 2026-10-01 BTCUSDT sample. It uses a free API key too; for a no-account run, swap its download call for `download_l2_sample`: https://candlefeed.ai/examples/l2-free-sample-day/ What's weak: one venue, 25 symbols (10 with history from June 2026, 15 from late September), and we can't backfill what we didn't record. It's also the 100ms stream, not Binance's fastest.

projects.title: Show HN: Rhyven – A marketplace for agents
projects.author: calebrhyven
projects.summary: My name is Caleb and I am the creator of rhyven marketplace. Why did I make it: I create and use a lot of mcps for my daily job. I noticed that most mcps did not have much uniformity and a lot of them were to connect to platforms with large UIs for humans even though agents are the only one using them now. So I thought why not make apps for agents to improve the end human user's experience, in both using and trying new apps. From this rhyven became two things. 1. A marketplace for primarily headless apps, although this is not a hard restriction. 2. A sort of extendable harness/tool kit for llms with or without a harness. One of the main things that sets rhyven apart from other new and old tool/plugin systems, is the focus on agents installing (with user permission) and creating their own tools. Meaning as the agent discovers it needs a tool it can make it thus avoiding long repetitive tasks, saving time and tokens for itself and, if posted, other agents as well. So instead of the user having to find and choose tools, the agent can form its own sort of self improvement loop as it works. The unified format and schema we have created lends itself to this agent development first model. Many helpful agent skills are provided with the marketplace download, which currently relies on an install script in the public github. Packaged forms are being worked on. Please reach out with any questions or feedback. I would love to see the apps other people and their agents come up with.

projects.title: Show HN: Etchv – API for invisible watermarks in images, PDFs and videos
projects.author: agurha
projects.summary: Hello HN! The inspiration for Etchv came directly from friends who raised concerns about the growing ease of unauthorized media copying without attribution. To address this, Etchv embeds an invisible watermark inside images, PDFs, or short videos that survives modifications like screenshots, format changes, and file compression. You can try it on our homepage without signing up. There's also a live demo where a watermarked PDF page gets screenshotted and the watermark ID is still successfully recovered: https://etchv.com/demo/trace Instead of training a model from scratch, our model is custom-trained on a blend of the COCO Dataset and a collection of proprietary datasets optimized to mimic real-world media variations. On 208 test photos, the watermark survived the shrinking and compression that a social feed or chat app applies, every time. Tiny thumbnails mostly killed it—only 16 of 208 survived. Full benchmark results can be found here: https://etchv.com/solutions/creative-delivery#survival Limits: video is restricted to short clips for now (a few seconds at 360p), and PDFs max out at 8 pages. Additionally, someone who knows what they're doing can always remove the mark. We offer an API with official SDKs in six languages, as well as an MCP server you can integrate directly into your workflow.

I was very impressed with Opus 5.5 overall, with all the animation, motion graphics and everything. But I did not realize connecting it to the DaVinci Resolve MCP can create complete edited YouTube videos just by me dropping some raw files into a folder! It's not completely zero effort - Claude gives me options of different takes that I should pick (it figures out which options to show). But it's crazy how good it's getting to. I thought it was just me talking to Claude and everything just gets done by the MCP. But the MCP only lets Claude run scripts inside Resolve, everything else (transcribing, picking the cuts, the graphics, the music) is stuff Claude built up over my last three videos. That’s what’s in the repo. My first video took a bit longer, the last one (a baboon reel) took 57 minutes. Just a heads up, I’m sure many of you will find the videos a bit shitty, and I totally understand that - I'm still new at it. But without these tools I would probably procrastinate and never post videos on YouTube. So these mediocre videos I can make with the help of Claude are much better than me trying to perfect it by hand and never posting. Thought this might be helpful for others who are considering posting things as well. projects.title: Show HN: Privatrak – no-code, privacy-first product analytics
projects.author: qwend
projects.summary: Hi HN! Quick story how it started: I was a freelance web developer in the past and also worked for several companies on web applications. For some projects we didn’t have analytics at all and we had to ask ourselves too many times what our users actually use in the product. Finding a good solution was painful, since we couldn’t use a consent banner (a lot of customers from the government) and existing tools were hard to set up so nobody took the time. I started with this idea already many years ago, but only really got to develop it in the past year. So what is Privatrak? A product tracking tool which is simple to set up and doesn’t require any code for most use cases. It can be used just by tagging elements on your site in the browser. From that, funnels and analytics dashboards can be created. I also wanted to make it as easy as possible to use with AI agents, hence there is a MCP server which can be used to question the data and set up the project (every change an AI agent makes is tracked and can also easily be undone). It doesn’t store any sensitive user data and can be used without a consent banner or cookies. Sessions are calculated based on a hash that consists of the users IP address + user agent + random rotating salt (IP address and user agent are never stored) and are aggregated for each day, so the data basically only points at a group of users in the end. In many cases this is fine. Often you are only curious about a specific feature or trends and not what a specific user did. If you need to track people over multiple days or need session replays, this is not the right tool. My main goal in posting here is to get some feedback for the product. Is the daily cutoff for sessions a dealbreaker for you? I just launched it and currently only have a handful of people actually using it. I built a demo project for everybody to see how it looks without having to sign up: https://demo.privatrak.com/

projects.title: [自荐] 大家都在把 AI 塞进 Obsidian，我却反过来把 Obsidian 接进 AI 官网
projects.author: errah
projects.summary: 最近这两年，Obsidian 结合 AI 的主流方向基本都很一致：把 AI 接进 Obsidian 。 做聊天侧栏、模型选择、API Key 、RAG 、Agent 、知识库…… 这个方向当然没问题，而且有些开源插件确实也做得非常强。但我自己折腾了一圈以后才发现：**我其实并不想在 Obsidian 里养 AI 。** 我平时本来就在高频用 ChatGPT 、Claude 、Gemini 的官方网页版。那里有我最习惯的 UI 、历史对话记录、文件上传功能，我也已经付了订阅费。而本地的额度很宝贵，我可不敢在 codex 随便喂几篇 ob 笔记然后聊上半个钟头。 所以对我来说，要在 Obsidian 里再维护一套 API Key 、Token 额度、模型配置和新的聊天入口，并没有让我很踏实。因为我总要考虑很多：这插件走哪个接口？这模型支持多模态传图吗？账户余额还有多少？ token 够不够？... 所以，**我真正想要的不是“把 AI 搬进 Obsidian”，而是我已经整理进 Obsidian 里的资料和附件，能不能一键丝滑的丢到 AI 官网里？** --- ### 随后问题就来了 如果只是纯文本笔记，直接复制 md 文件也能凑合用。但让我抓狂的是带图片和各种附件的笔记。 比如我的很多笔记，下面挂着十几张图片，有时还挂着 PDF 或视频。 ![图片描述]( https://i.imgur.com/Ndx6MvG.png) 现在我要把它丢给 Gemini 或 ChatGPT ，不管全选复制还是干脆目录里 copy md 文件，附件内容只有本地路径： ![图片描述]( https://i.imgur.com/GvAzPV1.png) 然后我只能苦逼的回到 attachment 文件夹，从文件堆里把它们一张张翻出来，再拖进浏览器。 ![图片描述]( https://i.imgur.com/hXXVEnq.png) 搞了几次后，我觉得这个流程太反人类了。于是就自己写了一个小工具：**NoteFerry**。 ### 核心思路：只搭桥，不改造 Obsidian 它的理念和当下众多 Obsidian AI 插件刚好相反： **不把 AI 搬进 Obsidian ，而是把 Obsidian 搬进网页 AI 对话框。** 使用非常简单。打开 ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini 网页： 点击输入框旁边的 `+` 号 → `从 Obsidian 添加` → 选笔记 → 添加。结束。 ![图片描述]( https://i.imgur.com/KGrceJX.gif) NoteFerry 会把笔记正文、图片甚至里面引用的 PDF 、Word 、表格等附件，一次性打包塞进 AI 的输入框里。每次最多可以选 10 篇。 ![图片描述]( https://i.imgur.com/wcXX9Oi.png) 没有第三方 AI 聊天窗口，不做整库 RAG ，不做代理自动发消息。 **Obsidian 继续负责存，AI 官网继续负责聊。我只负责把中间那段最恶心的“搬运动作”给干掉。** --- ### 技术实现 系统由两部分组成：Chrome 或 Edge 浏览器扩展 (NoteFerry) + Obsidian 社区插件 (NoteFerry Companion)。 ![图片描述]( https://i.imgur.com/oRvPl54.png) 当然，隐私和机制是必须说清楚的： **纯本地通信** 浏览器扩展和 Obsidian 插件之间是通过本地协议直接通信的。完全没有中间服务器参与。 **不收集数据** 没有账号系统，没有 Telemetry 。我不会收到你的 Vault 路径、搜索词、文件名或笔记内容。 **只读不写** 原始 Obsidian 文件绝对不会被修改，仅仅是读取并注入到你当前打开的 AI 网页前端。 --- ### 获取与定价 因为实在受够了万物皆订阅，所以我设定了**一次性买断**（国内 ¥49 ），可以在 2 台机器使用，没有连续包月包年。 安装后，前 10 次成功添加免费（搜索、预览都不扣次数，只有文件真正进入 AI 对话框才算一次）。 **官网下载** https://noteferry.dev/zh **Obsidian 插件** https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/noteferry-companion **GitHub** https://github.com/lancelee2026/Obsidian-Companion *(注：为保证本地读取的安全性，Companion 插件是完全开源的，接受社区 Review ；浏览器扩展暂不开源)* --- 最后，发在 V 站也是想看看，有没有一批和我一样的人： **重度使用 Obsidian ，同时重度依赖网页端 AI ，但就是不想在笔记软件里再套娃一个 AI 。** 如果大家平时有其他高效率的 “Obsidian → 网页 AI” 工作流，非常欢迎在帖子里交流。我越来越觉得：AI 和笔记软件，有时候不一定非得谁吞并谁，把中间那座桥修好，可能就够了。

projects.title: Show HN: Singularity – memory that makes coding agents cheaper on repeat work
projects.author: luvmakin
projects.summary: Coding agents start every session from zero. Ask Claude Code for a change like one it made last week and it reads the same files again, falls into the same test traps again, and you pay for all of it again. Singularity learns from your finished sessions (change committed, tests passing): where each kind of change goes in this repo, how it gets checked, and the mistakes made along the way. When the next task starts, a hook hands the agent the workflows that fit, pointed at the code as it is today. Picking them is plain text matching with no model call. It stores where to edit, never the code itself. Results, medians of 3–4 runs per side, hidden tests decide pass/fail, every run passed. On excalidraw: - A long task with four changes, all of kinds memory had learned: 1.9M → 423k tokens, $0.81 → $0.30, 28.5 → 9.5 turns. - The same kind of task, but two of the four changes were bugs it had never seen: 39% fewer tokens, 38% lower cost. The unseen bugs cost the same with or without memory. - Where it doesn't help: small tasks in validator.js and one-off bug fixes. The difference there is about zero, within noise. Each measurement was written down before it was run. The plans and results are in the repo. Caveats: 3–4 runs per side, mostly one repo. Only Claude Code sessions are learned from; Codex, Gemini CLI and Droid get the hand-over through their hooks. Learning uses your Claude account (about $0.25 a round, capped at $1 a day, and only if you opt in). Everything is stored locally in ~/.singularity. Install (Windows PowerShell and more options in the README): curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pandacover/singularity/main/install.sh | sh I'd love to hear where it breaks on your repos, and what memory should carry for one-off work like bug fixes.

projects.title: Show HN: Agent.reviews – Where AI agents read and write reviews on tools
projects.author: screm
projects.summary: Hi HN! I’m Louis, Co-Founder of Armature (YC P26), where we help teams make their product discoverable and usable by coding agents. We already measured 50k+ agent sessions and realized that over and over agents would encounter the exact same limitations on different tasks using the same tool. So we wondered why these weren’t fixed. And the answer is simple: the feedback loop just doesn’t exist between agents and software vendors but also between different agents. Humans can share their experience on platforms like https://g2.com and https://trustpilot.com , but agents have nowhere to. So we created: https://agent.reviews : the G2 for agents. It works with a set of skills and an npm CLI (@armature-tech/agent-reviews) connecting agents to our API endpoints. Anyone can ask their agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) to install it, and agents will naturally check reviews before picking a tool and post their own after using one. As usual, privacy was our main concern, so we added 3 layers before a review gets posted: Deterministic rules filtering secrets, PII, URLs, etc. A Jev classifier trained to detect any leak after the first check A small LLM checking each review to make sure nothing was missed We've been sharing this project around for a few weeks now and gathered thousands of reviews already. There are already interesting ones, for example: - A Claude Code agent noticed that the Stripe SDK systematically crashed when the API key was missing on the health check page (while it’s this page’s role to actually return an “API key missing” error) - 2 agents mentioned that Prisma required a DATABASE_URL variable even when it wasn’t connecting to any database. They both put fake URLs as a workaround, and it worked. We truly think the agent experience needs the same community effect user experience has, so everyone benefits from it: agents can pick the tools that are best optimized for them and software companies can improve their product based on real feedback. That’s why we made sure accessing reviews is free for both humans and agents and just requires copy/pasting one prompt for the agent to install our CLI & skill, start the authentication flow, and submit their first review (this helps us prevent unauthorized scraping and spam reviews). Would you let your agents submit and read reviews too? We’d love for you to set up agent reviews, ask your agent to check reviews next time it needs to pick a tool and post its own experience when using it. Then tell us how it went!

projects.author: rootSunc

github.description: 中国 A 股数据基础设施。55个日更数据集：股票行情、基本面、期货数据、资金面、公告事件、指数行业、宏观与风险。行级溯源、PIT 语义、复权与历史成分内置，MCP 原生。自托管，零注册、零 API Token

projects.summary: CNEquity 是一个开源、自托管的 A 股数据湖：把行情、财报、资金面、公司事件、宏观和期货期权等 55 个数据集采集到本地 Parquet，做增量更新、失败续跑和质量审计，再通过 Python、SQL、网页控制台和 MCP 统一查询。 做量化研究或回测时，常见的痛点是：每次都要重新拉数据、中断了要从头来、不知道这份数据是哪天从哪个接口拿的，以及最隐蔽的——用「今天还在交易的股票」去回测过去，悄悄漏掉了退市股（幸存者偏差），或者用了事后才披露的财报（未来函数）。CNEquity 把这些口径做进了数据层：退市股保留在历史股票池里，财报按 asof 只返回当时已披露的数据，原始价和复权因子分开存。 它也是一个 MCP 服务，可以把整个 A 股数据湖接给 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 助手，让 AI 直接用 SQL 查历史数据，回答里自带复权和覆盖口径。 核心功能 55 个数据集：日线 / 分钟线、复权因子、财报、估值、北向、融资融券、龙虎榜、公告、行业成分、宏观、期货期权与 Greeks 等 一分钟试用：cne init --profile demo 用真实数据源抓 5 只股票，立刻能查 研究口径正确：保留退市股、PIT 财报、复权方式查询时再选，每行带来源和版本 断点续跑：中断后重跑同一条命令，已下载的批次不会重来 网页控制台：cne serve 查看覆盖、新鲜度、质量，还能从页面发起日更和回填 接给 AI：cne mcp 提供 6 个只读工具（含 DuckDB SQL），支持 stdio 和 Streamable HTTP，已登记到官方 MCP Registry 中英文双语：文档和控制台都有中英文两套 快速开始 bash pip install cnequity cne init --profile demo # 约 1 分钟，建一个小 demo 湖 cne serve --config configs/cnequity.demo.toml # 打开网页控制台 完整的沪深京全市场：cne init（近 3 年，首次需要几个小时，可随时中断续跑）。 开源协议：Apache-2.0

projects.title: Show HN: agentc: <1mb static/no-libc, minimal, embeddable agent with Rust/C API
projects.author: logxroot
projects.summary: Sharing an agent that I built since most of the agents that's nice to work with, take hefty deps like node or is provider dependent. It's heavily inspired by the wonderful pi agent - and builds on it as something that you can run on tiny hardware or embed easily in your own binaries without needing it's hefty dependency chain. An agent doesn't really need much - a minimal networking stack, a TUI and an agent loop. Then comes tools, mcp, skills and prompts. agentc does exactly that - a minimal, static, embeddable coding agent in C - no libc, less than 1MB, starts up using <1MB of RAM, and RSS comfortably sits under a few MBs during usage. It's extensible and everything including status, mcp, tools is architected as an extension. The embeddable part is by design, but exposing it as an API is still a pending plan and should be done in a few days. Also: would love some human testing on a Mac! CI builds for: linux - x64, arm64, risv64; win - x64, arm64 and darwin - arm64.

projects.summary: 在浏览器中统一管理本地的 Codex、Claude Code、Kimi CLI 等 AI 编程 Agent，并通过钉钉或飞书机器人随时随地给它们派发任务、接收回复。 解决的痛点： 现在开发者往往同时装了多个 AI 编程 CLI（Codex、Claude Code、Pi、Kimi CLI、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Cursor Agent）。每个工具各开各的终端，会话分散、无法集中管理；想离开工位又没法继续跟进任务。 核心功能： 自动检测本机已安装的 Agent，按项目管理会话，支持 1/2/4 分屏同时对话 实时查看回复内容、工具调用、执行状态和 Token 用量 会话持久化保存，可随时恢复历史对话、停止运行中任务 通过钉钉 / 飞书机器人远程收发任务：扫码创建应用、私聊或群里 @机器人 派活，执行完自动把结果发回 IM 无需公网 webhook——基于钉钉 Stream SDK / 飞书 WebSocket 长连接，纯本地运行 IM 内置命令：/new、/projects、/project、/models、/model、/status、/help，可随时切换项目和模型 快速上手： bash npx agent-muster 浏览器自动打开 ，零配置开箱即用（要求 Node.js ≥ 22.19）。 典型场景： 下班前把任务丢给钉钉机器人，回家后直接在手机上查看 Agent 的执行结果；或让一个 Agent 跑长任务的同时，在浏览器分屏里继续用另一个 Agent 写别的代码。 协议： MIT

projects.summary: 一个开源的职场决策技能包，附一本 576 条的《高性价比职场指南》。装进 Claude Code、Codex 等支持 SKILL.md 的工具后，AI 会先在你本地的 book/ 目录里把相关条目查出来，再照书里的算法排序回答：工资少发了怎么要、年假没休完能换多少钱、被裁了能拿多少、公司让签「自愿放弃社保」签不签、竞业协议最短补偿是多少。每条都注明出自第几节第几条，查不到就说查不到，不凭记忆编数字。适合要自己算清账的打工人，也适合做劳动、社保、职场类内容的人当素材库。内容按中国大陆现行规定写，证据分 A/B/C 三级，A 级 518 条全部引法律、行政法规、部委规章和官方统计原文，885 处原文链接可逐条点回去核。 亮点 576 条、32 节，每条六个固定字段：成本、说人话、收益、证据等级、来源、备注。证据分级 A 518 / B 51 / C 7，A 级引的是法律法规、部委规章与官方统计原文，885 处链接能一条条回到原文 和网上绝大多数职场内容反着来：不给情绪给出处。查不到中立依据的宁可写「已检索，无可用依据」；各地不一样的地方一律写「按你所在省市当年公布的口径查」，不编全国统一值 四种成品全部由 Markdown 源文件自动生成：静态检索页（可按关键词、章节、证据等级筛，也能按「花不花钱、花多少时间、要不要毅力」三样筛）、离线单文件 HTML（微信里能直接传、双击就开）、PDF、EPUB 三份检查器守着产出，CI 每次提交都跑：体例（六字段齐全、条号连续、说人话 ≤120 字、禁止裸条号）、交叉引用（821 处引用必须指向真实存在的条目）、产出对齐（9 组，含 README 真实渲染、目录与文件名对位、EPUB 结构、离线语料）。fork 下来改坏格式，CI 当场报出来 构建链是纯 Markdown 源文件 + Python + pandoc + typst，fork 即可自建；换一套行业规则（医疗、教育、外贸）就能生成自己的一本 没做完的部分写在明处：只写「哪些信号必须去办」，不写「你这个情况该怎么处理」；各地不同的数字不给统一值，给查询方法

projects.title: Show HN: PanelAlpha Engine – Turn your VPS into a programmable hosting layer
projects.author: konradkeck
projects.summary: PanelAlpha Engine is an open-source hosting environment for your VPS, programmable through MCP, API and CLI. After ~2 years in the making (we started back in the non-ai era) we've decided to open source our Docker-based Engine. So far, we've used it as a back-end environment for WordPress sites and we have been distributing it through web hosting providers and larger agencies. It's been tested on a few thousand sites already. Now people are vibe coding, using AI for everything and building agentic workflows, while at the same time open source projects are getting through a reinassaince. So, not only we have open-sourced it ourselves, but we've also expanded it to support any web application and tested it against over a thousand repositories (and soon will be much more). You can use it with MCP, API or CLI to: - deploy projects from files or git - get a preview URL or use your own domain with automatic SSL - restrict access with a password - get built-in monitoring and visitor stats (no need for Google Analytics) - manage databases, SFTP/FTP, CRON, firewall rules - read through logs and debug - create or restore backups (locally or remotely via S3/FTP) - connect with Cloudflare (for tunnels and DNS) ... and much more (see docs). You install it with one command (you can also define a repo to be installed together with it) and then with another command connect your AI with it. Done. Your agent gets a hosting environment on your server without unrestricted root SSH access. You can even define its permissions. Our early users have asked us about the visual/panel - it will be available soon too (and also open source). Feel free to roast, we're open for feedback!

projects.title: Show HN: Monolith, an engine-building game about software startups
projects.author: chancelloradams
projects.summary: Hey HN, I'm sharing a game I've been building for the last few months. You run a tech company, starting with a few engineers and a Monolith. Requirements earn revenue, revenue unlocks funding, and funding hires more engineers. Let tech debt pile up or morale slide, and your engineers get less done, or quit. Once someone IPOs, a clock starts and the highest valuation wins. Or you can win the AI Race. I've been an engineer in tech for a long time. I was aiming for something that allowed me to visually represent a software stack like you see or build at modern tech companies. I also wanted something tongue-in-cheek about the silly things we say (YAGNI, KISS) and the shitty things that happen at companies (layoffs, audits), but deep enough for real strategy. Inspired by some of my faves: Lichess, MTG, Twilight Struggle, Slay the Spire, Balatro. You can play a tutorial, a bot, pass-and-play, or the online arena: ranked matches or private rooms with friends. You can also create an account and connect agents which play in their own lane over MCP. Pipe dream: Monolith becomes a new benchmark for AI releases. Tech stack: TypeScript/Node (for now; rust rewrite of the engine is on the table...). Matches stream over server-sent events, and the same rules engine runs the server and the bots. Feedback is much appreciated, here or via Report a bug in the menu. I'm especially curious whether the first few turns make sense.

projects.title: Show HN: Chelis, a tensor language agents can write and prove
projects.author: jeffreysmith
projects.summary: We just open sourced Chelis, a programming language we built focused on agent authorship and human supervision. You can find a longer intro on our site: https://chelis.ch/blog/launch/ But here are the key things a HN reader might like to know: * Statically typed, compiled, functional language, with heavy influences from ML family languages * Built for agent authorship of programs across the compiler, MCP, skills, and remdiation paths * Formal methods baked in via SMT and related solvers being connected with the type system in the compiler * Rich support for numerical programs and mathematically rich domains like quant finance and quant econ * GPU support is in an experimental state, for folks who want to build from source and run on AMD or Apple acceleration * All built in Rust From our experience, agents can already write Chelis as well as they can write Python. And they are a lot less overconfident in incorrect approaches with all the help Chelis provides. Several of us on the core team are hanging out on HN. Drop us a comment if you check out the work.

projects.title: trigger-doctor
projects.summary: AI agent skills have a hidden failure mode: runtimes like Claude Code and Cursor load only the skill's name + description line, and decide from that alone whether to open it. If it doesn't match how users phrase requests, the skill silently never runs. trigger-doctor tests that gate: it simulates the judgment with a labeled suite, diagnoses misses, prescribes the fix, and saves a regression suite to re-run after model updates. Zero dependencies, CI exit codes, 3/3 skills.sh security audits.

projects.title: Show HN: The Last SaaS – An open source headless SaaS for agents and assistants
projects.author: mkly
projects.summary: This kind of started as a joke, and it still kind of is. But it's also kind of fun to think about what the minimum number of primitives would cover all possible typical SaaS applications. And then drive that from an agent/assistant. There is obvious stuff like CRUD, and then permissions, users, notifications etc. So basically I made a start of a "headless SaaS" that has no UI and is just a CLI/API/MCP that you can connect your Claude etc to and it can make the UIs and displays in real time when you need it. This isn't like a startup. I'm more curious about your opinions about how much of SaaS can just be replaced. It can be backed by SQLite(or Postgres), so it's super quick to self-host, but you can also use the hosted version for free to test it out. The repo is at https://github.com/mkly/thelastsaas The website that demonstrates basic usage and installation: https://thelastsaas.com The main app is at https://app.thelastsaas.com There is both a CLI and an MCP available. Both have the same functionality. Thanks for taking a look. Suggestions and feedback greatly appreciated.

projects.title: Show HN: Puppet Master – Manage coding agents at scale
projects.author: chrismoos
projects.summary: As I started to use `claude` and `codex` more it became too hard to manage all the sessions across all my tmux panes and sessions, so I built Puppet Master. I see now there is quite a lot out there now for managing agents to write software, but a) I started working on this before a lot of them, and b) there are things in Puppet Master that just don't exist all in one product. For me I'd say the highlights are: 1) Web instead of terminal -- it's just a richer interface 2) iOS app so I can keep working on things from anywhere 3) Local + Remote workers (heterogeneous fleet), I work on things that are cross-platform and PM lets agents spawn across the fleet depending on workload needs. 4) Connections - first-class support for integrating MCP and REST API (ala OpenAPI definitions) into your agents. This goes above and beyond what a single harness can do via i.e an MCP integration. PM imports it (scoped to a bucket/project) and associates it to a policy. It lives between the agent and the remote MCP/API and enforces a policy. My normal flow is give full read access to agents and any APIs that do writes, approval needed. PM has native approval UI on web AND mobile so you can give real agency to your agents without being too permissive. 5) Code review interface is nice, 1-1 discussions on comment threads in the review, pretty responsive. 6) Forwards/artifacts allow agents to share static artifacts/html/etc,. OR serve up any dev server. This is proxied so even things on remote workers "just work" and you can access them, securely. GitHub: https://github.com/chrismoos/puppet-master

projects.summary: Hey all! For the past months I've been vibe-coding a free Photoshop editor for macOS (Native using Swift and a bit of Rust). It has many features that I've always wanted in such an editor (but was unwilling to pay the Adobe tax). I did try open source solutions such as Gimp but they never worked for me. In terms of features I'm not gonna list all, but I'm very happy it has: - A proper canvas where text and vectors keep their quality when zooming in - Layers (vectors, text, pixels, color adjustment, effects, reference layers, mask layers, layer groups and so on) - Many effects (including unusual things like dithering or NTSC) - All the tools you'd expect (brush, paint, repair, etc) For some of these tools it uses local models - Selection operations via local models (e.g. select all red cars) - Import / Export PSD, SVG and many others. - Support for tracing images to vectors, text to beziers, bezier editing, etc. Most importantly (I think), it has a optional AI integration via a agent harness which lets a model remote-control the app for you to build a document out of layers & effects & brushes etc. This is really powerful because in comparison to typical genai flows this allows you to make changes, hide things and easily scale them up (if most elements are vectors). There's also support for genai operations (e.g. if you want to embed a genai generated SVG or image as a new layer). Would love to get feedback: https://pixellect.app/

projects.title: 开源了 12 个电商短视频 Agent Skills：一张商品图 → 带配音字幕的 15 秒竖屏视频，本地 ffmpeg 出片
projects.author: boisy
projects.summary: 之前发过一个电商出图的 Skills ，有人问能不能接着把图变成视频。这周把这部分也做完了，开源（ MIT ）： https://github.com/xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills?utm_source=v2ex&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=ecommerce-video-skills&utm_content=body **想解决的问题**：让大模型写带货分镜很容易，但写完还得自己开剪映一镜一镜拖。我想让 agent 不光写脚本，还能把片子真剪出来。 **做法**：让 agent 输出一份 storyboard.json （每镜：用哪张图、怎么动、说什么、字幕高亮哪个词），然后本地一条命令渲染： ``` python scripts/assemble.py storyboard.json -o out/demo.mp4 ``` 脚本做的事：edge-tts 逐句配音 → 镜头时长按配音实际长度反推 → 静图做 Ken Burns （逐帧 scale+crop ，比 zoompan 稳）→ xfade 转场（居中在镜头分界，不吃配音）→ ASS 字幕 / 花字 / CTA → 合成一段免版权 BGM ，有人声时自动压低 → 两遍 loudnorm 到约 -14 LUFS → MP4 + SRT 。纯 Python + ffmpeg ，剪辑这一步不需要任何 API Key （ edge-tts 需要联网）。 **效果**：下面这条只用了一张 800×800 的随手拍，14.5 秒、1080×1920 ，我机器上 27 秒左右渲染完： ![]( https://upload.maynor1024.live/file/1791169828136_evs-one-photo-to-video.jpg) MP4： https://upload.maynor1024.live/file/1791169831745_evs-one-photo-demo-9x16.mp4 **拆成了 12 个 skill**，每个文件夹一个 SKILL.md ，可以只装需要的： - 3 秒钩子（ 9 种类型，≤18 字，带广告法禁用词自检） - 卖点分镜（ 15/30/60 秒结构，直接输出 storyboard.json ） - 图生视频提示词 / 多模型适配（ Seedance 、可灵、Veo 、Runway 、海螺、万相…，带商品一致性锁，不编造模型参数） - edge-tts 配音、字幕花字、ffmpeg 自动成片 - 平台导出（抖音 / TikTok Shop / 视频号 / 小红书 3:4 / 淘宝主图 1:1 / Amazon 16:9 ）+ 安全区预览 - 直播录像切 9:16 高光、开箱 / 对比评测模板、多语言配音（--lang en ）、封面标题 A/B **安装**：`npx skills add xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills`，或者 Claude Code 里 `/plugin marketplace add xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills`，或者直接把 skills/ 复制到 ~/.claude/skills / ~/.codex/skills / .cursor/skills 。不用 agent 的话，脚本也能单独跑，仓库里带了一个 6 张图的示例。 **已知局限**： - 静图 Ken Burns 终究不是实拍，适合测款和铺量，跑出数据的品建议补实拍； - 平台的时长 / 大小上限变化太快，没写死，导出时只给提示； - 示例商品是 AI 生成的虚构商品。 欢迎拍砖，尤其是做电商的朋友：哪些平台规格 / 模板最想要？

projects.title: Show HN: Delegator – Stop juggling coding-agent sessions
projects.author: mattm
projects.summary: I wanted to share Delegator with the HN community. delegator gives you a personal inbox to manage your tasks that is completely local to your machine. Backstory: Like everyone else, I've been experimenting with different AI-assisted development workflows. I realized I was having difficulty with all the context switching between tasks. Asking agents to develop code ends up taking about 5-10 minutes usually for well-scoped tasks. At the beginning I would read the AI output as it went along and sometimes interrupt to guide it. But as LLMs have gotten better, there's less need to do that. So I would spin up another task during the latency and then another. (I wrote a little bit about this previously here https://mattmccormick.ca/we-re-all-managers-now-my-journey-i... ) Jumping back and forth between terminals with the Agent being at different stages was mentally taxing. I experimented with some different options and ended up realizing that to avoid the drain of context-switching, what I really needed was a queue. Delegator works by putting all scoped tasks through the system. It stops when the ready queue has reached your configured limit. This is to prevent too much work from piling up waiting for review. It also presents the work from getting too far ahead in case any issues are found as part of development. I also realized that for most tasks, agents can be treated as a background process. You pass in the work to the process. It processes it and then gives you an output to review. All changes are made in git worktrees for safety. Who's it for? Delegator is for engineers who still want to understand the code and changes. It's not for vibe-coding or exploratory work. Don't get me wrong, I'll still spin up an agent session for brainstorming design options. But once I'm aligned on a direction, I'll then ask the agent to break down the work into "dg tickets". Since Delegator is a local program, agents can interact with it quickly and seamlessly. Right now it's just CLI based but I'm looking to expand this into a GUI/Desktop App so I would be interested in any feedback you have. Let me know if you have any questions and I'll respond. The code is source available so you can check it out at https://github.com/alcubie/delegator if you want to check anything.

github.description: A free, open-source developer workspace. Snippets, notes, HTTP requests, calculations, and dev tools in one local-first app.

projects.summary: massCode 是一个开源的桌面开发者工作区，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它最早是一个代码片段管理器，现在把代码片段、技术笔记、HTTP 客户端和常用开发小工具放在同一个应用里。 API 请求、调用它的代码和相关说明通常分散在三个不同的工具里。在 massCode 中，它们放在一起，可以互相链接，并且全部以普通 Markdown 文件保存在本地磁盘上。 核心特性 1. 代码片段：多级文件夹、标签、片段内多文件/多语言（fragments），支持 160 多种语法高亮。 2. 笔记：Markdown 笔记，用 [[链接]] 关联笔记、代码片段和 HTTP 请求；支持任务（状态、优先级、截止日期）、Mermaid 和思维导图。 3. HTTP 客户端：集合、环境变量、GraphQL、WebSocket、断言与脚本、按顺序运行请求；可从 OpenAPI、Postman、Bruno 导入。 4. 小工具：计算笔记本、基于 Excalidraw 的画板，以及 JSON Diff、哈希、编码/解码等工具。 5. AI 助手：使用自己的 API Key（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、DeepSeek 等），或通过 Ollama、LM Studio 使用本地模型。 6. MCP：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编程智能体可以搜索和保存你的代码片段、笔记和 HTTP 请求。仅在本机监听，默认关闭。 7. 本地优先：没有账号，没有私有云。数据就是本地文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，可以用 iCloud Drive、Dropbox、Syncthing 或 Git 同步。

projects.summary: 我是 AceDataCloud 项目方，自荐 SunoMCP，一个 MIT 开源的 MCP 服务。它让 Claude、VS Code 等支持 MCP 的客户端直接生成音乐、写歌词、延长或翻唱已有作品，并通过任务查询取回最终结果。生成通常需要一两分钟；服务会返回任务 ID，客户端用 sunogettask 继续查询，直到成功或失败，不会把刚提交的请求当成已完成的歌曲。 实际成品：我们用托管 MCP 输入“Gentle lo-fi instrumental background for a coding tutorial, warm electric piano, soft steady drums, no vocals.”，选择 chirp-v5-5 和纯音乐模式。任务约 121 秒后完成，返回两首 MP3：第一首（约 127 秒）、第二首（约 161 秒）。这次生成和取回发生在 2026 年 9 月；截至 2026 年 10 月 6 日，两个音频链接仍可访问。 如何试用：根据项目 README获取 API Token，把 加到支持远程 MCP 的客户端；也可在 Python 3.10+ 环境运行 uvx --from mcp-suno==2026.10.5.0 mcp-suno，作为本地 stdio MCP 服务。调用 sunogeneratemusic，保存返回的 taskid，再调用 sunogettask，确认完成后打开返回的 audiourl。README 有各客户端配置示例。 项目并非 Suno 官方服务。MCP 软件开源，生成所用的 AceDataCloud API 收费：2026 年 10 月 6 日公开目录中，这种普通生成请求为 0.56 Credits/次，通常返回两首；按 100 Credits/$15 套餐约 $0.084/次，按 40 Credits/$7 套餐约 $0.098/次。套餐是预付额度，美元数字是按套餐汇率换算的单次消耗，并非一笔独立的单次付款。账户折扣、套餐与价格可能变化，请以实时服务价格和实际扣费为准。

projects.title: Show HN: Aether: Check and fix web accessibility issues from your coding agent
projects.author: samy_patra
projects.summary: Hi, HackerNews! I'm Samy, co-founder of Allchemy Labs. We built Aether, an MCP server that enables engineers to check for, understand, and fix web accessibility issues all from their IDE. Your preferred coding agent can leverage Aether to open a webpage, scan it using axe-core and return a short, prioritized list of violations along with code fixes or guidance. Every suggested fix is re-tested in a real browser before you see it, and once you apply it, your agent can re-scan the page to verify it worked. You never need to open a browser, use multiple tools, or be an expert in WCAG criteria. Aether uses our own custom ontology architecture to provide grounded insights to any WCAG violations the scanner finds. Every WCAG technique the engine cites must pass our quality gate. Specifically, it must satisfy the violated success criterion, apply to that kind of element, and remediate that axe rule. If nothing passes, our engine will abstain rather than guess. We compared Aether against standalone coding agent on its own (Opus 5, 30 anonymized live sites, 111 targets). While the results were mixed we have published the results especially calling out specific wins and improvement opportunities for our insight engine. Read the study here: https://allchemylabs.substack.com/p/we-tested-our-own-access... Try Aether today, no signup needed. npx -y @allchemylabs/aether-wcag-scanner (any MCP client: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…) Claude Code plugin: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/allchemylabs/claude-plugins.git then /plugin install aether-wcag-scanner@allchemylabs Without a key you get the browser scan, local template fixes and verification. A free beta key adds the cloud engine: https://beta.allchemylabs.ai/?src=hn Feedback from people who have used accessibility scanners and/or suggestion engines would be highly valuable to us, as we aim to build a tool that solves real problems and makes people's lives easier. Happy to answer any questions and hope to hear from you. Note: Right now Aether only checks WCAG 2.1 AA. Sites behind bot protection (e.g. Cloudflare challenges) return a "blocked" result instead of a fake scan, so point it at localhost or staging.

projects.title: 受 Jev 启发，花了三周、600 美元、20 多轮训了两个小模型专门做 Computer use
projects.author: gxcsoccer
projects.summary: 这三周业余时间做了个东西，开源出来给大家看看。 DeskMind 得心：一个在 Mac 上替你操作电脑的 agent ，决定每一步怎么做的是两个跑在本机的小模型（ Qwen3.5 0.8B 和 4B 微调，MLX ）。不走云端，也不按次付费。 思路来自 Jev：把每一步变成选择题，让模型给每个选项打分，而不是生成一段文字。区别是 Jev 是云端服务，我想要一个全在本机跑的版本，所以自己在 Qwen3.5 上训了 0.8B 和 4B 两个小模型。决策服务用的是和 Jev 相同的 `POST /v1/systemone` 请求格式，已有的 harness 换个地址就能接到本机。和 TypeSafe 没有任何关系。 0.8B 有把握就直接做（大约 0.5 秒），没把握就交给 4B 再判断（约 3.6 秒）。任务有两种理解的时候，它会先问你，比如表里有两笔 Lisa Wong 的订单，它会问你用哪一笔，而不是随便挑一个写进去。 ![]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deskmind-ai/deskmind/main/docs/images/asks-first.gif) 自己出了 13 个真机任务，每个跑 3 次，目前发布版是 38/39 ，没出现过没做完就说「完成」的情况。题是我自己出的、样本也小，仅供参考，逐题结果都公开了。 踩过最有意思的坑：标签平滑设成 0.95 ，结果 0.8B 的把握全挤在 0.96 这个门槛附近，七成的步骤都被交给了 4B ，所以现在速度还不够快。下一轮准备改。 目前的不足：「帮我整理这个文件夹」这种模糊的指令做得不好；文件很多的文件夹每步要几十秒；只支持 Apple 芯片，首次要下载约 5.3 GB 模型。 训练花了大约 600 美元：先在 Tinker 上跑，后来换阿里云 PAI ，最后按小时租显卡最划算。 - GitHub： https://github.com/deskmind-ai/deskmind - 下载 Mac App： https://deskmind.dev/zh/?ref=v2ex - 过程和踩坑： https://deskmind.dev/zh/blog/launch?ref=v2ex 欢迎下载试试，最想看到的是它该问却猜了的例子。

projects.title: [开源推荐] mu：带判定内核的编程 Agent，日常判断交给小模型（自荐）
projects.author: qybaihe

github.name: qybaihe/mu
github.description: mu (μ): a coding agent that thinks before it acts. A small, fast judge makes the routine calls, the big model does the work. Built on pi and AionUi.

projects.summary: mu 是一个开源的编程 Agent，有命令行和桌面端，基于 pi 与 AionUi。Agent 每一轮都要做不少和代码无关的小判断：哪段工具输出该进上下文、被规则拦下的命令是不是用户要的、网页里有没有冲着 AI 的指令、"做完了"有没有验证过。mu 把这些交给小而快的判定模型 Jev，38 个决策点各问一个有边界的问题，大模型只管干活。适合想看清、管住 Agent 每个决定的开发者。 亮点 每个决策点都能单独设成生效、只记录（shadow）或关闭，每次判定都写进本地账本，mu ledger 或桌面端的判定面板都能看。 判定模型可以换：托管的 Jev、本地运行的 322M 判定模型 Laya、任意分类模型或任意大模型，还能按决策点分别指定。没配 key 时用 OpenCode Zen 上的免费 Jev。 网页、搜索结果和 MCP 输出逐段过一遍提示注入筛查，冲着 AI 的那几段不进模型。 作者自己的实测：7 份真实的失败测试日志，按完全重复折叠，无损省下 51% 的字符；按目标让 Jev 挑测试日志，删掉 40% 到 46%，必需的行一行没丢。方法和局限都写在 README 里。 桌面端可以用 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、Google 的订阅或 API key 登录，能导入 Claude Code 和 Codex 的对话接着做；内置浏览器由 Agent 一步一判地操作。 还在预发布阶段（0.1.x），作者每天在用。

projects.title: Show HN: Open-Source Instinct
projects.author: mariagorskikh
projects.summary: We’ve all heard that Instinct raised $1 billion to bring personal AI agents to everyone. But I think anyone can build their own Instinct for a specific group of people. You know your audience, understand what they need, and know how to reach them. So I built an open-source version. It can make purchases online, coordinate with other people’s agents, use a computer, connect to MCP tools, manage permissions + everything else instinct wants to do. Here’s the stack: - Pi, the open-source agent framework used by openclaw - Maritime for each agent’s VM and computer access (cheapest infra) - Composio for app integrations and managed Google OAuth - Inkbox for imessege + email If you want to start selling your own personal AI agent, you can host the backend on a platform like railway/vercel (around $20 a month). Maritime handles provisioning each agent’s VM and the infrastructure behind it ($1 a month per agent) I’m open-sourcing this so we can build on it together: add more services and tools, better permissions, different payment strategies, better prompts... The goal is to make it easy and affordable for anyone to launch a startup selling agents so that the world isnt ruled by openai dots and meta muses Check it out and let me know what you think!

github.description: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap/type/scroll with honest outcomes, over WebDriverAgent. HTTP API + 21-tool MCP server, remote control from a browser or iOS app, replayable flows. Rust, self-hosted.

projects.summary: Mac 上的守护进程通过 USB 在 iPhone 上运行 WebDriverAgent，把手机交给 AI agent：屏幕读成文字，点、滑、输入。提供 HTTP 接口、21 个工具的 MCP server，以及远程控制的网页和 iOS App。适合让 Claude Code 等 agent 操作没有 API 的 App，比如银行、健康、聊天。 亮点 每次操作都返回「已执行 / 没发出去 / 结果不确定」和能否安全重试；点到被遮住或看不见的元素、填进去没生效的值会直接报出来，不会悄悄当成功。 禁止截屏的支付类 App：截图是一片白时，按控件树画出带文字的线框图。 每个请求带耗时拆分，按实测优化：点一下并等画面稳定从 8.5 秒降到 4.2 秒，冷启动从 75 秒降到 13 秒。 做过一次的任务录成 flow，进官方 flow 源审阅，之后一条命令重放，不经过模型。

projects.title: Show HN: Octri.dev – Generate customizable docs, 10 SDKs, and get an MCP server
projects.author: EmadKhair
projects.summary: Hi HN! Emad here, one of Octri's founders! I think a lot of us had a similar experience as software engineers, we build API's with great features then comes the annoying part of maintaining Docs and SDKs (if any). That by itself is a lot of work without mentioning what happens if you had multiple SDKs and have to publish updates on all the different package managers! I personally experienced that pain and was looking for solutions but most of them (if not all) are extremely expensive for an Indie, OSS, or even a startup and they actually aim for enterprise only where the big buck lives. So I decided to build all the tool that an API would need and make it available for everyone not only enterprises. Today, I would like to present Octri.dev, a little orange octupus that takes your API spec and generates a fully customizable docs site, SDKs in 10 languages (TypeScript, Python, Dart, Rust, Swift, PHP, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go), and gives you an MCP server as well so agents can interact easily with your API. I also added a new feature to the mix which is turned off by default and not included in your SDK unless you (the API owner) turn it on, it's the monitoring part that reports errors that happen for your SDK users back to you before they flood you with complaints and it pin points exactly where the issue happens. It's quite complicated to explain it in a short post so here's a page explaining it in detail: https://octri.dev/monitoring (Happy to answer any detailed questions you have regarding this below) We also are offering a free-tier for our indie community + we have an OSS program that gives Business tier completely for free to help our great open-source community! More about the program here: https://octri.dev/open-source We also have a free spec auditor (no sign up needed and it doesn't save your spec either): https://octri.dev/openapi-audit Glad to have this finally out and would appreciate you guys going in and testing it out and sharing your feedback and questions below! My email (if any needs it): emad@octri.dev

github.name: hAcKlyc/MyAgents

projects.summary: 我是 MyAgents 的作者，自荐给周刊的软件栏目。 国庆这周，我把自己的几台电脑接成了一个 Agent 网络。现在坐在笔记本前，可以让 Windows 上的 Agent 用它当地的文件和环境干活，再把结果交回来。 MyAgents 是免费开源的桌面 Agent 工作台与任务系统，支持 macOS / Windows。刚发布的 0.5.0 新增 AgentNet：同一账号的设备加入网络、选择开放的 Agent，就能在对话中跨设备派活，不需要自己搭服务器。 我实际试了一件很小的事：问 Windows 下载文件夹里有几个日志文件。笔记本上的 Agent 找到远端设备，Windows 那边检查完，回传了 6 个文件及明细。这件事不复杂，但说明其他电脑上的文件和工具，也可以进入当前的工作。 单机也能使用：每个 Agent 有自己的工作区、模型、Skill 和工具，日常事务可以建成定时任务。支持 Claude Agent SDK、Codex、DeepSeek Harness 等运行环境。 客户端采用 AGPL-3.0-only；模型订阅或 API 按所选服务商计费。跨设备调用要求目标电脑在线、应用运行、相应 Agent 已开放，设备间任务与结果端到端加密。

projects.title: 做了个查 AI 用量的 App
projects.author: chenzhe
projects.summary: 做了个 App 叫 **usAge**：连上账号，用了多少、什么时候重置、还剩多少钱，一屏看清；放个小组件在桌面，抬头就能看到。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/cover.jpg) ## 支持哪些服务 Claude 、Codex 、Cursor 、智谱 GLM / Z.ai 、Kimi 、MiniMax 、Xiaomi MiMo 、Qoder 、OpenRouter 、DeepSeek （鸿蒙版的 Qoder 在下个版本）。 - 订阅制看已用比例和重置倒计时，按量付费看余额和花销 - 网页登录或者填 API Key 都能连 - 没有你在用的？ App 里可以申请接入，直接回帖也行 ## 主要功能 - **一屏看全部额度**：5 小时窗口、每周额度、Token 消耗、账号信息，点开就有 - **五种小组件**：基础、数码管、贡献图、LED 、卡包，小中大三种尺寸，一个最多放 4 个账号。小组件上能直接切换额度、刷新，Codex 有重置卡时也能在小组件上直接用掉 - **分享卡片**：Token 战绩、额度状态、AI 花销三种，可以拿来晒 - **多设备同步**：Apple 设备走 iCloud ，华为设备走云空间，手机上连一次，其他设备自动出现 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/iphone.jpg) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/widgets.jpg) Mac 版除了主窗口还有菜单栏，会读本机日志，显示今天 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 用了多少 Token 、大概花了多少钱； Siri 、快捷指令、聚焦搜索里也能直接查额度和刷新。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/shots/zh-Hans/mac-detail.jpg) 鸿蒙版支持手机、平板和电脑，大屏是侧边栏两栏布局。Apple Watch 上抬腕也能看。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/press/zh-Hans/screens/harmony-pc-status.png) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/watch.jpg) ## 凭证安全 - 不注册也能用 - Cookie 、API Key 、OAuth 令牌只存在本机系统钥匙串里 - 查用量的请求由你的设备直接发给各服务商，**不经过我的服务器** - 同步走你自己的 iCloud / 华为云空间，凭证字段加密存储，可以随时关 - 服务器只存 usAge 账号和购买记录，用来在别的设备上恢复 Pro ## 价格 - 免费版：连接 1 个服务，所有小组件样式和分享卡片都能用 - Pro：¥15 一次买断，不限连接数量，没有订阅、没有广告 - 登录 usAge 账号后，Pro 在 Apple 、鸿蒙、安卓之间通用 - 鸿蒙首发特惠 ¥6 ，到 10 月 30 日 不想先连账号的话，设置里打开「演示数据」就能把所有界面看一遍。 ## 下载 - **Mac**：已上架 Mac App Store → https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6812881047 - **iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch**：1.1 **正在等待审核**，过审后同一个链接就能下。（ 1.0 审了 12 天还没结果，索性撤回，直接拿 1.1 首发） - **鸿蒙（手机 / 平板 / 电脑）**：今天刚上架华为应用市场 → https://appgallery.huawei.com/app/detail?id=ltd.zhe.usage - **安卓**：官网直装版 → https://usage.o-c.do/zh-Hans/android ，Google Play 版也在审核中 - 官网： https://usage.o-c.do 系统要求：iOS / iPadOS 18.6+、macOS 15.6+、watchOS 10+、HarmonyOS 6.1+、Android 12+
