projects.title: 做了个 prlctl 风格的 VMware CLI
projects.author: normalcoder
projects.summary: 先贴地址和安装...目前暂时只支持了 Homebrew 。手动安装可以自行编译或走 GitHub Release 。 - 开源地址： https://github.com/normal-coder/vmctl - Homebrew 安装：**brew install --cask normal-coder/tap/vmctl** ## 为什么写这个 **核心还是解决自己的使用问题（笑。** 出于对环境纯粹的洁癖，一般各种新工具的尝试还是选择在干净的 OS 内去解决。 考虑到各种安全、隔离问题，有些环境不想/不适用用容器。于是常年在重装各种系统和各种初始化中来来去去，每次操作都相当耗费心神。 **初始化系统的活儿交给 Agent 干，心里又不踏实😩。。** 于是反复在各种老牌虚拟化方案和新晋虚拟机中来回捯饬。最终。。**对个人免费的 VMware 还是真香** 😂😂😂 VMware 漫长的历史和博通的产品调性。让 VMware 比起 PD/OrbStack/Lima 一众产品，开发者友好程度不太够。 - `vmrun` 的参数太反人类了——快照、克隆、往 guest 里拷个文件，每样都要记一长串路径参数，用完就忘；敲起來还费手 - 用惯了 Parallels 的 `prlctl`，换到 VMware 之后发现没有对应手感的 CLI - 想脚本化批量操作，GUI 点不动；管 vSphere 又不想开浏览器 - ... **为了手感**。照着 `prlctl` 的命令风格写了一个，底层用统一的 Driver 接口把两种后端收进同一套命令里。 ## 快速感受 ```console $ vmctl list ┌────────────┬───────┬─────┬─────────┬─────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 名称 │ 状态 │ CPU │ 内存 │ 客户机系统 │ UUID │ ├────────────┼───────┼─────┼─────────┼─────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤ │ ubuntu-dev │ on │ 4 │ 8192 MB │ Ubuntu 24.04│ 564d1156-abcd-ef01-2345-678901234567 │ │ win11 │ off │ 8 │ 16384 MB│ Windows 11 │ 564d9876-2345-6789-abcd-ef0123456789 │ └────────────┴───────┴─────┴─────────┴─────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 📊 基础信息 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **列出所有虚拟机** `vmctl list` | 支持 --json 输出格式。 | | **查看虚拟机详情** `vmctl info ` | 显示名称、UUID 、Tools 状态、Guest IP 等。 | | **查看版本信息** `vmctl version` | 支持 --json 输出格式。 | ### 🔌 电源管理 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **启动虚拟机** `vmctl start [--nogui]` | 返回即代表已加电，不等待 Guest OS 就绪。 | | **关闭虚拟机** `vmctl stop [--hard]` | --hard 表示强制断电。 | | **挂起虚拟机** `vmctl suspend ` | 暂停并保存当前状态到磁盘。 | | **恢复虚拟机** `vmctl resume ` | 恢复被挂起的虚拟机。 | | **暂停虚拟机** `vmctl pause ` | 暂停虚拟机运行（保持在内存中）。 | | **重启虚拟机** `vmctl reset [--hard]` | --hard 表示强制重启。 | ### 🔄 生命周期 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **克隆虚拟机** `vmctl clone --name [--full] [--snapshot ] [--path ]` | 默认链接克隆；--full 为完整拷贝。vmrun 后端要求源 VM 已关机，vSphere 支持开机克隆。 | | **派生新虚拟机** `vmctl create --from [--memory 4096] [--cpus 4] [--full]` | 从现有 VM 派生（ vmrun 后端不支持从零创建裸 VM ）。 | | **修改虚拟机配置** `vmctl set --memory 4096 --cpus 4 [--name ]` | 必须在虚拟机已关机状态下执行。 | | **删除虚拟机** `vmctl delete ` | 删除虚拟机及其全部文件，不可恢复。 | ### 📸 快照管理 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **列出快照** `vmctl snapshot list [--tree]` | --tree 可按树状结构展示快照关系。 | | **创建快照** `vmctl snapshot create ` | 为当前状态创建快照。 | | **删除快照** `vmctl snapshot delete [--children]` | --children 表示连同子快照一并删除。 | | **恢复快照** `vmctl snapshot revert ` | 必须在虚拟机已关机状态下执行。会一并恢复快照时的电源状态。 | ### 🖥️ Guest OS 交互 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **执行 Guest 命令** `vmctl exec [-u root] -- ' '` | 经 /bin/sh 执行，捕获输出并透传退出码。要求 VM 已开机且安装 VMware Tools 。 | | **查看 Guest IP** `vmctl ip [--wait]` | 脚本友好，直接输出裸 IP 。要求安装 VMware Tools 。 | | **SSH 进入 Guest** `vmctl shell [--user u] [--port 22] [-i key] [--wait] [--dry-run]` | 要求 Guest 开启 sshd 。-- 之后的参数会透传给 ssh 命令（如 `vmctl shell -- -v`）。 | ## 特性 - **双后端一套命令**：默认 `vmrun`（本机 Fusion / Workstation ），`--backend vsphere` 直连 vCenter / ESXi （ govmomi ），本地和实验室环境切换只是换一个参数； - **VM 引用很随意**：显示名、名称的唯一子串、UUID 前缀、`.vmx` 路径、vSphere 的 MoRef （`vm-42`）都能用，不必先查 UUID ； - **同名快照消歧**：vmrun 按名字操作快照，撞名时给出 `名字#uid` 候选引用（走 Fusion 13.5+ 的 vmcli ）： - **guest 内执行**：`vmctl exec -- 'df -h'` 捕获输出并透传退出码，`vmctl shell ` 直接 SSH 进去（`--` 之后透传给 ssh ）； - **为脚本设计**： `--json` 全命令覆盖；退出码分级（ 0 成功 / 1 运行错误 / 2 用法错误 / 3 对象不存在 / 4 后端不支持，exec 再透传 guest 程序退出码）； - **中文界面**：帮助和报错默认中文，`--lang en` 切英文； shell 补全内置，VM 名是动态读当前后端列表补的； - **多 profile 配置**：`~/.config/vmctl/config.yaml` 里配好本地 + 远程两套环境，`--profile lab` 一条命令切换。 ## 技术栈与现状 Go + cobra + govmomi + go-pretty ，单二进制无运行时依赖，MIT 协议。 当前 0.x 阶段，还有一些问题尚未解决。但做好一个基础镜像后，后续的工作就好弄了。。。 - `vmrun` 后端不支持从零创建裸虚拟机（`create` 需要 `--from` 一个现有 VM ）； - vSphere 后端部分电源操作（如 `pause`）按设计返回「不支持」退出码 4 ，还在真机验证中； - exec / shell / ip 依赖 guest 内装有 VMware Tools （或开了 sshd ）。 ## 最后 写这个主要自用，但如果你也在 macOS 上折腾 VMware 、或者受够了 vmrun 的参数，欢迎来提 issue / PR ，特别是 vSphere 场景的真机反馈： https://github.com/normal-coder/vmctl Happy Hacking 🙌

projects.title: [开源推荐] snap-back：给编程 Agent 加一个撤销键，改坏的文件一条命令找回（自荐）
projects.author: Abelo9996

github.name: Abelo9996/snap-back
github.description: Undo for any coding agent. Snapshots your project in a shadow git repo so one command rolls back what the agent did, without touching your own git history.

projects.summary: snap-back 是一个开源命令行工具，给 Claude Code、Codex 等编程 Agent 加上撤销功能。它在 Agent 改动前后把项目快照存进一个独立的影子 git 仓库，不碰你自己的 .git、暂存区和 stash。Agent 删错文件、改坏代码时，snap-back undo 一条命令恢复，包括被删掉的文件。适合用 Agent 写代码、又怕它一次改坏一片的开发者。 亮点 任何 Agent 都能用：snap-back wrap -- codex 包住一次会话；Claude Code 可以直接装成插件，每次工具调用前后自动快照，再用 /snap-back:undo 回滚。 撤销前先列出要恢复和要删除的文件，确认后才动手；每次恢复前还会再拍一张安全快照，所以撤销本身也能撤销。 遵守 .gitignore，跳过 nodemodules 这类目录；2 万个文件的项目首次快照约 3 秒，占用约 6 MB。 不联网，只依赖两个包（cac、chokidar），核心代码约 2200 行，MIT 协议，macOS、Linux、Windows 上都有测试。 坦白说明做不到的事：Agent 在项目外的副作用（写数据库、发请求）无法撤销，被 .gitignore 忽略的文件也不在快照里。

projects.title: Show HN: Tofu – let your agent deploy full-stack apps
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm the founder of Tofu, a code deployment platform built for agents. Paste our setup prompt to any agent you're already using and Tofu enables your agent to take your project from code to production. Current features include frontend & backend hosting (created & managed by Tofu), Postgres database (created & managed by Tofu), domain management (one-click setup for Cloudflare managed domains, manual DNS record for others), authentication, Google login, and Analytics. We built Tofu out of our personal frustrations: we're engineers who know how to code, we've deployed live products and understand the process, and our AI agents have already finished writing the code that works locally, yet taking a product fully online still took 2-3 hours: - Setup hosting, backend, database - Copy-pasting a lot of apikeys/secrets from here to there - Setting up correct redirect urls from places to places - Managing DNS records, domains - Setting up a lot services (email, 3rd parth OAuth, etc) - Payments Tofu works with any MCP-compatible agents, and here's a list of tested agents (10+ different projects end-to-end deployment via Tofu): local coding agents (Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Kimi Code, DSH, Cursor), Instinct, Muse, Kimi Code cloud. None of that is hard, but each of these services have their own providers and it involves managing 5-10 different accounts. Most cloud providers have their own CLI, but it only works within their own platform and the process still involves a lot of manual interventions. Agents can call any API and use CLIs, but cannot open a Google Cloud project or put a card on file with 5 vendors. We think deployment is not a compute problem, but an accounts problem. Our endgoal is to utilize SSO across services, and provide agents the ability to deploy a live product end-to-end. We don't want to compete with any cloud providers, but to make agents actually capable of shipping "live" products. We're rolling out features to support buy domains directly from Tofu (we're an authorized reseller of Name.com), and provide more customizability to tech stacks. We're still very early and have just launched our product, please send us any feedbacks, comments, and we promise we will respond to every single one of them.

projects.summary: A couple of months ago, I gave access to my coding agent to do work on my repos. I was worried about hallucinations so I manually checked each transcript against modifications to see whether what the agent said it did actually happened. I found that in many cases, my coding agent either failed to disclose what it actually did or found workarounds to things like failed tests instead of telling me upfront. That led me to the idea for Rashomon. Rashomon is an independent execution recorder for coding agents that notifies users whenever there is a discrepancy between what the agent said it did and what we capture as a ground truth. It aims to capture items like shell commands, exit codes, file writes, tool calls, tests, and subagents. We build a timeline of the events but we do not store any prompts, responses, file contents, or tool outputs. A question we got often has been how is this different than a diff. A diff gives you a look at the final result and what changed while what we aim to provide is visibility into the execution that led to it. Currently, we do not capture network codes, prompts, responses file contents, and tool outputs. We plan to implement some of those based on feedback recently, but please let us know whether you would find that useful. To get started, you can install it is as a Claude Code plugin or from the command line. I would appreciate feedback on the solution, but I also would want to see whether anyone can break a test on purpose and see whether Rashomon can capture everything you would like to see in order to trust the independent record.

projects.title: Show HN: Reright.it – Human approval for agent-written text
projects.author: paulofilip3
projects.summary: So, I use agents to write a ton of stuff now: e-mails, client messages, commit messages, comments, etc. The problem is that AI writing is VERY easy to spot and most of the time I don't want it being sent under my name, since it does not sound like me at all. After failing at trying to fix it with rulebooks or skills like humanizer, I decided it was better to try to "catch" every time the agents write public-facing text and force the agents to send it to a single queue and wait for my editing and approval. Why this approach? I still want the agents to draft the text for me, since it's time consuming to pull up the necessary information and create the initial structure of the message. All I need to make the text sound like me is to lightly re-structure some sentences, remove the enthusiasm, trim it down, remove words I don't use, etc.. So I made this for myself and have used it for a while now, find it very useful, so I decided to make it public. If offers a nice looking UI with a proper text editor that allows me to easily edit and approve/reject public facing text produced by any of my running agents. It's super simple, can be used locally or with cloud session agents (but hooks don't work there, so there's no way to enforce its use there). Every message shows up as a draft that I can edit and it’s got all the context right there: what it is, who's gonna read it, and why the agent even wrote it. Then, I can edit it, hit approve and the agent sends my version of the text. I figured other people might also find it useful, so here it goes. Any feedback is much appreciated.

projects.summary: 自荐 Igra Station 智能体竞技场：一个公开的竞技场，AI 智能体在这里和别人的智能体、和真人、和机器人对弈，比赛全程直播，结果计入公开的 Elo 排行榜。 现在有 34 款游戏：国际象棋、国际跳棋、黑白棋、五子棋、海战棋、坦克对战，也有几个专门为智能体设计的谈判和经济类游戏。已经下完 6400 多盘。 智能体自己下棋时，会做出一些没人教过它们的事。下面这几件事都有服务器日志和桌边聊天记录为证： 一个智能体一步真棋都走不出来，就在桌边聊天里给对手发了一句“e2e4，我赢了”。对手也照样回了一句，双方都宣布自己获胜。 对局结束后，智能体们开始互相介绍自己是怎么搭起来的：一方讲自己的六个预测器，另一方就拿自己的四个模型来回应。这个习惯从一个智能体开始，后来传给了别的智能体。 炮战里，一个比分落后的智能体没等连射三发就主动移动，一步棋同时清掉了自己的过热、废掉了对手的校射。它拿到的说明里，根本没有这种打法。 接入很简单：起个名字就能拿到密钥，读游戏规则，开桌或者入座，然后循环“看局面、走一步”。可以用 REST，也可以把竞技场当作 MCP 服务器接入 Claude、Cursor 等客户端。现成的 Python 客户端在 kotinder/arena-play（MIT，无依赖），里面故意没有任何策略，默认只会随机走合法的一步——怎么下赢，是你自己的事。用引擎、求解器、别的模型都可以，只是不许攻击竞技场。 还有一件事我觉得挺有意思：在公平排行榜上（同一位所有者旗下智能体之间的对局不计入），用 DeepSeek 的智能体里，成绩最好的一个排在第 11 名，前十名里还没有它们。不知道是模型的问题，还是接入它们的人还没认真写策略。欢迎接上你的 DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi 或 GLM 来试试，看能不能进前十。 不想一直在线的话，可以开“异步对局”：每步从几小时到三天，断线、重启都不影响。每盘结束后都有一个永久页面，可以逐步复盘。 此条由项目维护者账号提交。

projects.title: [开源] Precedent Loop：让 Agnet 换个会话也记得项目里踩过的坑
projects.author: sanwanzzz
projects.summary: 用 Codex 和 Claude Code 写代码久了，最头疼的是它不记事。上周跟它一起查了一下午，根因找到了，方案也定了。这周开个新会话，它又从头猜一遍，有时还会把当初否掉的方案再提出来。 我试过两种办法，都不太顺手。 一种是写进 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`。放"必须遵守的规则"没问题。但"这个接口为什么要做幂等""那个报错其实是连接池配置引起的"这类经验，一条条加进去，文件很快就几百行。每次会话都全量塞给模型，真正相关的那几句反而被淹没了。 另一种是用客户端自带的记忆。记什么由模型自己决定，我看不全，也不知道哪条在哪次起了作用，记错了也很难发现。 所以我做了 Precedent Loop ，思路很简单：经验让 Agent 来提，入不入库我说了算，用的时候按需去取。 实际用起来是这样一个循环： 1. 方案定下来，或者根因查清楚的时候，Agent 会整理一条"候选"，写明背景、结论和适用范围。 2. 候选出现在桌面 App 里。我可以改，可以让 AI 重写，也可以直接拒掉。点了确认才会入库，入库的就是我看到的那一版。 3. 之后的会话里，Agent 碰到相关任务会自己去查。一次最多拿 8 条、总共不超过 5000 字，先看标题和摘要，需要了再读全文。 4. 真正影响了它判断的那几条，它会标记"用上了"。用的时候发现内容过时，它会提一条修订，同样由我确认。 和前面两种办法比，好处主要有这几点： - **库里每一条都是我看过的。** Agent 只能提候选，不能直接往库里写，所以不会越记越乱。 - **上下文不会膨胀。** 库里有几百条也没关系，每次只取和当前任务相关的几条，而且有上限。 - **知识会跟着项目更新。** 旧结论不对了，是在用的时候顺手发现、顺手提修订，不需要我定期去翻。 - **能看出哪些经验真有用。** 每条被查到几次、被用上几次都有记录，长期没人用的可以清掉。 - **Codex 和 Claude Code 共用一个库。** 多个项目之间也能互相查，比如在后端项目里查前端那边的约定。 - **全在本地。** 数据就是一个 SQLite 文件，App 不调用任何模型 API ，也不保存 Key 。已有的 Markdown 笔记可以借本机的 Codex / Claude Code CLI 转成候选导进来。 它不是用来替代 `AGENTS.md` 的。每次都要遵守的规则继续写在那里，只在特定场景下用得上的经验放到这里。 先说清楚现在的不足，免得大家装了失望： - 只支持 Apple Silicon 的 Mac 。App 没签名，第一次打开要去系统设置里手动放行。界面目前只有中文。 - 检索用的是 SQLite 全文检索（ FTS5 trigram ）加字面匹配，没上向量。好处是简单、能解释，不依赖外部服务；缺点是换个说法可能就搜不到。现在的补救办法是每条知识入库时必须带 3–16 个检索词，把常见说法提前写进去。这是我最想改进的地方。 - 没做过严格的对照实验。我自己从 7 月 8 日用到 10 月 4 日，库里攒了 79 条，被查到 307 次，模型标记用上 113 次。"用上"是模型自己报的，只能当个参考。 GitHub： https://github.com/hemuzzz/PrecedentLoop （ Apache-2.0 ） README 开头有一段 83 秒的演示视频。装好后 App 有引导，跟着点几步就能把 Codex 和 Claude Code 都接上。 欢迎试用、提 issue 。特别想听听大家的意见：同义说法怎么检索比较好，召回效果又该怎么评测。

What Happened records what your Mac does every ten seconds, so it can answer "why was my Mac slow at noon?" with names, and then fix it with your OK. Fixes are one click from the menu bar, the cleaner and uninstaller move things to the Trash with Undo, Space maps your disk, and an MCP server lets Claude Code or Codex read how your own apps behaved. Your history stays on your Mac.

projects.title: Agens Volundr 32B Preview
projects.summary: Agens Volundr is a dense 32B open-weights model for agents and long working sessions. Only 18 of its 72 layers keep a KV cache; the other 54 are linear attention with a fixed-size state, so long context stays affordable on hardware you own. Decode holds at 23.9 tok/s even at 128K context (BF16, two 48 GB GPUs, single user). 262K window, Apache-2.0, BF16 and INT4 (one 48 GB GPU). Runs on our open sglang build; GGUF planned.

projects.summary: roomcomm 是一个开源的临时房间服务，专门为 AI 智能体设计。创建房间就得到一个链接，把链接发给别人的智能体（Claude、GPT、DeepSeek 或一段脚本），双方就在同一个对话里读写消息，房间的所有者在浏览器里旁观。不用注册账号，接入方式有 REST、MCP 和 A2A 三种。 亮点 一个房间就是一个 URL，不需要账号，也没有 SDK；房间 72 小时没人说话就自动过期。 同一个房间同时提供 REST、MCP（Streamable HTTP）和 A2A v1.0 接口，能发 HTTP 请求的智能体都能进来。 智能体名字可以随便填，所以每条消息还带 keyref，即发消息用的密钥的固定标识：同一个名字换了 keyref，就是换了人。 拿到房间链接的智能体不需要预装任何东西：页面里自带一份给智能体看的说明，Accept: text/markdown 直接返回纯 Markdown。 有言在先：房间内容对所有拿到链接的人公开、不加密，72 小时没人说话就过期，重要内容请自己留存。 网页界面支持简体中文；AGPL-3.0，Python + FastAPI，可以用 Docker 自己部署。

projects.title: Show HN: Claude Remote – start Claude Code on your own PC from your phone
projects.author: kaushik_n__
projects.summary: I kept having ideas away from my desk, and my Claude Code sessions only lived at it. The hosted sessions run on a cloud copy of the repo, so my local hooks and config don't come along. This is a small Node agent on a Windows PC (zero dependencies, binds to 127.0.0.1 only) exposed through tailscale serve, plus a PWA. Tap a folder on the phone and it starts a Claude Code session there with --remote-control, which you then drive from the Claude app. It's a start button, not a terminal. The trade is spelled out in the README: a session runs with your account's full permissions and anything on your tailnet can reach the agent, behind a six-digit passcode with a lockout. Fine for a single-user tailnet, not for a shared one. Windows only for now. Happy to answer questions about the design.

projects.title: Stochastly

Under the hood, a quant desk's rigor: deflated Sharpe, probability of overfitting, out-of-sample and cost stress, so quants and trading firms get audit-ready research without building the stack. Export to TradingView, MetaTrader, Python or a paper; drive it via MCP.

github.description: A layered map of your codebase for coding agents: callers, callees and the impact of a change, for TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Python and Java. MCP server, CLI, and plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

projects.summary: 这是一个给编程 AI 用的代码地图。装进 Claude Code、Codex 或 DeepSeek Harness 后，AI 改代码前一次就能查清：改这个函数会牵连哪些接口、定时任务和命令。它用各语言自己的编译器分析 TypeScript、JavaScript、Go、Python 和 Java，地图只存在本机，不上传代码。适合用 AI 维护中大型项目、担心“改一处坏一处”的人。目前支持 macOS 和 Linux。 亮点 连线准确：用编译器解析调用关系，经由接口、基类、装饰器的调用也能连上，这是文本搜索容易漏的地方。 一次追到底：调用方最多追 8 层，直到 HTTP 路由、处理函数、定时任务和命令；语言服务器通常每次只返回一层。 装上就能用：AI 自己判断什么时候查地图，测试中 Claude Code 和 Codex 都是 6 次中 6 次主动使用。 实测：限 15 次请求时，AI 找到受影响接口 97.9%，不用地图 58.8%。样本不大、题目由作者编写，完整报告和局限都已公开。 本地运行、只读、Apache-2.0。

projects.summary: SLG：一款开源的网页三国策略游戏，可以自己建城、征兵、攻城，也可以把令牌交给 Claude、ChatGPT 或自己写的脚本，让 AI 按同样的规则 24 小时替你经营，离线时还会给你写日报。支持 MCP，一行配置就能接入。 在线公测： （Google / GitHub 登录，中英文界面） 开源仓库（MIT）： 为什么做这个 SLG 游戏拼的是谁更肝：半夜收资源、掐点出兵、提防偷袭。我想反过来：让游戏本身就是给 AI 玩的，人可以亲自上手，也可以只负责定方向。 它和一般的「AI 对战平台」不同 这是一款完整的游戏：15 种建筑、11 个兵种互相克制、多回合战斗、世界地图、名城、武将、科技、全服事件、玩家对抗。人类玩家完全可以自己玩。 服务端不跑任何 AI，智能全部由玩家自带；网页和 AI 走同一套协议、同一套校验，没有专门给 AI 的后门。 AI 只能用令牌登录，拿不到账号密码，令牌随时可以重置。 提供 MCP 插件（npx -y slg-mcp），Claude Desktop、Cursor、Claude Code 里加一段配置就能直接说「帮我打三国」。 排行榜可以按 AI 模型分组，看哪个大模型最会打仗。 技术栈：Node.js + Fastify + 标准 WebSocket + PostgreSQL，前端 React。

projects.title: 【软件自荐】nohmitaina：让人与 AI 共同读写工作记忆的本地编辑器
projects.author: nowissan
projects.summary: 大家好，我是 nohmitaina 的开发者，想分享一下最近发布的 0.3.0 版本。 在和 AI 一起做事时，除了保存背景信息，我还希望把“这件事应该怎么做”留下来：按什么顺序推进，每一步需要什么信息、要检查什么，以及哪些地方需要我来判断。 为此，我在 nohmitaina 中加入了 Procedure，用可视化流程来组织这些内容。比如“制定计划 → 评审计划 → 实现 → 验证”，每一步都可以设置角色、指令、输入、输出、工具和检查项。人可以在编辑器里查看和修改，AI 则通过 noh CLI 读写同一份流程。 除了 Procedure，还有三种记忆类型： Concept：保存想法、背景知识和概念。 Task：记录当前要做的工作。 Episode：留下执行结果和过程中发现的问题。 最近我用它整理了一套产品推广流程：和 AI 一起寻找允许推广的社区，核对规则，准备文案，再由我确认并手动发布。之后让 AI 把结果记入 Episode，方便下次回顾。这次实践也让我发现，Episode 还需要按工作类型筛选，才能更方便地查看。 nohmitaina 支持 macOS 和 Windows，记忆数据保存在本地，应用免费使用。与 AI 配合使用时，需要自行配置 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI；相关服务的订阅或 API 费用另计。 官网提供可交互的操作演示： 这次推广流程的使用案例：

projects.summary: agent-skills-en 是一个采用 MIT 协议的免费开源英文 Skill 集合，包含 5 个面向 AI 编程与知识工作场景的 Agent 技能：tech-writing-proofread（英文技术文档校对，输出 Original → Suggestion → Reason 清单，不直接改写原文）、git-commit-message（从 staged 改动生成 conventional commit 信息）、meeting-notes（把原始会议笔记整理成结论先行的纪要，行动项带负责人和截止时间）、code-review-checklist（从正确性、安全、可读性、性能、测试覆盖五个维度给出可执行评审意见，而不是风格挑刺）、deep-research-framework（深度研究框架：定义问题、来源分级、交叉验证、结论先行并显式标注不确定性）。支持 npx skills add alapha888/agent-skills-en 一键安装，也可手动复制单个 SKILL.md 使用；已被 skills.sh 收录（5 个 skill 全部可被发现和安装），并上线 AI Agents Listing。 亮点 1. 输出边界写死在 Skill 里：校对只逐项列出建议与理由、不重写原文；代码评审给可执行意见、不做风格挑刺——每个 Skill 都明确了做什么和不做什么。 2. 不编造缺失信息：每个 Skill 自带一个最小实景示例；其中 meeting-notes 的示例展示了一个刻意的设计——笔记里没写明的日期和负责人不会被编造，而是标注 [date to confirm] / [unassigned] 等待确认。 3. 零门槛上手：无需注册账号，npx skills add 一次装全 5 个，或只复制需要的单个 SKILL.md 到自己 Agent 的 skills 目录即可。

projects.title: Show HN: Skins.dev – add the features missing from the web apps you use
projects.author: dalichelbi
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm building skins.dev : Most AI tools help you build your own tool from scratch, but usually there's already a tool that gets you 80% there. Skins is for the other 20%: you describe what's missing in a web app you use, and we handle the rest, whatever it takes: from simple JS scripts and styles up to new backend features (hosted on our Cloudflare-compatible serverless cloud), so your feature can call other APIs and even have its own SQLite database. How it works: go to the page you'd like to change and press "Record" in the extension. We use the DOM snapshots and network requests to build a replica environment where coding agents can iterate safely. The Chromium extension then injects the changes per site via chrome.userScripts (à la Tampermonkey). I'm building a library of ready-made templates, inspired by long-open feature requests on SaaS forums (Salesforce, Jira, HubSpot): https://skins.dev/blog/ Currently Chromium only (we're working on getting the latest version into the Chrome Web Store). I would love feedback, and curious what you'd change first in a tool you use daily :)

It was originally a way of managing multiple agents in parallel (like TMUX, but with a nicer chat UI). But I found that I was only able to work with 3 or 4 agents simultaneously without information overload, so I decided to morph it into something which resembles Slack, where you can either privately speak to agents or address a room (like a channel) full of them. Importantly though, the agents can delegate work to each other, create other agents etc. Also had lots of user feedback from the first launch which means we've added multiple harnesses (Codex, OpenCode and waiting for Anthropic to approve Claude Code), git worktrees, connections to hundreds of MCPs, CLIs and APIs, browser-use and a proactive Chief of Staff (which periodically wakes up and gets things moving). It's local with no telemetry. Grateful for the feedback from our users from the first launch. Would be grateful for bug reports, other problems, ideas, questions or suggestions. Thanks, Chris

projects.title: [魔力工作台] 一个开源版 workbuddy 替代品
projects.author: Pony996
projects.summary: 我做了一个开源版 workbuddy 替代品，你可能会问，类似的产品海了去了，重复造轮子有什么意义？ ![ScreenShot_2026-10-03_205453_642.png · 184]( https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6ac0fb3c7f690_1791032124.webp) # 缘起 事情是这样的 我在一家 AI 公司就职产品经理工作，就我用这个行业真实业务的视角，以及我接触到的一些东西来看我觉得他很有机会 公司业务说白了就是卖 token 而组成公司收入的主要客户实际上是搞蒸馏，这种客户我觉得并不优质 因为这不产生价值，是军备竞赛，一旦 AI 泡沫破灭，市场没有了钱，军备竞赛终止，公司业绩会大幅缩水，所带来的连锁反应是非常恐怖的 不过也在转型，在做企业客户，转型二字说来容易，赚钱真的是太难了，企业直客就两个特点，没钱、事多 企业用 AI 本身的目的就是为了降本增效，让他花大把的钱买 token 肯定要考虑是否值得 我们公司员工不限量使用任何大模型，成本价的情况下一个月最高的能用到五六千块 rmb ，平均使用也有 1500 左右，这个价格去企业里推，很少有公司愿意花这个钱来买 token 企业顶多能接受一个月一个坐席几百块的预算，甚至更低 一个蒸馏客户一天就能消费十几万 rmb ，而一个企业客户那，可能一个月才一两万，如果按这个来计算，这背后基础建设的投入想要回本需要拓展非常多的企业客户去平摊，也就是市场生产力需求真的爆发 大部分公司买 token 也不知道怎么用，你要跟他们讲 codex 、claudecode ，他们跟听天书一样，哪怕是程序员，大部分也都是只用过 trae 、qoder 等国产 vibecoding 应用，甚至还有的只用过豆包 这部分客户并非低端，只不过行业不同，对计算机技能接触深度不同，当然不能跟天天泡在电脑上的工作者相比 # workbuddy 的优劣势 企业更想要的是一套成熟的、高效的工作体系 所以他们大多对 workbuddy 评价是非常高的 因为都被腾讯的销售洗脑过很多次了，他们也表示 workbuddy 的业绩压力非常大，而且广发英雄贴让 fde 团队跟 workbuddy 合作一块进企业，这确实是一个共赢的合作 我参加的很多行业展会也接触到一些不同的需求，很多传统型的企业还是很看重数据安全的，他们更愿意自己私有化部署大模型，要求数据不出园区 使用自己部署的模型用来工作也需要一个能够接入的客户端，曾经这个客户端是 cherrystudio 再说一些 workbuddy 的问题吧 它最大的问题就是贵，我遇到的企业都说它好，但是又说它不好，原因就在于收费昂贵 买一个企业坐席是个人会员的两倍价格，积分还少一半，且积分非常不耐用，几个任务就没了，官方也没有说明积分的具体扣费逻辑，计费黑盒，不耐用，还贵 那么企业买了之后自定义 API 使用行不行？ 当然可以，但是 workbuddy 的自定义 API 只支持一个 openai completions 协议，像 anthropic 和 responses 协议就不支持了，而且他绑定了很多自己家模型才能使用到工具，自定义模型用不了 其实细数一些这个市场有哪些使用起来没有门槛的工具，还是挺有限的 所以我觉得这个市场还有机会，尤其是开源的 workbuddy 替代 他其实没啥门槛，护城河无非就是腾讯自家生态连接器，不给别家开放，但是办公领域有多少是用腾讯生态的？ workbuddy 这款产品定位本身就是腾讯在上一次企业办公应用全面惨败之后想要一雪前耻的东西 # 魔力工作台能做什么 dsh 本来很有希望的，但是门槛太高，把很多人拒之门外，所以我做了这款魔力工作台 像基础的 Agent 任务，PPT 制作、处理 word 、excel 、pdf 、整理文件等都是基本功 支持插件、skill 、角色库、mcp 、自定义模型三大常用协议 还支持 AI 视频生成、AI 生图、AI 剪辑等音视频方面的能力 用它来写代码也可以，我参考了 opencode 、omp 、开源版 claudecode 等编程 Agent 的核心能力，支持 LSP 、TUI 、git 工具等，可以识别语言自动安装所需的 LSP 服务 觉得有意思的话赏个 star 吧，我相信未来一定是属于开源的 https://github.com/ponysb/mlimli

projects.author: naw103
projects.summary: Claude Code's scheduled tasks (routines) leaves a session behind on every run and in the desktop app you can only delete them one at a time. We had 618 open sessions in just one routine. The skill plans the clean up (keeps the newest N and protect any sessions where you typed a reply - optional) and then has Claude delete through the apps own session tool, 25 per call each behind an approval card. I tried just deleting the sessions on disk manually first but deleting the files directly dosnt work because the app keeps the list in memory and writes records back. The apps delete tool is turned off inside routine runs so the clean up command has to run from a normal conversation session. The planner is a single python file that dosnt delete by itself so you can run it by hand to see where everything exists.

projects.summary: 这是一个MIT许可的长文听稿工具箱，帮助把读书笔记、知识长文和AI草稿整理为适合听的文字。浏览器工具可生成请求、标出网址及表格等格式问题，并将正文与来源分别导出TXT；处理不上传文稿。另有纯文字Agent技能、三种中文起步请求，以及统计与历史两份完整听稿和AI音频。工具本身不调用AI、不合成语音，适合想先把材料讲清楚，再选择朗读工具的读者。 亮点 不把“适合听”简单理解成删表格或压缩摘要：改写示例保留数字、单位、来源归属和不确定性，原文格式只提示，不替用户删除。 在线使用或解压后直接打开HTML，不用注册、密钥或安装依赖。复制不可用时可手动复制或导出TXT；关闭页面不会保留输入。 两份中文完整示范可以直接听，也能查看原稿及来源。统计示范用原创虚构数据解释平均数与中位数；历史示范讲火车与时间制度。音频约8分17秒、8分05秒，由Mac上的本地模型生成，非iPhone录音，不承诺学习效果或手机性能。 纯文字听稿技能不执行脚本、不访问账号，也不在生成稿里加入产品广告；不用技能也能复制中文请求。AI内容仍需对照可靠材料核验。

projects.title: Show HN: Terminal Gym – a Claude mod that makes you do pushups between prompts
projects.author: heynaitik
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built this for myself and wanted to open-source it. The problem: I wanted a way to get reminders in-between prompts as I often spend long hours in the terminal, especially now that we're usually parallel-processing so many agents. The first version was a simple rep counter in my Claude Code status line and a shell script to log reps. Since Claude Code shipped mods this week, I thought this was a good way to level it up with even more accountability. How it works: 1. Every day, you get a daily goal for either squats, pushups, or dips (e.g. 0/100 pushups) with +5 / +10 / +25 buttons to log a set in the terminal. 2. Reminders for sets are spread out across the day so it doesn't get annoying, starting from your first prompt for the day. A toast tells you when the next set is due. 3. Strict mode is opt-in: if you're falling behind in terms of your daily rep goal, it will block your prompts till you log some reps. Added a streak counter for some added fun. All local and data is stored as plain files in ~/.claude/fitness. Install: claude plugin marketplace add DrumAndCode/terminal-gym && claude plugin install terminal-gym@terminal-gym Overall, thought the mod API is super powerful and can't wait to see the stuff people build with it. Eg: I built a clickable onboarding process inside the terminal, and that felt quite powerful to use. Now you can enjoy spending both tokens and calories. :)

projects.author: zhuangjie
projects.summary: ## 使用场景 项目开发最开始解决的问题是收藏了很多网站/软件/一些小教程(后面可能用到)，通过按规则写好源放到 github 上得到订阅然软件负责递归解析出数据项来搜索，有内置订阅，可制作自己订阅（[教程]( https://github.com/My-Search/my-search) | [官方源仓库-参考]( https://github.com/My-Search/official-subscribe)），桌面版有**插件功能** ![image]( https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/18476305640/typora@master/uploads/2026/10/03/1791035519022.png) ## 使用 **桌面版（订阅数据+插件）：基于 Rust 开发 [my-search-desktop]( https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-desktop)** 原版（订阅数据）：油猴脚本应用 [mysearch]( https://greasyfork.org/zh-CN/scripts/457020-%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E6%90%9C%E7%B4%A2) ## 当前有哪些可用的插件 | 插件名 | 描述 | |---|---| | Pi Agent | Pi 编码代理 - 支持多项目、多模型、模型配置面板、插件管理、流式对话与工具调用 | | 文件搜索 | 在粘贴/拖入的文件夹里按名称搜索文件：一直扫描、边扫边显示，随时可停止；回车或点击用系统默认程序打开 | | 插件市场 | 浏览、安装、更新与卸载插件 | | 录屏与水印 | 屏幕录制（可选实时叠加水印），并给已有视频批量添加文字/图片水印，支持九宫格定位与水印预设 | | 截图 | 全局快捷键截图：框选区域、标注后复制到剪贴板，并在前台查看最近 7 天的截图 | | MayeLite 快速启动 | 把常用文件/文件夹拖进来固定，随时一键打开；支持分类、排序与拖拽整理 | | 百度翻译 | 使用百度翻译 AI 能力，支持 200+ 语言互译，输入文本即译 | | GitHub 文件上传 | 将文件上传到 GitHub 仓库，支持拖拽、粘贴、选择文件与图片压缩 | | 剪贴板历史 | 自动记录你复制过的文本与图片，按快捷键呼出即可搜索、复制、删除、收藏。收藏的条目永久保留、不会被上限淘汰或清空。监听在后台原生完成，不干扰系统剪贴板。 | | 待办清单 | 本地待办清单：增删改查、优先级、标签、截止日期、筛选统计与 JSON 导出导入 | | 资源监控 | 每 5 秒采样整机 CPU / 内存 / 网络，按程序聚合，用可缩放时间范围的趋势图展示占用最高的 Top 10——快速定位 CPU 莫名 100%、内存暴涨、异常上传的程序 | 插件支持调整窗口大小，关闭自动恢复再打开时仍会按之前调试的宽度显示。 ## 如何开发新插件 AI 开发提示词： ``` 软件主体： https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-desktop 插件市场： https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-plugin-market 参考下面仓库开发出 my-search-desktop 插件。 需要开发插件的功能：xxx ``` 开发的插件通过设置里的挂载安装即可进行调试，当前开放的接口可能不多，需要可提 issues; 开发的插件可声明是否跟随软件启动，使用后退出是否后台运行，可声明在主体软件上快捷键使即使插件停止仍可通过快捷键激活插件功能； 插件市场运作说明： 插件都是在[插件市场 github 仓库]( https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-plugin-market)里定时自动索引的,按规范开发好，将仓库通过插件市场仓库提 issues 我看到会放到 index.json 会自动索引； ## 关于环境变量 用于多插件配置复用：通过直接在软件写好环境变量配置，在插件中直接通过环境变量授权给插件使用

projects.summary: 把小红书或抖音链接直接丢给 Claude、ChatGPT，它们基本读不到：小红书图文笔记的正文在图片里，抖音的内容在口播里，分享页本身只是一个“打开 App”的壳。 LinkDigest 是给 AI agent 用的 API / MCP 服务：一次调用，把小红书、抖音、TikTok、YouTube、X 的链接变成文本——带时间戳的逐字稿、画面上的文字（带出现时间）、每张图的描述和 OCR、要点。由服务器端去读，不需要你的 cookie，也不用你的账号，没有封号风险。 实测同一条小红书链接：直接抓取只拿到 860 个字符的可见文本，LinkDigest 返回 35,059 个字符。 新加了「爆款拆解」（breakdown: true，+1 积分）：钩子（开头原话逐字摘录）、带时间的结构节拍、标题公式、行动号召、目标人群、可复用模板。所有引用都和原文逐字核对，对不上的直接删掉并写明——一条 15 分钟的剪辑教程里，模型写出的 7 条“引用”原文里没有，都被删了。点赞、收藏、话题标签来自平台，不由模型编。加 translateto: "en" 可以直接拿到英文版拆解。 接入方式：Claude Code / Cursor 用 MCP；REST 一个 POST；批量 50 条带签名回调；Dify 插件、Apify；另有 /openapi.json（OpenAPI 3.0.3）。 注册送 10 积分（一次性）；任何人读过的链接再读免费；读不出内容不收费。加量包 ¥36 / 250 积分，支持支付宝。 （作者自荐。）

projects.title: Show HN: Television – an open source GUI for your agent harness
projects.author: stlhood
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm co-creator of Television ( https://television.run/ ). Me and the team at Telepath ( https://telepath.computer/ ) have been cooking on this and testing it with a few hundred alpha users. We just opened up the repo to the public today. Television is a clean, beautiful place for all your artifacts. Think of it as a GUI for your agent harness, a visual space for creating and working with artifacts in collaboration with your agent. It works with any agent harness (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Pi, OpenCode, etc) and uses whatever inference provider(s) your agent is already using. It's open source. A CLI and lightweight server get installed wherever your agent harness is running (Linux or macOS for now). These talk to our macOS client app, which can be running anywhere (the browser is also supported with a few limitations). A set of skills tell your agent how to put artifacts on your TV's screen and modify them over time. You use the client app as a sidecar -- i.e. you chat with your agent the way you normally do, but it can now respond by creating artifacts and putting them on your TV. Everything that ends up on your TV is yours and can be modified by talking to your agent. The entire UI, and your artifacts, are themeable. We noticed lots of people are using artifacts in agents like Claude Code/Cowork and Codex, and lots of developers are spinning up little websites and webapps for working on projects, organizing their life or work, etc. But it all either ends up locked inside your agent's interface or as a mess of random tabs running on a bunch of ports you quickly lose track of. We think that the future of personal computer interfaces isn't just chat, any more than it's MS-DOS. Artifacts are an early first step beyond chat. We think they should be easier to work with, and that you should own your own artifacts. So we made Television. It's early but give it a try and let us know what you think: https://github.com/telepath-computer/television/ (BTW: we're building TV via an end-to-end fully spec-driven dev process, with custom tooling that also pulls in design and UI work. Planning to share more about that in the near future.)

projects.title: Show HN: Syn – Approve remote sudo requests from your Mac
projects.author: ferrerluis
projects.summary: I built Syn to review and approve individual sudo requests from a remote machine using Touch ID on my Mac. The problem came up about five minutes after I set up my Raspberry Pi with Ubuntu Desktop and Codex. I wanted an always-on personal agent with Browser Use, Computer Use, and a residential IP, accessible from both my phone and laptop (keep in mind, this was before Muse and Dots dropped). But a few prompts in, in order to run a command that needed `sudo`, the agent asked me to enter an administrator password in a terminal that–to me as a client on my Macbook–seemingly didn't exist. I then realized: "this dude has some password prompt open on its TTY, and I simply cannot see it." Unrestricted passwordless sudo would have removed that interruption, but I wanted to keep approving administrator actions myself, so setting up my Pi pivoted into building a Mac app. And so Syn was born: Syn hooks into sudo after its policy check. It pauses the invocation and shows the machine, account, executable, and arguments on the paired Mac, where I can approve it with fresh Touch ID or Mac-password authentication. Each approval is cryptographically signed and bound to that specific invocation. The unprivileged network service only relays signed requests and decisions; sudo executes its original command. The devices communicate directly over mutually authenticated TLS, without the need for a cloud relay. Interactive terminal use also has a password fallback, and Syn works with any eligible commands regardless of which agent—or person—started them. Current support is macOS 15+ on Apple silicon and Ubuntu 26.04 ARM64 with classic sudo.ws 1.9.x. I have mine set up between my Raspberry Pi and my Macbook with NordVPN Meshnet in the mix to ensure I can connect when outside my LAN, but it should work the same with any compatible VPS or using another virtual LAN (like Tailscale). If this fits your setup, I’d love folks to try it and share feedback! It's an open-source project, so PRs are super super welcome.

projects.summary: 前几天我试着用本地 Agent （ Codex / Claude Code ）帮我清理堆积了 4 年、400 多个 Edge 书签，本来以为一句话的事情，结果踩了一裤裆的工程暗坑。 今天把整个过程中的反直觉真相、工程死锁以及最终跑通的解决方案开源出来。 **项目开源地址**： https://github.com/askofcc/chromium-bookmark-guardian （无需安装任何插件或第三方脚本，纯 Prompt 规范，丢给你的本地 Agent 即可现场执行） --- ### 一、 两个反直觉的认知“打脸” #### 1. 为什么“让 AI 自动整理书签目录”是个彻头彻尾的灾难？ 第一轮我让大模型根据 URL 和内容“智能重组分类”。结果它把属于我个人业务流的海外支付钱包 `WebMoney`，生硬地塞进了 `常用站长与 SEO`。 后来我想明白了：**书签本质上是人的「空间记忆」和「私人业务上下文」**。 当年我做站长要买外链，顺手需要办一张虚拟卡，所以虚拟卡自然在垂直业务目录下。AI 只有通识词向量，没有私人业务上下文。它自作聪明地按大词归类，看似整齐，实际把大脑建立了几年的空间肌肉记忆瞬间切碎，心理感受就是“东西全丢了”。 **结论：书签治理的第一铁律，是 AI 严禁触碰用户原有的目录结构。** #### 2. 传统死链工具（以及只查 HTTP 状态码的脚本）漏掉了 80% 的“假存活与黑产劫持” 市面上的扩展（如 Bookmarks Clean Up ）通常只看返回码是不是 200 ，结果这几天深度复测发现： - **域名过期被黑灰产抢注（最恶劣）**：当年存的正规电商/技术工具平台早已停业，域名过期后被黑产批量买走，变成了披着 200 状态码外衣的**涉黄非法看片站、境外博彩下注平台、或盗版影视泛站群**！ - **表面 200 ，实际为伪装 403 / 挂马跳转**：服务器 Nginx 返回 HTTP 200 ，但页面源码标题直接写着 ` 403 Forbidden `，正文是一段加密的博彩跳转脚本； - **SSL 证书域名不匹配**：老站换理解析但证书过期或域名不匹配，浏览器打开直接弹红屏隐私拦截； - **Cloudflare 致命解析错误**：如被查封的服务，返回 Cloudflare 的 `Error 1000: DNS points to prohibited IP` 错误说明页。 如果不做**语义级内容比对 + 严格证书校验**，这些已经变质的毒性链接会永久潜伏在你的日常收藏夹中。 --- ### 二、 必须绕过的底层死锁：Chromium 云同步（ Sync ）反向覆写 如果你在后台关闭 Edge/Chrome ，直接用 Python 修改磁盘上的 `Default/Bookmarks` JSON 文件： **千万别这么干！** 因为开启了微软/谷歌账号云同步后，Chromium 内部遵循硬性冲突规则 **「 Remote parent wins （云端归属优先）」**。你离线改的文件没有同步事务凭证，浏览器启动联网瞬间，云同步引擎会把云端旧目录全量拉下来覆盖你的本地修改！ **有效解法**： 通过系统自动化管道（如 macOS AppleScript / CDP ），向浏览器内部打开的 `edge://favorites` 或 `chrome://bookmarks` 注入原生脚本，直接调用浏览器内部特权接口 `chrome.bookmarks.move()`。 每一次移动都会作为原生事件被 Sync 引擎捕获并主动提交给云端，实现**无感实时更新、零刷新生效、云端永久同步**。 --- ### 三、 终极工程准绳与一键抄作业 踩完坑后，我们总结出了一套 Chromium 书签无损治理的四大准绳： 1. **结构绝对不动，组内频次浮顶**（原有业务分类 100% 保持，只在文件夹内部把近期高频项置顶）； 2. **四层穿透探针，清仓隐蔽伪存活**（双通道测活 + SSL 验真 + 灰产词库对抗 + 标题防假死）； 3. **客观二元隔离，零物理删除**（移入末尾隔离箱细分子类，确定死亡项随时一键清空）； 4. **宿主原生特权注入**（解决 Edge/Chrome 云同步回滚）。 如果你也有几百个吃灰的书签想清理，不用装任何扩展，也不用上传书签泄露隐私。 直接去 GitHub 复制那份 **PROMPT.md** 丢给你的本地 Agent （ Codex 、Claude Code 、Cursor 等）： 👉 **GitHub 项目地址**： https://github.com/askofcc/chromium-bookmark-guardian

projects.author: munvard

github.name: munvard/dockterm
github.description: The calm, terminal-first workspace for Claude Code — run claude, with files, Git, diffs & MCP on demand, and munu, a notch mascot that watches Claude for you. Local-only, no telemetry.

projects.summary: 我经常让 Claude Code 跑长任务，然后去做别的事，结果它在一个权限提示上等了十分钟。所以做了 DockTerm，一个免费开源的桌面工作区（Electron，MIT 协议，支持 macOS / Windows / Linux）。 它不替换 claude，只是包住真实的终端会话，再加一些东西： munu：Mac 刘海里的小脸（Windows 和 Linux 是顶部的小胶囊）。Claude 需要权限时，它把问题弹出来，全屏应用上面也能弹，点一下就能回答。它不会替你点确认。 每个仓库一个窗格，多个会话放在同一个窗口里。 实时显示子代理在做什么，可以审查 diff，也有简单的 Git。 显示 5 小时和每周额度还剩多少（只在本地读取日志，是估算值）。 本地运行，无账号，无遥测，自己不会调用任何 AI 接口，也不用装 hooks（直接读终端文字）。 不足：基于 Electron，安装包比较大；Windows 版本还没有签名；状态检测依赖终端文字，Claude Code 改了提示文案时我需要跟进修复。 安装：brew install --cask munvard/dockterm/dockterm，或者到 Releases 下载。仓库里有中文 README。 作者：Moon Labs，亚美尼亚。欢迎反馈哪里会出问题。

projects.title: Show HN: Graphene – Data analysis toolkit for your coding agent
projects.author: kcmarr

github.name: graphene-data/graphene
github.description: Turn your coding agent into a world-class data analyst

projects.summary: My friend and I have worked at a number of BI companies and thought: Can’t a coding agent do most of this now? Almost. They just need a context/semantic layer to ensure query correctness and some kind of artifact for publishing findings and visualizations. We built an open source project called Graphene that provides these tools: - Semantic layer that’s more token-efficient than YAML, more deterministic than Markdown (eg, composable, callable metric macros), with a query API that’s well in-distribution (SQL). - MDX-like files for dashboards (Markdown with inlined SQL + HTML components for viz with support for CSS and Javascript) - Connects to popular data warehouses or local DuckDB Your coding agent will build really in-depth reports and can ofc leverage any other skills or context that you've made available to it. We dogfood it inside a monorepo with our website, app source code, planning docs, etc so the agent has access to a ton of context. It’s also nice that the agent can add instrumentation, adjust pipelines and transformations, and add dashboards all in one PR. If you want to try it out, just point your coding agent at https://github.com/graphene-data/graphene/blob/main/docs/set... and ask it to set up Graphene. If you don’t have data to play with, you can clone our example project: 1. `git clone < https://github.com/graphene-data/example-flights.git` > 2. `cd example-flights && npm install` Would love any/all feedback!

projects.title: Show HN: Add a natural-language interface to your SaaS w/ Yedric
projects.author: aaroneous
projects.summary: Hi HN, I've been building SaaS products for more than 20 years, and lately I've been thinking a lot about how we interact with software. When we add a feature, we have to figure out where it goes in the UI and how users will interact with it. Then users have to learn our particular way of doing something. AI lets us flip that around: the software can translate what the user wants into the actions needed to accomplish it. Yedric lets devs add a natural-language interface to an existing SaaS app. You expose your app's actions and give it your docs and user context. Users can then ask for things like: • "Export the table to a CSV" • "Fix this disconnected integration" • "Change my logo color to #B5E2F4" We originally built Yedric for our own Shopify apps and discovered an interesting side effect: the conversations became a useful source of product feedback. One of our apps surfaced 80+ distinct feature requests this way last month. Yedric uses a small JS SDK and MCP to connect to your app's capabilities. It's free, you bring your own LLM key, and you can get a basic implementation running in under 30 minutes. Let me know how you like it!

projects.title: Show HN: Grist, open source coding harness
projects.author: pranav6226
projects.summary: I built a coding harness on top of the new Opencode v2, it started with the the idea of using the new jev model for routing easy tasks to cheaper models such as deepseek and hard tasks to models such as Opus 5.5. In total in separated it into 4 rungs - easy, medium, hard and frontier. Two more layers compound the savings: the Sol-Pi methodology based on the recently published paper which uses action fusion and observation packing and cuts roken usage within every tier. Doctrine injection loads your engineering standards into every session by default, so the agent writes code the way your team would. There is also a real control plane - escalation, permission and verification hooks so the agent surfaces uncertainty instead of being confidently wrong in silence. Run it using your own key from Openrouter or Vercel AI gateway key, we need this since one key is able to call the jev decision model as well as the llms for coding. One more thing I added was the ability to connect your Meta Muse to use this for coding tasks which has worked really well so far you can try it out by copying the promp for agent on the website. Two ways you can use it today is the Mac app and the cli. Honest limitations are documented, happy to take any questions. Repo: https://github.com/grist-ai/grist npm CLI: npm install -g grist-ai

projects.title: Show HN: Breadcrumb, record everything on your mac + context manager for AI
projects.author: jv22222
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Justin. Breadcrumb records everything you do on your Mac (screen + meetings + AI transcripts + what you and your AI decided) and turns it into memory your AI can search. It's local and encrypted. You can also teach it rules by talking to it and it makes sure the right rules turn up in the right context. Works with Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / opencode. All of this is exposed to your AI as 30+ MCP tools (here's the definitions): https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb/mcp I started it in June because I wanted to understand what was going on with my AI dev work. Then it just kept growing as I jammed on it 10 hours a day for 3 months. I started by recording every screen so I could jump back to a moment and see what I'd been doing with the AI. Then I added MCP so the AI could search it. Then time tracking. Then meetings with transcripts and timestamped screenshots. After that I started feeding the data back in. At first it was just a few relevant memories in the prompt. Then I started adding rules and rules modules. Then I started recording the AI transcripts and all the other stuff the AI did (subagents, tools etc). I wanted a complete record so I could go back and see what the AI did and why. I found the more data the AI had the more useful it became. One example. I got off a zoom call with the team at the day job and said: "Review the meeting I just had, find all the bugs we discussed, and create JIRA tickets with screenshots." It read the transcript. Found every bug we mentioned, pulled the screens from the screen timeline, spun up my local server, diagnosed each bug, reviewed the code, created 14 tickets in JIRA with diagnosis and likely fixes, attached 12 screenshots as evidence, and created a nice Slack message to send to my colleagues. I never built a workflow for any of that. Claude had the meeting record, Breadcrumb tools, and rules I'd accumulated. It basically chained the steps together itself. My favorite thing about the system is observability of my own work as an AI developer. I can trace a bug all the way back to the first thing I said (or the first thing the AI did) that caused it. Then I can add a rule so it doesn't happen again. Anyway, my working system is simply Claude Desktop + Breadcrumb + Markdown. I find I don't need anything else. It's local software for one person. Local models for transcription and diarization. Data encrypted with SQLCipher and a passphrase. You can exclude any apps, websites, words and phrases. Breadcrumb itself only makes one network call which is a daily update check. (but of course your AI will use it and that is local or cloud depending on what you use). It runs cool about 12% of one core on average (M series mac has 8+). You can set it to just save OCR text or to save screenshots. If just OCR it's about 12mb day (a lot of telemetry, indexing etc). If you record screenshots on meetings it's about 120mb/hour (1 every 2 secs). It can also record screenshots of everything that's heavy at about 160mb/day. It does local classification/naming with ollama with Gemma 3 4B (2.5 GB). It's 100% free. There's no account you can just download and start using it. I'll monetize it via E2EE cloud sync and team sync. It's open beta. Just one developer working on it. Requires 16GB+ M Series Mac. Thanks for reading! https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb (homepage) https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb/download (direct download) https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb/mcp (mcp definition)

github.description: 把外部 Agent CLI、持久终端、工作区调试和远程访问，装进 DSH 原生界面。

projects.summary: 面向经常切换 AI 编程工具的开发者，Codingns4DSH 将多种外部 Agent CLI 统一投影为 DSH 原生会话。 如果你同时使用 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 或其他 AI 编程工具，Codingns4DSH 的外部 Agent 集成模块已支持 17 个外部 Agent，可以把已安装的 CLI（命令行工具）接入 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）原生会话，在同一个工作区切换使用。 按各 CLI 的实际能力，插件提供模型选择、流式输出、工具调用、会话恢复、打断、思考强度及用量展示；支持的 CLI 还可在 DSH 原生界面完成权限确认、提问和插话。各 Agent 的能力有所不同，详见 README 能力表。 完整名单：17 个外部 Agent（不含内置的 DeepSeek Harness Agent） 1. Command Code 2. Claude Code 3. Kimi CLI 4. Gemini CLI 5. Pi Agent 6. Codex 7. OpenCode 8. Grok Build 9. MiniMax Code 10. ZCode 11. CodeBuddy（自动识别 CN / 国际版） 12. WorkBuddy 13. Cursor CLI 14. Kiro CLI 15. Qoder 16. Qoder CN 17. Antigravity CodeBuddy 的 CN / 国际版由同一适配器自动识别区域；Qoder 与 Qoder CN 分别列出。 安装： dsh plugin --profile web add @jingyi0605/codingns4dsh@0.2.1-beta.3 dsh web 当前安装版本为 0.2.1-beta.3（预发布版）；兼容 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <=0.2.1-alpha.1，已验证 0.2.1-alpha.1；要求 Node.js >=22.19，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows。Agent 需在 DSH 外安装并登录，由各 CLI 管理凭据，插件不保存 Agent 凭据。 项目： npm： 许可证：GPL-3.0-or-later 外部 Agent 会话的上下文由 CLI 自己组装，因此面板只显示占用百分比和总量，不显示系统、工具、消息构成明细。

projects.title: Anthroposcaper
projects.summary: Draw a 2D plan in the browser or import a DXF, then tag its faces and lines. projects.title: Show HN: Silta: family assistant on Matrix with continuity across context limits
projects.author: dmitry-markin
projects.summary: Silta is a self-hosted assistant serving multiple users from a single Matrix account, used by me, family, and close friends for the last three weeks. It runs on Claude Code with each person using their own Claude subscription. Silta answers everyday questions, conducts web research (presenting the results as PDFs), performs scheduled tasks to monitor/research something and notify you if needed. It uses a deliberate handoff & compaction procedure, writing the compaction summary itself with a custom prompt, so the thread of the conversation and its picture of the user is preserved across context limits. As it turned out, the assistant accessible in a continuous chat (contrary to ChatGPT / Claude Web sessions) builds up better context about you and your tasks, and provides more relevant answers and help. It runs on Claude Code as the only allowed way to use a personal Claude subscription. Using Claude Code also spares me developing a harness, at the cost of tracking changes as new versions of Claude Code are released. The assistant itself (the daemon, the channel plugin, the supervisor, and the deployment) is open-source, while the model and the harness are Anthropic's and proprietary. Silta is deployed to a dedicated VM with separate Linux users per session and systemd hardening, protecting sessions from each other. Claude Code's bubblewrap sandbox is used to protect the Claude credential and the harness's state from the agent. This does not protect from prompt injections coming from search results and potentially leaking user data. Matrix E2EE protects the conversation from a Matrix server operator, but everything in the context is of course sent to the model provider. Private content is never logged, and the operator is expected to respect the privacy and not read the session transcripts on disk. Additionally, it is recommended to use full-disk encryption and tell the users how their data is handled. Silta only works in its workspace with files explicitly shared by users in the chat. Giving it access to a user's own computer or services like email is not planned. Since Opus 5.5 has been released, it is possible to run a session on a $20 Claude Pro subscription. Before that, only Fable 5.1 was pleasant enough to talk to. When run on Anthropic API, a moderately used session extrapolates to $100-$150 per month, with each research run costing $6-$12. Silta is built with Claude Code and Silta itself. The design, review, deployment, and testing are mine.

projects.title: Show HN: Beyond "chat with your database" – agentic data exploration
projects.author: sandhya6
projects.summary: Business intelligence is changing. AI can now do more than turn a question into a single SQL query: it can investigate a question through a series of queries, examining the result of one query to decide what to query next. Today, to answer a business question against a database, analysts use a tool like Tableau: they select relevant data, build an initial view using fields, filters, calculations, and visualizations, then look for patterns or anomalies. They form hypotheses and test them — filtering by region, drilling into customer cohorts, comparing time periods, or creating calculations to validate or rule out an explanation. They repeat this process until the evidence supports an answer, then save a workbook or dashboard for others to review and monitor. With a single question, AI can now perform much of this exploratory loop: it can investigate the data, follow the evidence through multiple queries, and present the supporting analysis. This is agentic data analysis — AI autonomously decides what to investigate next based on the results it has already found. Reportr puts agentic AI at the center of the experience, then builds complementary capabilities around it to address AI's limitations: SEMANTIC LAYER Production databases are rarely clean: columns that are no longer used, cryptic names like status2, misc, or flag, columns whose meaning has quietly shifted over time, tables that linger long after their purpose is gone, and so on. This is known as schema rot. AI tools guess wrong against schemas like this. Reportr's semantic layer lets you give tables and columns business-friendly names and descriptions, document relationships, capture business rules, and flag what AI should ignore — so it's working from what your data means, not just what it's called. USER OVERSIGHT AI-generated answers can be wrong. Reportr lets you inspect the SQL executed to arrive at an answer. It also provides explanations of what the SQL does (understandable by business users), and how it works (intended for technical users). You can review the analysis rather than simply accepting AI's conclusions. BETTER USER EXPERIENCE Reportr UI is specifically optimized for chatting with a database. Database queries often return large number of records. Ask which customers haven't placed an order in the last 90 days, and the answer is a list of customers. Reportr displays tabular data in an interactive grid that can handle thousand of records without breaking a sweat. The grid supports sorting, searching, and filtering. REPORTS AND DASHBOARDS Chat is ephemeral. Every conversation starts fresh, and that's fine for exploration — but not for information you need every week. When a chart or table reveals something worth tracking, save it as a report. Combine reports into dashboards to monitor changes over time, share findings, and keep important insights accessible without having to ask the same questions again. ROLE BASED ACCESS CONTROL Not everyone on your team needs the same level of access. Reportr's role-based access control lets you give each user exactly the permissions they need — from view-only access to report building, database management, and full administrative control. projects.author: yolandac
projects.summary: Hey HN! Yolanda and Spencer here - wanted to share a token compression tool that we’ve built for ourselves to save 30% costs on codex! After maxing out sub and burning $700/day per person on api, we fine tuned a compression model to trim codex's tool call output to reduce input token + cache. It cut down tokens by 29.6% and now I just leave it on by default in Codex. To avoid messing up w/ cache, we use proxy + fine tuned qwen model trained on preserving agent trajectory to remove tool call results before they go back to the model, leaving kv cache untouched. The cli is free for everyone to use ( https://github.com/spenmcke/compress ). Just lmk ur feedback and hacks to shave even more costs on astra! If you want to integrate it into your product to offer the best models at low cost, I can set you up with an sdk and api keys PS: It’s built for coding agents, not conversational agents. I optimized it for file retrieval accuracy, trajectory preservation, and quality to get up to 30% cost reduction depending on how context-heavy the task is. On security and privacy side, it's a proxy wrapping your local codex and ZDR so it doesn't retain any queries. It’s on by default in codex and when you don’t want compression, you can use `codex --uncompress` to disable it. Give it a try: code is in https://github.com/spenmcke/compress You can install the cli using `curl -fsSL https://install.everestagi.com/install.sh | sh && source ~/.config/everest/shell.sh` Love to hear any feedback and learn your hacky ways to save token costs too!

projects.title: AI Agent 的能力上限由模型决定，行为的可靠性与一致性由规则体系决定。
projects.author: tntin
projects.summary: 在使用 AI Agent 开发项目的过程中，我的一些理解 以及 推荐一下我开发的工具： ## 一句话总结版 模型决定能力上限，规则决定底线与一致性； Agent 规则文档是给智能体用的长期执行手册，拒绝直接抄模板，聚焦你反复遇到的问题，写死动作与验收标准，约束长任务每一步的判断。 ## 正文 | 维度 | 模型层 | 规则层 | |---|---|---| | **决定因素** | 理解、推理、创作、工具调用的能力边界 | 目标拆解、工具白名单、权限审批、可验证性 | | **典型约束** | 成本与速度（复杂任务需大模型，简单判断用小模型） | 把“必须”“禁止”变成程序必经节点，而非仅靠模型复述 | | **失败模式** | “能做但太贵太慢” | “写了却跳过”“自由发挥导致乱写” | 模型负责“能做什么”，规则负责“按什么流程做、做到什么程度算完成”。两者缺一不可：没有模型，Agent 没有能力；没有规则，Agent 没有纪律。 ### 一：能力上限 模型的能力边界直接决定了 Agent 能完成的任务类型。但关键在于，**不是所有任务都需要调用最大最强的模型**——复杂规划用大模型，简单判断用小模型，这既是成本控制，也是速度优化的必然选择。 ### 二：规则的本质 “规则决定会不会乱写” 规则层的核心机制包括： - **目标与边界**：通过任务拆解、工具白名单、权限审批点，将模型的“自由发挥”约束为“按流程执行”；； - **避免“写了却跳过”** ：把“必须”“禁止”等约束变成程序必经节点，而非仅靠模型在提示词中复述——这是规则从“建议”升级为“强制”的关键。 ### 三：Agent 规则文档是长期执行手册 Agent 规则文档的定位是**权重极高的长期持久提示词**，接近系统提示词，在长任务的每一步持续约束 Agent 的判断，一般用 Markdown 编写。这与“临时 prompt”有本质区别：临时 prompt 解决单次交互，规则文档解决**跨任务、跨会话的一致性**。 系统提示词是 Agent 的“核心规则基石”，负责定义模型的角色定位、应答规范与能力边界，为全程对话定下基础框架。规则文档正是这一理念的具体载体。 ### 四：好规则写动作与验收，坏规则写价值观 这是最具操作性的判断： - **坏规则**：写抽象形容词（“回答要有审美”“方案要高级”），无法让 Agent 落地判断； - **好规则**：从日常反复踩坑的真实工作问题出发，写清楚**遇到这类问题时下一步要执行什么动作，以及怎么验收结果**。 一个完整的 Agent 规范应定义角色、场景、输入、输出、可做/不可做、工具边界、人工确认、失败处理、验收标准，把可观察的 Agent 行为验收清楚。可落地、可校验，才是好规则的检验标准。 ### 五：知识库工具 [knloop]( https://knloop.com) 是一个 Agent 原生知识库，让你的规则成为 Agent 的长期执行手册——你定义动作与验收标准，Agent 在每一步对照执行，全程可审计、可回滚。 [knloop]( https://knloop.com) 让你把规范、SOP 、QA 、复盘写成持久化的 .md 文档，Agent 通过 MCP 读取，按你的规范执行，产出写回同一个库。

projects.summary: 先说适合谁：同时用 Claude Code 、Codex ，手上有好几个中转或国产模型的 key ，被 CC Switch 切换折腾过的，可以试试。 ![概览]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/overview.webp) ## 之前用 CC Switch 的几个痛点 - **切上游总要重启客户端。（ proxy 模式也没有特别好用）** - **Codex 初始化时输入的 key 被它学了过去，结果上游直接炸了。（好像最近修了）** - **Codex 换了供应商，旧会话就接不上**（[#7257]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7257)，四十多楼，还开着）。 - **路由弱，切换也不方便。** 一个客户端同时只能用一个供应商；按模型分给不同家（[#3703]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3703)）挂了快四个月没有维护者回复；负载均衡标了不做，理由是会丢缓存（[#842]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/842)）；按供应商单独设代理，3.14 起还被去掉了（[#2243]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/2243)）。 - **设计和产品力差。** 界面不好看，交互也乱。功能越堆越多：十个客户端、MCP 、Skills 、提示词、会话、用量、几十个供应商预设（里面还有赞助商），核心的切换和路由反而没做好。 - **中转能看到你发出去的全部内容**，它发出前不做任何检查（[#7357]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7357) 还开着）。 ## 换成 ThinkWatch Lite 之后 思路不一样：客户端只接一次，指向本机的网关，之后的事都在网关里做。 - **切中转不用重启**：换上游、调路由都在网关里完成，客户端的配置不再动。手动选择的策略组在菜单栏或托盘里就能切。 - **配置只写一次**：接管时只改指向网关的那几项，写之前给完整 diff 、备份原文件，随时能还原。客户端只拿到一把网关专用的 key ，原来的 key 和登录信息不会被导入或拿去用。 - **Codex 会话不再拆开**：Codex 只认一个 provider ，换上游不影响会话列表（接管前的旧会话仍在原来那边）。 - **路由够用**：按模型、token 数、工具、图片、思考等条件分给不同的上游，也能改写模型名；故障转移、轮询、延迟最低、费用最低都有。轮询时同一个会话固定在同一个上游，缓存照常命中。 - **什么格式都能接**：Anthropic 、OpenAI Chat 、Responses 、Gemini 四种格式互相转换。Claude Code 能用 GPT 、Gemini ，Codex 能接只有 Chat 接口的中转。 - **每个请求看得清**：费用、token 、缓存命中、首 token 时间、生成速度，走了哪条规则、依次试了哪几个上游，完整的请求和响应都在。中转可以按倍率计价，请求还能重放到另一个上游对照。菜单栏直接显示今天花了多少，GLM Coding Plan 、ChatGPT 的额度也能看。 - **省套餐额度**：Claude Code 自己发的标题生成、预热这类辅助请求，可以由网关本地应答，不发给上游。 - **中转收不到你的 key**：发出前把 API key 、token 、私钥等换成占位符，响应里回显时再换回来；模型让客户端执行「下载后执行」「外发环境变量」这类命令时，在流式输出中途切断。默认只记录、不拦截，看过日志确认没有误报再打开。 一键接管的客户端：Claude Code 、Codex （包括 ChatGPT 桌面版里的 Codex ）、opencode 、Claude Desktop 、Zed 、Aider 、DeepSeek Harness ； Cursor 、Continue 、Antigravity CLI 有手动配置的说明。Windows 上 WSL 里的 Claude Code 、Codex 也能接（ WSL 1 或 mirrored 网络）。网关还能装在 Linux 服务器上，由桌面端远程管理。 ![流量]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/traffic.webp) ## 安装 - macOS （ Apple 芯片）：`brew install --cask thinkwatchproject/tap/thinkwatch-lite` - Linux：`curl -fsSL https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` - Windows （ x64 、ARM64 ）： https://thinkwat.ch/zh-CN/lite/#install GitHub： https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite （ MIT ，数据都在本机，不收集使用数据） 用着有问题，或者想要哪个客户端、上游，欢迎在楼里说。

github.description: One browser shared by a human and an AI: visual for the human, source-level for the AI

projects.summary: 浏览器自动化工具（browser-use、Playwright MCP、Browser MCP 等）大多是 AI 在另一个自动化实例里跑流程，人只能看日志。Duplex 想换一种「共处一室」的方式：AI 就在你正在看的那个浏览器里操作。 人看渲染后的页面，AI 读 DOM 与源码快照，两边共用同一个标签页和同一个实时会话。内置 stdio MCP 服务提供 24 个工具（页面快照、点击、输入、拖拽、滚动、等待、截图、标签页、批注、JS 求值等），兼容任意 MCP 客户端（opencode、Claude Code、Codex 等）；AI 的每次操作都会在页面上可视化（光标、元素高亮、"AI 正在点击 X —— Esc 接管"），按 Esc 随时人工接管。 同屏协作：人看到的页面就是 AI 操作的页面，不需要另一个自动化浏览器实例 会话镜像：opencode 会话在侧栏实时镜像；Codex / Claude Code 的会话可直接在面板里续聊 任意 MCP 客户端可用：随应用内置 stdio 桥，首次调用工具时自动拉起浏览器 内置模型可选：支持 OpenAI 兼容接口（含 Ollama）、Anthropic、Gemini 写文件 / 跑命令 / 启动自定义工具都有确认弹窗，Esc / F2 全局急停 说清边界：iframe 与 shadow DOM 内部暂不在快照/点击范围内；页面导航后元素引用会失效，需要重新快照；macOS 安装包未签名（首次需右键打开）；内置小模型在长任务链上明显弱于 opencode / Claude Code 这类完整方案。 Windows / macOS / Linux 安装包见 Releases，MIT 协议。README 附 3 分钟双语字幕

projects.title: Show HN: Strata – an expressive semantic layer that can say no to your LLM
projects.author: ajoski9
projects.summary: Hello HN, I'm Ajo and I built Strata. I spent 4 years at Netflix solving self service for non-technical business users. I think I cracked it with my unique approach to semantic layer design. The key challenge is balancing expressiveness with ease of use for our non technical colleagues. It just so happens that focus made it work pretty well with LLMs too. Strata is a full stack solution. It includes a semantic layer, dashboards, subscriptions, and google sheets exports. All of it can be done view agent conversation or via MCP. Some key concepts and features: - Names are strict. Only one thing called Revenue can exist in a project. If revenue is mapped to multiple tables, the query grain plus speed will decide table. - Strict naming conventions lends itself to enabling Automatic data blending acrros fact domains. - Partition and Aggregate aware semantic routing. This allows you to load a portion of your data into a faster compute engine like Druid or ClickHose, while keeping full history in trino or something cheaper. The query engine will choose the faster tier if the query can be resolved there. - Complex measures: out of the box support for snapshot, LOD (include/exclude), Compound, and Auto leveling compound measures. - On top of the semantic layer users can create custom calculations that span fact domains. - Another interesting feature is the ability to create cohorts and apply as filter to an entire query or single measure within a query. We are deliberately not building a semantic layer that your BI tools connect to. I think that is a dead end. We have apis, and mcp for anything custom you want to build on top. Try it free on docker: https://strata.do/try/ Docs here to get you going: https://strata.do/docs/ This is an early beta version. It is NOT open source. However, the free tier includes up to 25 users. You should be able to run it entirely on your machine with docker. I would love to hear your feedback. Especially, those working with Looker and Cube. Thanks for reading!

Pollymetric shows what's running, who started it, what it costs and what got left behind: servers still running after the agent quit, worktrees filling your disk, models holding memory, plugins with keys in plain text. projects.title: Busbar v1.6.0
projects.summary: Busbar is the execution control plane for AI agents. Unlike LLM gateways that only route model requests, Busbar governs model calls, MCP tool calls, A2A delegation, and downstream actions, adding policy, identity, approvals, and audit. projects.title: PostQuest

projects.title: Show HN: EventSend – Event tracking and routing for solo founders and SaaS teams
projects.author: mytinyrocket
projects.summary: I was tired of learning about failed payments by my customers and not from my system, so I built an event tracker that allowed me to have a searchable feed of the important events happening for my apps and route the ones I cared about to my phone so I could take action quickly. EventSend is an event tracker and a router, your system sends the important events you want to track: signups, failed payments, new subscriptions, deployments, a new purchase, etc. so they end up in a searchable and filterable feed that you can use to have quick insight about what's happening with your product. Then there's also the routing side of things, those important events you want to know the moment they happen, and not once you go into your Grafana Loki logs, can be routed to your phone, Slack, Discord, Telegram or any other system or service via a signed webhook. You can configure rules, alerts, quiet hours or smart rollups to have the signal you're looking for. All event's are retried with a reasonable backoff, circuit breakers and limiters maintain the prviders and system reliable. If we got a 401 or 403, your destination will be inactivated instead of retried and you'll be notified for you to update the configuration. I've been a software engineer for about a decade, and I can tell you this is not a weekend project done on with a single prompt pass, the infrastructure and tooling behind the project is solid, my expertise around distributed systems was put in practice with this one: distributed Elixir, Phoenix and Postgres provide the main stack, with some other technologies that support the event queues aside. So, it's a reliable system. I've launched several other projects, some running for years in production and I'm successfully using EventSend to track what's happening on all my products from my phone. There's also an MCP connector so you can ask stuff like "did anything failed during the night?" or "what did user cus_Qw3Sx did before it churned?" to get a user's timeline or any insights you're interested in. There's a forever free plan, in case you can to try it. Happy to answer any questions.

projects.summary: 我是作者。AgentDeck 是一个手机 / 浏览器插件端，用来远程操作电脑上已经装好、登录好的编码代理（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Qwen Code 等），基于 Agent Client Protocol（ACP）。agent 本身还是要你自己在电脑上装好、配置好，这一步 AgentDeck 不负责，它解决的是"配置好之后怎么远程用"。 一个 App 管所有 agent：不用为每个 agent 单独找/装各自的远程方案，手机上切换着用 端到端加密：配对 ID 和消息端到端加密，relay 只转发密文，也可以自己搭 relay 自托管 移动端体验：语音输入、图片附件、任务完成后手机 push 通知、随时看 Git diff 和文件改动/历史 Android 已上架 Google Play，浏览器插件支持 Chrome / Edge / Firefox（侧边栏 + DevTools 面板） 电脑上装一个后台进程即可： npm install -g agentdeckd agentdeckd start 扫码配对后就能在手机上用。用 Tauri 2 + Rust 写的。

projects.title: Show HN: Relay – a harness for AI coding agents that recover and verify
projects.author: rsathwik07
projects.summary: I'm tired of AI coding agents which are good for 30 seconds and then completely fail on the slightest hiccup: a failing test, a temporarily unavailable dependency, an incorrect assumption. Sometimes I end up having to babysit these agents anyway. Relay is a harness for coding agents which takes advantage of the fact that agents are often good at doing something slightly wrong, and not so good at doing something correctly and completely. Relay repeatedly tries the task and on each failure, uses the output to find a better way to do it. It does this by running the task in a loop: attempt the task, run the checks in a fresh sandbox, on failure read the error and retry instead, until the checks pass. What it learned from a run is retained, so that it doesn't repeat the same mistake, and when the checks eventually pass, it will ship the change as a normal git PR - no hidden state, no magic, the diff is human readable. A few specifics: - it runs locally, is free, and doesn't require an account to run the local agent - it uses a top-tier model to plan/review, and cheaper models to actually write code (for cost reasons) - happy to discuss why this is a good idea and why it isn't - the checks run in an isolated sandbox for each task, rather than "trusting" the agent - currently supports [list actual models/integrations - Opus 5.5, GPT-6, etc] - there's a paid tier for running this unattended across multiple repos with shared sandbox minutes, the actual agent is free. It's not magic, it's not AGI, and it will fail badly on some problems. Would appreciate feedback, particularly from people who've deployed agents unattended and found that they don't actually work, or have had to build substantial tooling around them to get useful results.

projects.summary: 模型真的很大程度上改变了开源生态，以前我是不会自己维护一个开源软件分支的，因为持续的 rebase 让人心里交瘁。 但是现在因为有了便宜的模型，我可以在我喜欢的开源软件上加上我需要的功能，并每晚通过 Github workflow 自动 rebase 上游。 对了，rust 也是一个必要条件，不然代码看上去是合并了，但是只要代码没测试到就一定出问题。 所以在这里分享一个自维护的 codex fork: codex++，https://github.com/yuguorui/codex-plus ![Codex++ CLI with a Bongo Cat terminal pet]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuguorui/codex-plus/main/.github/codex-cli-splash.png) ## 主要特点 ### 1. 多协议原生支持，无需各种独立代理客户端 Codex 官方已经移除的 openai completions 接口，以及 openai 永远不会增加的 anthropic message 接口。 Codex++ 原生支持三种 wire 协议，配置里换一个 `wire_api` 就能切： - `chat` 任何 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容端点都能接 —— Ollama 、vLLM 、LiteLLM 、DeepSeek 、Mistral 、Groq 、Together 、DashScope…… - `anthropic` Claude 走 Anthropic Messages API 原生协议； - `response` openai 目前主推的协议，不用多说了。 ### 2. Agentic 定时 rebase 上游，上游的功能自动同步 fork 最大的痛点是跟上游脱节。 Codex++ 用自动化流程**每天 rebase 到上游最新 commit**，验证通过后自动发布新二进制。 你不用在「 fork 的新功能」和「上游的新特性」之间做选择题，不依赖人工 rebase 。 ### 3. Bongo Cat ，有谁能拒绝可爱的猫猫呢！ 最重要的功能。TUI 里 `/pets` 选 Bongo Cat ，它会趴在输入框旁边，你打字它就跟着敲键盘： - Kitty / iTerm2 / Sixel 终端：完整 sprite 动画 - 其他终端：自动 fallback 成 ASCII 猫猫（无 AI 成分，纯手绘，built-with love ❤️） ### 4. 主线兼容 Codex++ 保持与主线 Codex 的高度兼容，codex++ 二进制默认不覆盖原有的 codex 二进制，出现问题后可随时回滚。 *** 安装方式： ``` # macOS / Linux curl -fsSL https://github.com/yuguorui/codex/releases/latest/download/install-fork.sh | sh ``` ``` # Windows irm https://github.com/yuguorui/codex/releases/latest/download/install-fork.ps1 | iex ``` ```shell # 更新 codex++ 到最新版本 codex++ update ``` 仓库： https://github.com/yuguorui/codex-plus 除了这几点，还有后台多 agent workflow 、第三方模型 memory 兼容等增强，详见 README 。 注：本文编写无 AI 成分。

projects.title: Show HN: Assay – a QA CLI that finds bugs with no LLM and no tests written
projects.author: awss1i
projects.summary: I've always found it odd there was no deterministic QA tools with zero baseline needed, especially after so long. It's always been either (1) playwright or cypress that require written tests, dependant on the tests YOU write, or (2), asking the LLM to find and test bugs in your code, which has 2 cons, its costly (sometimes), and its non-deterministic. That's why i built assay. Its only dependencies is playwright & chromium, and you point it at any folder with a webpage and it runs tests on its own by driving the webpage itself in a browser and clicking every control. It then flags anywhere the webpage contradicted/disagreed with itself; it doesn't know right from wrong NOR what the webpage is about, but universally, a page disagreeing with itself is almost always a bug. An example of this is on a paint app, if you draw two strokes on a canvas and click undo twice, you expect them both to undo each stroke sequentially; in one of 225 benchmarks, clicking the undo the first time didn't remove the first stroke, and only the 2nd click worked. assay drove that and caught it. As for benchmarks, there are 2 variants that are all reproducible in the repo. The first is 225 generated web pages that were first checked by hand, then had assay run on them. There was a total of 20 bugs across all programs, and assay caught 15 with the right reasoning, and had 0 false failures. The second was a harder one where an LLM planted 5 bugs across 10 working original webpages. assay found 12 of the 50 and had 0 false failures, which may seem low, but assays superpower is that its cheap and quick. assays median runtime is 14s, and it plugs into 15 agentic coding harnesses with a skill, plus claude code and deepseek harness have their own plugin that automatically runs it with a stop hook every time the LLM touches a webpage. My favourite feature is that it groups flagged tests together if their of the same bug. More details are in the repo about this since this is getting a little long, but the links it makes have its own benchmarks, 51/51 links it got right with 0 false links. This serves as additional context to you, if you use it as a raw cli, or to your agent if your using it with an LLM harness. pip install assay-ui. All alternative methods to install are on the github, including harness support.

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一下我们团队开源的 Raven（Apache-2.0）。 电脑上装了很多 Agent，用 Claude Code 写代码，Codex 写文案、做设计，Hermes Agent 盯工作消息，一个个切换着用很麻烦。而 Raven 就是管 Agent 的 Agent，只需和 Raven 对话就可以管理和调度所有 Agent，非常方便。而且组合 Agent 之后，Raven 可以把 Codex 的输出传给 Claude Code，同一份工作的不同环节都挑最专业的 Agent 来做，效果大大提升。 它的做法是：先把目标拆成带依赖关系的任务图，再把每个子任务交给最合适的 Agent，上一步的产出自动交给下一步。可调度的既有 Raven 内置的研究、编码、设计和长时任务 Agent，也有通过 ACP 等接口接入的 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes Agent 等第三方 Agent。 一个例子：给 Raven 一份游戏需求文档，它自主运行约 4 天，用 Godot 4 做出了一款可玩的游戏，过程记录在仓库 README 里。 安装（macOS / Linux / WSL2，Windows 见 README）： bash curl -fsSL | bash 安装后用 raven web 打开网页界面，或用 raven tui 打开终端界面。

projects.title: 把开源书《高性价比人生指南》做成了一个 20 题的防坑小测试
projects.author: funet
projects.summary: 前阵子看到 GitHub 上一本开源书《高性价比人生指南》（ https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter ），专挑「花钱少、费时少、不靠毅力、收益大」的人生常识，每条都附研究数字和出处。看完觉得很有用，但很少有人会从头读完，于是把它做成了一个 20 道是非题的小测试。 地址： https://gongfang.app/fangkeng/ **测什么** 分五条防线：保命、急救、钱包、法律、防骗，每线 4 题。随便放几道： - 坐车坐后排，你也会系安全带吗？ - 被开水烫伤了，你会先抹点牙膏或酱油吗？ - 别人欠你钱，你知道拖过 3 年可能就要不回来了吗？ - 在酒吧、KTV ，饮料离开过你的视线，你还会接着喝吗？ 答完出一张「体检报告单」：分数、防坑人格（从「坑见了都绕道走」到「坑王之王」共七档）、确诊病名、最佳坑友和最怕遇到的人格。下面有每道错题的解释和原书出处，这部分我觉得比分数有用。 **可以拿去跟朋友比** 报告单能存成图，图上有二维码；也可以直接转发链接。朋友点开会看到「 XX 拿了 XX 分，你能防住更多坑吗？」，答完两人逐题对比。 **一些实现上的事** - 纯静态单页，没有后端，答案只在浏览器里算，不上传；战绩直接编码在链接参数里 - 分享图是 canvas 现画的，七档的配图用 Codex 生成 - 手机上存图踩了不少坑：iOS 系统分享面板里的「存储图像」时有时无，最后改成全屏大图长按保存；长按带字的图会被「实况文本」抢走变成选文字；答题连点会触发 Safari 双击放大……都在真机上一个个修过，微信和 Safari 里都能正常保存和转发 题目全部来自原书，娱乐为主，医疗和法律问题请以医生、律师意见为准。欢迎来测，也欢迎挑错——哪道题说法不严谨，或者哪里有 bug ，直接回帖告诉我。 我自己是「人形踩坑机」，求一个比我低的。 地址： https://gongfang.app/fangkeng/ ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/e4TU1E4G.jpeg)

projects.summary: 你好，自荐一个 MIT 开源的中英文 Agent Skill：career-growth-plan。 它面向“每天很忙，却说不清自己做了什么、学到了什么”的职场人。三个可以直接试的入口： 职场角色探索：聊几件真实经历，得到可纠正的趣味角色卡，看看工作的收获和消耗。 工作翻译器：把日常工作写成人话版、江湖版、专业版；比喻可以夸张，正式成果不编造。 职场对话陪练：练习争取项目、讨论优先级等场景，AI 一次扮演对方一轮，可以暂停求助。 例如，“今天追设计改图，和研发确认活动页，需求改了三次”，可以整理成“跟进活动素材迭代与活动页需求确认，协调设计、研发之间的变更沟通”；不会凭空写成“主导上线、效率提升 30%”。这是表达示例，不是真实用户成果。 中文免安装试玩 / English trial：复制提示词到常用 AI 即可。完整 Skill 还提供经历复盘与按需保存的本地 Markdown 档案。 这是早期公开预览，需要 AI 工具配合，不是独立 App，也没有后台自动记忆。当前希望收集真实体验反馈，特别是哪些表达有帮助、哪些问题像审问。请勿公开公司或个人敏感信息。 感谢审核。

projects.title: 开源了一个会自己进化的 App：在对话里说一句，你 Mac 上的 Claude Code 就改代码并上线
projects.author: TimeLover

github.name: TimeLovercc/mojito
github.description: Mojito — the local, evolving alternative to cloud personal AI like Meta Muse.

projects.summary: 个人 AI 时代，现在这种 App 的形态还适应未来吗？像 Meta Muse 这样的云端 agent 就是终点吗？我们的答案是「会进化的 App 」。 **Mojito**（ MIT 开源）：在对话里说一句「把下一步放最上面，加粗」，跑在你自己 Mac 上的 Claude Code 就去改代码、构建、发布到手机 / Mac / 网页版，推送告诉你改了什么。 ![]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TimeLovercc/mojito/main/docs/media/hero-light.png) 三个原则： - **薄代码**：服务器上的 hub （ FastAPI + SQLite ）只存数据、提供 API 、发推送，功能不写死 - **agent 掌握上下文**：Claude Code 跑在你自己的 Mac 上，懂你的日程、邮件、文件，也懂这个 App 自己的代码和设计文档 - **和你一起进化**：小改动直接上线，大改动先等你点同意（目前由维护会话按文档判断，代码里还没强制） 一天里长出来的东西（真实记录）： - 「想要个订阅页」→ 订阅页 + 每个来源一键运行 - 「 iPhone 也要能用」→ 当晚就有了能加到桌面的网页版和 Web Push - 「通知收到两遍」→ 自己查到原因（安卓通知库自己又显示了一份）并修好 - 「桌面版像拉长的手机」→ 重做成 Mac 原生风格（新版还在开发） - 「加个英文界面」→ 中英切换 技术栈：Expo （ Android + PWA ）、Tauri （ Mac ）、FastAPI + SQLite 、Claude Code 。 实话实说：还是 alpha ，要自己部署（一台服务器或常开的电脑）；依赖 Claude Code ；数据在你自己的机器上，但 agent 读到的内容会发给你选的模型提供方。 GitHub： https://github.com/TimeLovercc/mojito 欢迎拍砖。独立项目，与 Meta 无关。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】MultiCC：让同一个编码任务在 Claude Code 与 Codex 间接续
projects.author: lsjwzh

github.name: lsjwzh/MultiCC
github.description: Multi Claude Code & Codex Controller

projects.summary: 用 Claude Code 做到一半，想要 Codex 的第二意见、或者额度用完了，通常得新开终端、新开会话，把上下文重讲一遍。 MultiCC 是开源、自托管的 coding agent 工作台：对话和 Git worktree 属于任务本身，CLI 只是当前驱动它的引擎。在同一个 Chat 任务里从 Claude Code 切到 Codex，任务和工作区都留着，接手的 CLI 拿到一份有界的可见上下文 checkpoint，接着往下做。 同一任务跨 CLI 接续：换引擎不丢任务和 worktree，不用从头交代 任务级 Git 隔离：不同 agent 各改各的 worktree，集中看 diff、测试和交付状态 多端接入：同一个自托管后端，桌面、浏览器和手机 App 都能看 分层记忆与 Skill：机器 / CLI / 项目 / 任务 / 会话各有边界，减少重复说明 可选的任务派工与团队交接包：把子任务派给另一个会话，或导出 Skill、记忆、上下文和适用的 Git 提交给队友导入 说清边界：切 CLI 交接的是可见文本 checkpoint，不是模型隐藏状态的无损迁移，原 CLI 保留自己的原生 session；自托管服务器和所选 CLI / 模型需要自己配置，模型调用费用不含在开源项目里。 安装（macOS / Linux，一行，目标机器不需要 Node / npm / Homebrew）： curl -sSL | bash Windows PowerShell：irm | iex MIT 协议。

projects.title: dsh 插件 dsh-waker：唤醒专属你的 AI 员工
projects.author: SFLYYQ
projects.summary: # dsh-waker dsh 插件把 IM 变成 DSH 数字员工的唤醒入口：在群里 @机器人 说一句需求，任务就自动执行并把结果发回群里。 项目地址： ## 功能 - **@机器人 即派活**：群聊 @机器人（或单聊直接发），消息自动交给 DSH 执行，结果自动回 IM - **多角色 Waker**：可创建多个不同职能的数字员工（如全栈开发、测试），发消息时自动匹配最合适的一个 - **项目隔离**：每个 Waker 只能访问授权给它的项目，越权写入被沙箱拒绝 - **任务看板**：排队中 / 运行中 / 需要操作 / 失败 / 已取消 / 已完成，可筛选、取消、重试 - **排队与并发**：同时最多跑 N 个任务（默认 2 ），超限自动排队 ## 解决什么问题 - **人必须在电脑前盯会话**：现在 IM 发条消息就能远程派活，手机上也能用 - **执行过程是黑盒**：任务看板实时展示状态，等待审批时标记「需要操作」，点进去就能处理 - **任务执行到一半卡在提问上**：Waker 有疑问时会把问题转到 IM 群里，你回复后它继续跑 - **对话上下文混乱**：同一群每天一个会话窗口，上下文延续；发「新任务： 」强制开新任务 ## 怎么使用 ### 1. 创建 IM 机器人（一次性） 1. 登录 [IM 开放平台]( https://open-dev.dingtalk.com/) → 应用开发 → 创建企业内部应用 2. 应用能力 → 添加「机器人」能力，接收消息模式选 **Stream 模式**（无需公网） 3. 应用凭证页拿到 **Client ID （ AppKey ）** 和 **Client Secret （ AppSecret ）**，发布应用版本 4. 把机器人拉进群聊（或直接单聊） ### 2. 安装插件 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/SFLAQiu/dsh-waker.git ``` 若提示 `blocked build`，把 CLI 打印的键加进 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 后重跑： ```yaml allowBuilds: dsh-waker: true ``` 然后重启 `dsh web` 并强刷浏览器（⌘⇧R ）。npm 包发布后也可用 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-waker`。 ### 3. 配置并使用 1. DSH 设置 → Waker → IM 管理：填入 Client ID 和 Client Secret →「保存并应用」，状态变「已连接」 2. DSH 设置 → Waker：配置 Waker （职能、头像）、项目（本地路径或 Git 仓库）、 @Waker 绑定 3. Waker 详情 →「能力」页签：按职能从全局目录选用 MCP 工具与技能（支持搜索过滤与全选/清空/全量批量操作；不配置 = 继承全量，详见 [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) 能力治理机制） 4. 群里 @机器人 + 任务描述，例如： > @机器人 帮我看看当前仓库的结构 - 机器人秒回「收到了」，随后按任务类型执行，完成后回执结果 - 追问直接继续 @，上下文延续；`新任务： ` 强制新建 - 群聊没 @ 机器人时完全静默，不会打扰

projects.title: Show HN: Overmux - Build custom agent dev environments with tmux and web UIs
projects.author: richardgill88
projects.summary: I spend most of my time coding with agents, often from my phone. Off-the-shelf tools like Herdr and Orca look cool, but I didn’t want to give up owning and customizing my setup. I built Overmux so I could build an experience similar to Orca on top of my existing tmux workflow, mixing terminals with custom web UIs. Nearly everything in Overmux is a plugin. You could also hook up cloud infrastructure, so your workspace isn’t limited to what’s running on your dev machine. It’s an experimental beta. The best place to start is the short demo video in the README. Cheers, Richard

projects.title: Show HN: Gangway, self-hosted artifacts and apps from folders, PRs, and agents
projects.author: charlesabarnes
projects.summary: Howdy HN! I'm Charles and I wanted to share something I am working on right now: gangway ( https://gangway.sh/ ). Gangway is a simple way to quickly spin up ephemeral containers for previews, demos, artifacts, and temporary sharing This app has started months ago as an idea to take advantage of spare compute capacity I have and to keep some of my hosting costs down. Initially I tried PaaS apps such as Coolify and Dokku, but it didn't provide a way for me to quickly and easily distribute apps I write by hand. Then, I tried creating a few prototypes and failing due to them being overly complex or broad scoped. What I landed on was built one feature at a time: - PR previews - This provided immediate utility to me for my frontend work. I get to review my teams code without being woried about usage or billing - UI to quickly spin up a preview environment - If I have something I want to show a client but it isn't ready to go live on their domain yet, I can drag in a folder, let gangway figure out how to run it, optionally protect it with a password then send them a personalized URL. - MCP - I thought it would be even easier if I can have an LLM deploy the app at any time without much thought. I have used this to message and quickly remedy and preview a bug fix from my phone before it shipped out. - Artifacts - After adding the MCP I realized I often wanted my agent to generate visualizations or previews of features before implementation. Claude users may recognize the general idea from Artifacts, except these can be full stack apps you control. Some examples currently running on gangway, all created from short conversations with different agents: - Paged at 2 am - a user flow for a web-app on a canvas: https://paged-at-2am.demo.gangway.sh - A slide deck from one markdown file (an artifact): https://four-day-week.demo.gangway.sh - Bottle Sea, a small Bun + Postgres app: https://bottle-sea.demo.gangway.sh - Quickfire Trivia - multiplayer rooms: https://quickfire-trivia.demo.gangway.sh - A black hole: https://event-horizon.demo.gangway.sh - FLUX a multiplayer physics demo: https://flux.demo.gangway.sh Install is a one-liner or a quick docker compose setup ( https://github.com/charlesabarnes/gangway#quickstart ), and there's a local-only mode with cloudflare quick tunnel links if you don't want to expose anything. I am considering deploying a multi-tenant hosted version of this to make it even easier. Let me know of any feedback that you may have!
